name: TDA.Persistence.ThreeStageExamples.stage_dimensions
statement:
theorem stage_dimensions (i : Fin 3) :
    Module.finrank k ((compositeZero (k := k)).obj i) = (if i = 1 then 2 else 1) ∧
    Module.finrank k ((compositeIdentity (k := k)).obj i) = (if i = 1 then 2 else 1)

name: TDA.Persistence.ThreeStageExamples.zero_rankBarcode
statement: theorem zero_rankBarcode : rankBarcode (compositeZero (k := k)) = zeroBarcode

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.birthSuffixCount_eq_finrank
statement:
theorem birthSuffixCount_eq_finrank (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin s))
    [∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj i)] (b c : ℕ)
    (hb : 0 < b) (hbc : b ≤ c) (hc : c < s) :
    birthSuffixCount (rankBarcode M) b c =
      Module.finrank k ((LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear M
        (show (⟨b, Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt hbc hc⟩ : Fin s) ≤ ⟨c, hc⟩ from hbc))) ⧸
          birthPreviousImage M b c hb hbc hc)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.birthSuffixCount_le_of_surjective
statement:
theorem birthSuffixCount_le_of_surjective {M N : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin s)}
    [∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj i)] [∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (N.obj i)]
    (p : M ⟶ N) (hp : ∀ i, Function.Surjective (p.app i).hom)
    (b c : ℕ) (hbc : b ≤ c) (hc : c < s) :
    birthSuffixCount (rankBarcode N) b c ≤ birthSuffixCount (rankBarcode M) b c

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.birthSuffixCount_zero
statement:
theorem birthSuffixCount_zero (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin s))
    [∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj i)] (c : ℕ) (hc : c < s) :
    birthSuffixCount (rankBarcode M) 0 c =
      structureMapRank M ⟨0, by omega⟩ ⟨c, hc⟩ (by change 0 ≤ c; omega)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.deathPrefixCount_eq_finrank
statement:
theorem deathPrefixCount_eq_finrank (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin s))
    [∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj i)] (b d : ℕ) (hbd : b < d) (hd : d < s) :
    deathPrefixCount (rankBarcode M) b d =
      Module.finrank k (deathSubspace M b d hbd hd)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.deathPrefixCount_le_of_injective
statement:
theorem deathPrefixCount_le_of_injective {M N : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin s)}
    [∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj i)] [∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (N.obj i)]
    (j : M ⟶ N) (hj : ∀ i, Function.Injective (j.app i).hom) (b d : ℕ)
    (hbd : b < d) (hd : d ≤ s) :
    deathPrefixCount (rankBarcode M) b d ≤ deathPrefixCount (rankBarcode N) b d

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.deathPrefixCount_terminal
statement:
theorem deathPrefixCount_terminal (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin s))
    [∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj i)] (b : ℕ) (hb : b < s) :
    deathPrefixCount (rankBarcode M) b s =
      structureMapRank M ⟨b, hb⟩ ⟨s - 1, by omega⟩ (by change b ≤ s - 1; omega)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.deathOrdinal_lt_deathPrefixCount
statement:
theorem deathOrdinal_lt_deathPrefixCount (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval s))
    (i : BarcodeOccurrence s B) :
    deathOrdinal B i < deathPrefixCount B (occurrence B i).birth (occurrence B i).death

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.deathPrefixCount_le_card
statement:
theorem deathPrefixCount_le_card (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval s)) (b d : ℕ) :
    deathPrefixCount B b d ≤ Fintype.card (DeathOccurrence B d)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.deathPrefixCount_le_deathOrdinal
statement:
theorem deathPrefixCount_le_deathOrdinal (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval s))
    (i : BarcodeOccurrence s B) (b : ℕ) (hb : b < (occurrence B i).birth) :
    deathPrefixCount B b (occurrence B i).death ≤ deathOrdinal B i

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.monoEmbedding_birth_le
statement:
theorem monoEmbedding_birth_le (j : M ⟶ N) (hj : ∀ i, Function.Injective (j.app i).hom)
    (i : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode M)) :
    (occurrence (rankBarcode N) (monoEmbedding j hj i)).birth ≤
      (occurrence (rankBarcode M) i).birth

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.monoEmbedding_comp
statement:
theorem monoEmbedding_comp {P : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin s)}
    [∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (P.obj i)] (j : M ⟶ N) (l : N ⟶ P)
    (hj : ∀ i, Function.Injective (j.app i).hom) (hl : ∀ i, Function.Injective (l.app i).hom) :
    monoEmbedding (j ≫ l) (fun i => (hl i).comp (hj i)) =
      (monoEmbedding j hj).trans (monoEmbedding l hl)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.monoEmbedding_death
statement:
theorem monoEmbedding_death (j : M ⟶ N) (hj : ∀ i, Function.Injective (j.app i).hom)
    (i : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode M)) :
    (occurrence (rankBarcode N) (monoEmbedding j hj i)).death =
      (occurrence (rankBarcode M) i).death

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.monoEmbedding_eq_iff
statement:
theorem monoEmbedding_eq_iff (j : M ⟶ N) (hj : ∀ i, Function.Injective (j.app i).hom)
    (i : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode M)) (a : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode N)) :
    monoEmbedding j hj i = a ↔
      (occurrence (rankBarcode N) a).death = (occurrence (rankBarcode M) i).death ∧
      deathOrdinal (rankBarcode N) a = deathOrdinal (rankBarcode M) i

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.monoEmbedding_id
statement:
theorem monoEmbedding_id (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin s))
    [∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj i)] :
    monoEmbedding (𝟙 M) (fun _ => Function.injective_id) = Function.Embedding.refl _

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.monoEmbedding_mem_range_iff
statement:
theorem monoEmbedding_mem_range_iff (j : M ⟶ N)
    (hj : ∀ i, Function.Injective (j.app i).hom)
    (a : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode N)) :
    a ∈ Set.range (monoEmbedding j hj) ↔
      deathOrdinal (rankBarcode N) a <
        Fintype.card (DeathOccurrence (rankBarcode M) (occurrence (rankBarcode N) a).death)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.monoEmbedding_ordinal
statement:
theorem monoEmbedding_ordinal (j : M ⟶ N) (hj : ∀ i, Function.Injective (j.app i).hom)
    (i : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode M)) :
    deathOrdinal (rankBarcode N) (monoEmbedding j hj i) = deathOrdinal (rankBarcode M) i

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.birthOrdinal_lt_birthSuffixCount
statement:
theorem birthOrdinal_lt_birthSuffixCount (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval s))
    (i : BarcodeOccurrence s B) (c : ℕ) (hc : c < (occurrence B i).death) :
    birthOrdinal B i < birthSuffixCount B (occurrence B i).birth c

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.birthSuffixCount_le_birthOrdinal
statement:
theorem birthSuffixCount_le_birthOrdinal (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval s))
    (i : BarcodeOccurrence s B) (c : ℕ) (hc : (occurrence B i).death ≤ c) :
    birthSuffixCount B (occurrence B i).birth c ≤ birthOrdinal B i

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.birthSuffixCount_le_card
statement:
theorem birthSuffixCount_le_card (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval s)) (b c : ℕ) :
    birthSuffixCount B b c ≤ Fintype.card (BirthOccurrence B b)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.epiEmbedding_birth
statement:
theorem epiEmbedding_birth (p : M ⟶ N) (hp : ∀ i, Function.Surjective (p.app i).hom)
    (i : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode N)) :
    (occurrence (rankBarcode M) (epiEmbedding p hp i)).birth =
      (occurrence (rankBarcode N) i).birth

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.epiEmbedding_comp
statement:
theorem epiEmbedding_comp {P : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin s)}
    [∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (P.obj i)] (p : M ⟶ N) (q : N ⟶ P)
    (hp : ∀ i, Function.Surjective (p.app i).hom) (hq : ∀ i, Function.Surjective (q.app i).hom) :
    epiEmbedding (p ≫ q) (fun i => (hq i).comp (hp i)) =
      (epiEmbedding q hq).trans (epiEmbedding p hp)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.epiEmbedding_death_le
statement:
theorem epiEmbedding_death_le (p : M ⟶ N) (hp : ∀ i, Function.Surjective (p.app i).hom)
    (i : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode N)) :
    (occurrence (rankBarcode N) i).death ≤
      (occurrence (rankBarcode M) (epiEmbedding p hp i)).death

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.epiEmbedding_eq_iff
statement:
theorem epiEmbedding_eq_iff (p : M ⟶ N) (hp : ∀ i, Function.Surjective (p.app i).hom)
    (i : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode N)) (a : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode M)) :
    epiEmbedding p hp i = a ↔
      (occurrence (rankBarcode M) a).birth = (occurrence (rankBarcode N) i).birth ∧
      birthOrdinal (rankBarcode M) a = birthOrdinal (rankBarcode N) i

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.epiEmbedding_id
statement:
theorem epiEmbedding_id (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin s))
    [∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj i)] :
    epiEmbedding (𝟙 M) (fun _ => Function.surjective_id) = Function.Embedding.refl _

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.epiEmbedding_mem_range_iff
statement:
theorem epiEmbedding_mem_range_iff (p : M ⟶ N)
    (hp : ∀ i, Function.Surjective (p.app i).hom)
    (a : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode M)) :
    a ∈ Set.range (epiEmbedding p hp) ↔
      birthOrdinal (rankBarcode M) a <
        Fintype.card (BirthOccurrence (rankBarcode N) (occurrence (rankBarcode M) a).birth)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.epiEmbedding_ordinal
statement:
theorem epiEmbedding_ordinal (p : M ⟶ N) (hp : ∀ i, Function.Surjective (p.app i).hom)
    (i : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode N)) :
    birthOrdinal (rankBarcode M) (epiEmbedding p hp i) = birthOrdinal (rankBarcode N) i

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.epiEmbedding_terminal
statement:
theorem epiEmbedding_terminal (p : M ⟶ N) (hp : ∀ i, Function.Surjective (p.app i).hom)
    (i : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode N)) (hi : (occurrence (rankBarcode N) i).death = s) :
    (occurrence (rankBarcode M) (epiEmbedding p hp i)).death = s

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteEpiMatchingExamples.duplicate_occurrences_distinct
statement:
theorem duplicate_occurrences_distinct :
    ∃ i j : BarcodeOccurrence 1 (rankBarcode (copies 2)),
      i ≠ j ∧ epiEmbedding dropLast dropLast_surjective i ≠
        epiEmbedding dropLast dropLast_surjective j

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteEpiMatchingExamples.duplicate_terminal_count
statement:
theorem duplicate_terminal_count : birthSuffixCount (rankBarcode (copies 2)) 0 0 = 2 ∧
    birthSuffixCount (rankBarcode (copies 2)) 0 0 = structureMapRank (copies 2) 0 0 (le_refl _) ∧
    ∀ i : BarcodeOccurrence 1 (rankBarcode (copies 2)),
      (occurrence _ (epiEmbedding dropLast dropLast_surjective i)).death = 1

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteEpiMatchingExamples.empty_chain
statement:
theorem empty_chain : IsEmpty (BarcodeOccurrence 0 (rankBarcode empty)) ∧
    epiEmbedding (𝟙 empty) (fun _ => Function.surjective_id) = Function.Embedding.refl _

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteEpiMatchingExamples.positive_birth_quotient
statement:
theorem positive_birth_quotient :
    birthSuffixCount (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) laterShort)) 1 1 = 1 ∧
    birthSuffixCount (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) laterShort)) 1 1 =
      Module.finrank ℚ ((LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear (intervalModule (k := ℚ) laterShort)
        (show (1 : Fin 3) ≤ 1 from le_refl _))) ⧸
          birthPreviousImage (intervalModule (k := ℚ) laterShort) 1 1
            (Nat.zero_lt_succ 0) (le_refl 1) (Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.le_succ 1))) ∧
    birthSuffixCount (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) laterShort)) 1 1 ≤
      birthSuffixCount (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) laterLong)) 1 1

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteEpiMatchingExamples.rank_domination_insufficient
statement:
theorem rank_domination_insufficient :
    (∀ (i j : Fin 3) (h : i ≤ j),
      structureMapRank (barcodeModule (k := ℚ) {laterShort}) i j h ≤
        structureMapRank (barcodeModule (k := ℚ) {long}) i j h) ∧
    ¬ ∃ e : BarcodeOccurrence 3 ({laterShort} : Multiset (FiniteInterval 3)) ↪
        BarcodeOccurrence 3 ({long} : Multiset (FiniteInterval 3)),
      ∀ i, (occurrence {long} (e i)).birth = (occurrence {laterShort} i).birth

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteEpiMatchingExamples.three_death_composition
statement:
theorem three_death_composition :
    epiEmbedding (first ≫ second) (fun i => (second_surjective i).comp (first_surjective i)) =
      (epiEmbedding second second_surjective).trans (epiEmbedding first first_surjective)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteEpiMatchingExamples.unequal_death_embedding
statement:
theorem unequal_death_embedding :
    ∃ i : BarcodeOccurrence 3 (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) middle)),
      (occurrence _ i).death = 2 ∧
      (occurrence _ (epiEmbedding first first_surjective i)).death = 3 ∧
      (occurrence _ (epiEmbedding first first_surjective i)).birth = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.birthSuffixCount_translated_le_of_kernelTrivial
statement:
theorem birthSuffixCount_translated_le_of_kernelTrivial
    [∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj i)] [∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (N.obj i)]
    (b c : Fin s) (hbc : b ≤ c) :
    birthSuffixCount (rankBarcode M) b.val (theta c).val ≤
      birthSuffixCount (rankBarcode N) b.val c.val

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.epiEmbedding_covers_long_of_kernelTrivial
statement:
theorem epiEmbedding_covers_long_of_kernelTrivial
    (theta : Fin s →o Fin s) (hTheta : ∀ i, i ≤ theta i) (p : M ⟶ N)
    (hp : ∀ i, Function.Surjective (p.app i).hom)
    (hk : TranslationTrivial theta hTheta (finiteKernel p))
    (i : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode M))
    (hlong : (theta (occurrence (rankBarcode M) i).birthStage).val <
      (occurrence (rankBarcode M) i).death) :
    ∃! j, epiEmbedding p hp j = i

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.epiEmbedding_death_bounds_of_kernelTrivial
statement:
theorem epiEmbedding_death_bounds_of_kernelTrivial
    (theta : Fin s →o Fin s) (hTheta : ∀ i, i ≤ theta i) (p : M ⟶ N)
    (hp : ∀ i, Function.Surjective (p.app i).hom)
    (hk : TranslationTrivial theta hTheta (finiteKernel p))
    (j : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode N)) :
    (occurrence (rankBarcode N) j).death ≤
        (occurrence (rankBarcode M) (epiEmbedding p hp j)).death ∧
      (occurrence (rankBarcode M) (epiEmbedding p hp j)).death ≤
        (occurrence (rankBarcode N) j).translatedDeath theta

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.epiEmbedding_unmatched_short_of_kernelTrivial
statement:
theorem epiEmbedding_unmatched_short_of_kernelTrivial
    (theta : Fin s →o Fin s) (hTheta : ∀ i, i ≤ theta i) (p : M ⟶ N)
    (hp : ∀ i, Function.Surjective (p.app i).hom)
    (hk : TranslationTrivial theta hTheta (finiteKernel p))
    (i : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode M)) (hi : i ∉ Set.range (epiEmbedding p hp)) :
    (occurrence (rankBarcode M) i).death ≤
      (theta (occurrence (rankBarcode M) i).birthStage).val

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteHomDimension.componentMapPi_injective
statement:
theorem componentMapPi_injective (X Y : PModule.{u,0,u} k S) :
    Function.Injective (componentMapPi (k := k) X Y)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteHomDimension.finiteDimensional_hom
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_hom [Fintype S]
    (X Y : PModule.{u,0,u} k S)
    (hX : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (X.obj p))
    (hY : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (Y.obj p)) :
    FiniteDimensional k (X ⟶ Y)

name: TDA.Persistence.fromFiniteImage_injective
statement:
theorem fromFiniteImage_injective (f : M ⟶ N) (i : Fin s) :
    Function.Injective ((fromFiniteImage f).app i).hom

name: TDA.Persistence.fromFiniteImage_surjective
statement:
theorem fromFiniteImage_surjective (f : M ⟶ N)
    (hf : ∀ i, Function.Surjective (f.app i).hom) (i : Fin s) :
    Function.Surjective ((fromFiniteImage f).app i).hom

name: TDA.Persistence.toFiniteImage_comp_fromFiniteImage
statement:
theorem toFiniteImage_comp_fromFiniteImage (f : M ⟶ N) :
    toFiniteImage f ≫ fromFiniteImage f = f

name: TDA.Persistence.toFiniteImage_injective
statement:
theorem toFiniteImage_injective (f : M ⟶ N)
    (hf : ∀ i, Function.Injective (f.app i).hom) (i : Fin s) :
    Function.Injective ((toFiniteImage f).app i).hom

name: TDA.Persistence.toFiniteImage_surjective
statement:
theorem toFiniteImage_surjective (f : M ⟶ N) (i : Fin s) :
    Function.Surjective ((toFiniteImage f).app i).hom

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.inducedMap_domain
statement:
theorem inducedMap_domain (f : M ⟶ N) (i : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode M)) :
    (∃ j, inducedMap f i = some j) ↔ i ∈ inducedDomain f

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.inducedMap_endpoints
statement:
theorem inducedMap_endpoints (f : M ⟶ N)
    (i : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode M)) (j : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode N))
    (h : inducedMap f i = some j) :
    (occurrence (rankBarcode N) j).birth ≤ (occurrence (rankBarcode M) i).birth ∧
      (occurrence (rankBarcode M) i).birth < (occurrence (rankBarcode N) j).death ∧
      (occurrence (rankBarcode N) j).death ≤ (occurrence (rankBarcode M) i).death

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.inducedMap_eq_none_iff
statement:
theorem inducedMap_eq_none_iff (f : M ⟶ N) (i : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode M)) :
    inducedMap f i = none ↔ i ∉ inducedDomain f

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.inducedMap_eq_some_iff
statement:
theorem inducedMap_eq_some_iff (f : M ⟶ N)
    (i : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode M)) (j : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode N)) :
    inducedMap f i = some j ↔
      ∃ a, imageSourceEmbedding f a = i ∧ imageTargetEmbedding f a = j

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.inducedMap_eq_some_iff_unique
statement:
theorem inducedMap_eq_some_iff_unique (f : M ⟶ N)
    (i : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode M)) (j : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode N)) :
    inducedMap f i = some j ↔
      ∃! a, imageSourceEmbedding f a = i ∧ imageTargetEmbedding f a = j

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.inducedMap_injective
statement:
theorem inducedMap_injective (f : M ⟶ N)
    (i i' : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode M)) (j : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode N))
    (hi : inducedMap f i = some j) (hi' : inducedMap f i' = some j) : i = i'

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.inducedMap_intermediate_endpoints
statement:
theorem inducedMap_intermediate_endpoints (f : M ⟶ N)
    (i : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode M)) (j : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode N))
    (h : inducedMap f i = some j) :
    ∃ a, imageSourceEmbedding f a = i ∧ imageTargetEmbedding f a = j ∧
      (occurrence (rankBarcode (finiteImage f)) a).birth = (occurrence (rankBarcode M) i).birth ∧
      (occurrence (rankBarcode (finiteImage f)) a).death = (occurrence (rankBarcode N) j).death

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.inducedMap_range
statement:
theorem inducedMap_range (f : M ⟶ N) (j : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode N)) :
    (∃ i, inducedMap f i = some j) ↔ j ∈ Set.range (imageTargetEmbedding f)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.inducedMatching_from_image
statement:
theorem inducedMatching_from_image (f : M ⟶ N)
    (a : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode (finiteImage f))) :
    inducedMatching f ⟨imageSourceEmbedding f a, ⟨a, rfl⟩⟩ = imageTargetEmbedding f a

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.inducedMap_id
statement:
theorem inducedMap_id (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin s))
    [∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj i)] (i : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode M)) :
    inducedMap (𝟙 M) i = some i

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.inducedMap_of_injective
statement:
theorem inducedMap_of_injective (f : M ⟶ N)
    (hf : ∀ i, Function.Injective (f.app i).hom) (i : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode M)) :
    inducedMap f i = some (monoEmbedding f hf i)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.inducedMap_of_surjective_iff
statement:
theorem inducedMap_of_surjective_iff (f : M ⟶ N)
    (hf : ∀ i, Function.Surjective (f.app i).hom)
    (i : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode M)) (j : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode N)) :
    inducedMap f i = some j ↔ epiEmbedding f hf j = i

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedMatchingExamples.duplicate_identity
statement:
theorem duplicate_identity :
    ∃ i j : BarcodeOccurrence 1 (rankBarcode two), i ≠ j ∧
      inducedMap (𝟙 two) i = some i ∧ inducedMap (𝟙 two) j = some j

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedMatchingExamples.empty_chain
statement:
theorem empty_chain : IsEmpty (BarcodeOccurrence 0 (rankBarcode empty)) ∧
    ∀ i : BarcodeOccurrence 0 (rankBarcode empty), inducedMap (𝟙 empty) i = some i

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedMatchingExamples.nontrivial_endpoints
statement:
theorem nontrivial_endpoints :
    ∃ (i : BarcodeOccurrence 3 (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) sourceBar)))
      (j : BarcodeOccurrence 3 (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) targetBar))),
      inducedMap overlap i = some j ∧
      (occurrence _ i).birth = 1 ∧ (occurrence _ i).death = 3 ∧
      (occurrence _ j).birth = 0 ∧ (occurrence _ j).death = 2

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedMatchingExamples.proper_linear_map
statement:
theorem proper_linear_map :
    ¬ (∀ i, Function.Injective (projection.app i).hom) ∧
      ¬ (∀ i, Function.Surjective (projection.app i).hom)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedMatchingExamples.rank_one_partial_matching
statement:
theorem rank_one_partial_matching :
    Fintype.card (BarcodeOccurrence 1 (rankBarcode two)) = 2 ∧
    Fintype.card {p : BarcodeOccurrence 1 (rankBarcode two) × BarcodeOccurrence 1 (rankBarcode two) //
      inducedMap projection p.1 = some p.2} = 1

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedMatchingExamples.terminal_pair
statement:
theorem terminal_pair :
    ∃ i j : BarcodeOccurrence 1 (rankBarcode two), inducedMap projection i = some j ∧
      (occurrence (rankBarcode two) i).death = 1 ∧ (occurrence (rankBarcode two) j).death = 1

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedMatchingExamples.zero_matching
statement:
theorem zero_matching (i : BarcodeOccurrence 1 (rankBarcode two)) :
    inducedMap (0 : two ⟶ two) i = none

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.deathPrefixCount_le_translated_of_cokernelTrivial
statement:
theorem deathPrefixCount_le_translated_of_cokernelTrivial
    [∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj i)] [∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (N.obj i)]
    (theta : Fin s →o Fin s) (hTheta : ∀ i, i ≤ theta i) (f : M ⟶ N)
    (hf : ∀ i, Function.Injective (f.app i).hom)
    (hc : TranslationTrivial theta hTheta (finiteCokernel f))
    (b : Fin s) (d : ℕ) (htd : (theta b).val < d) (hd : d ≤ s) :
    deathPrefixCount (rankBarcode N) b.val d ≤
      deathPrefixCount (rankBarcode M) (theta b).val d

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.monoEmbedding_birth_bounds_of_cokernelTrivial
statement:
theorem monoEmbedding_birth_bounds_of_cokernelTrivial
    (theta : Fin s →o Fin s) (hTheta : ∀ i, i ≤ theta i) (f : M ⟶ N)
    (hf : ∀ i, Function.Injective (f.app i).hom)
    (hc : TranslationTrivial theta hTheta (finiteCokernel f))
    (i : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode M)) :
    (occurrence (rankBarcode N) (monoEmbedding f hf i)).birth ≤
        (occurrence (rankBarcode M) i).birth ∧
      (occurrence (rankBarcode M) i).birth ≤
        (theta (occurrence (rankBarcode N) (monoEmbedding f hf i)).birthStage).val

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.monoEmbedding_covers_long_of_cokernelTrivial
statement:
theorem monoEmbedding_covers_long_of_cokernelTrivial
    (theta : Fin s →o Fin s) (hTheta : ∀ i, i ≤ theta i) (f : M ⟶ N)
    (hf : ∀ i, Function.Injective (f.app i).hom)
    (hc : TranslationTrivial theta hTheta (finiteCokernel f))
    (a : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode N))
    (hlong : (theta (occurrence (rankBarcode N) a).birthStage).val <
      (occurrence (rankBarcode N) a).death) :
    ∃! i, monoEmbedding f hf i = a

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.monoEmbedding_unmatched_short_of_cokernelTrivial
statement:
theorem monoEmbedding_unmatched_short_of_cokernelTrivial
    (theta : Fin s →o Fin s) (hTheta : ∀ i, i ≤ theta i) (f : M ⟶ N)
    (hf : ∀ i, Function.Injective (f.app i).hom)
    (hc : TranslationTrivial theta hTheta (finiteCokernel f))
    (a : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode N)) (ha : a ∉ Set.range (monoEmbedding f hf)) :
    (occurrence (rankBarcode N) a).death ≤
      (theta (occurrence (rankBarcode N) a).birthStage).val

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.inducedMap_birth_bounds_of_cokernelTrivial
statement:
theorem inducedMap_birth_bounds_of_cokernelTrivial
    (theta : Fin s →o Fin s) (hTheta : ∀ i, i ≤ theta i) (f : M ⟶ N)
    (hc : TranslationTrivial theta hTheta (finiteCokernel f))
    (i : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode M)) (j : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode N))
    (h : inducedMap f i = some j) :
    (occurrence (rankBarcode N) j).birth ≤ (occurrence (rankBarcode M) i).birth ∧
      (occurrence (rankBarcode M) i).birth ≤
        (theta (occurrence (rankBarcode N) j).birthStage).val

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.inducedMap_covers_long_source_of_kernelTrivial
statement:
theorem inducedMap_covers_long_source_of_kernelTrivial
    (theta : Fin s →o Fin s) (hTheta : ∀ i, i ≤ theta i) (f : M ⟶ N)
    (hk : TranslationTrivial theta hTheta (finiteKernel f))
    (i : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode M))
    (hlong : (theta (occurrence (rankBarcode M) i).birthStage).val <
      (occurrence (rankBarcode M) i).death) :
    ∃! j, inducedMap f i = some j

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.inducedMap_covers_long_target_of_cokernelTrivial
statement:
theorem inducedMap_covers_long_target_of_cokernelTrivial
    (theta : Fin s →o Fin s) (hTheta : ∀ i, i ≤ theta i) (f : M ⟶ N)
    (hc : TranslationTrivial theta hTheta (finiteCokernel f))
    (j : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode N))
    (hlong : (theta (occurrence (rankBarcode N) j).birthStage).val <
      (occurrence (rankBarcode N) j).death) :
    ∃! i, inducedMap f i = some j

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.inducedMap_death_bounds_of_kernelTrivial
statement:
theorem inducedMap_death_bounds_of_kernelTrivial
    (theta : Fin s →o Fin s) (hTheta : ∀ i, i ≤ theta i) (f : M ⟶ N)
    (hk : TranslationTrivial theta hTheta (finiteKernel f))
    (i : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode M)) (j : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode N))
    (h : inducedMap f i = some j) :
    (occurrence (rankBarcode N) j).death ≤ (occurrence (rankBarcode M) i).death ∧
      (occurrence (rankBarcode M) i).death ≤
        (occurrence (rankBarcode N) j).translatedDeath theta

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.inducedMap_endpoint_bounds_of_shortness
statement:
theorem inducedMap_endpoint_bounds_of_shortness
    (thetaK thetaC : Fin s →o Fin s) (hK : ∀ i, i ≤ thetaK i) (hC : ∀ i, i ≤ thetaC i)
    (f : M ⟶ N) (hk : TranslationTrivial thetaK hK (finiteKernel f))
    (hc : TranslationTrivial thetaC hC (finiteCokernel f))
    (i : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode M)) (j : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode N))
    (h : inducedMap f i = some j) :
    (occurrence (rankBarcode N) j).birth ≤ (occurrence (rankBarcode M) i).birth ∧
      (occurrence (rankBarcode M) i).birth ≤
        (thetaC (occurrence (rankBarcode N) j).birthStage).val ∧
      (occurrence (rankBarcode M) i).birth < (occurrence (rankBarcode N) j).death ∧
      (occurrence (rankBarcode N) j).death ≤ (occurrence (rankBarcode M) i).death ∧
      (occurrence (rankBarcode M) i).death ≤
        (occurrence (rankBarcode N) j).translatedDeath thetaK

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.inducedMap_unmatched_source_short_of_kernelTrivial
statement:
theorem inducedMap_unmatched_source_short_of_kernelTrivial
    (theta : Fin s →o Fin s) (hTheta : ∀ i, i ≤ theta i) (f : M ⟶ N)
    (hk : TranslationTrivial theta hTheta (finiteKernel f))
    (i : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode M)) (hi : inducedMap f i = none) :
    (occurrence (rankBarcode M) i).death ≤
      (theta (occurrence (rankBarcode M) i).birthStage).val

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.inducedMap_unmatched_target_short_of_cokernelTrivial
statement:
theorem inducedMap_unmatched_target_short_of_cokernelTrivial
    (theta : Fin s →o Fin s) (hTheta : ∀ i, i ≤ theta i) (f : M ⟶ N)
    (hc : TranslationTrivial theta hTheta (finiteCokernel f))
    (j : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode N)) (hj : ∀ i, inducedMap f i ≠ some j) :
    (occurrence (rankBarcode N) j).death ≤
      (theta (occurrence (rankBarcode N) j).birthStage).val

name: TDA.Persistence.cokernel_translationTrivial_fromFiniteImage_iff
statement:
theorem cokernel_translationTrivial_fromFiniteImage_iff (theta : Fin s →o Fin s)
    (hTheta : ∀ i, i ≤ theta i) (f : M ⟶ N) :
    TranslationTrivial theta hTheta (finiteCokernel (fromFiniteImage f)) ↔
      TranslationTrivial theta hTheta (finiteCokernel f)

name: TDA.Persistence.kernel_translationTrivial_toFiniteImage_iff
statement:
theorem kernel_translationTrivial_toFiniteImage_iff (theta : Fin s →o Fin s)
    (hTheta : ∀ i, i ≤ theta i) (f : M ⟶ N) :
    TranslationTrivial theta hTheta (finiteKernel (toFiniteImage f)) ↔
      TranslationTrivial theta hTheta (finiteKernel f)

name: TDA.Persistence.PrincipalDownsetInjective.app_val
statement:
theorem app_val (p : P) (M : PModule.{u,v,u} k P)
    (f : M ⟶ module p) (q : P) (x : M.obj q) :
    ((f.app q).hom x : k) =
      if h : q ≤ p then evaluation p M f (structureMapLinear M h x) else 0

name: TDA.Persistence.PrincipalDownsetInjective.evaluation_extension
statement:
@[simp] theorem evaluation_extension (p : P) (M : PModule.{u,v,u} k P)
    (l : M.obj p →ₗ[k] k) : evaluation p M (extension p M l) = l

name: TDA.Persistence.PrincipalDownsetInjective.evaluation_precomp
TDA.Persistence.PrincipalDownsetInjective.extension_app_val
statement:
theorem extension_app_val (p : P) (M : PModule.{u,v,u} k P)
    (l : M.obj p →ₗ[k] k) (q : P) (x : M.obj q) :
    (((extension p M l).app q).hom x : k) =
      if h : q ≤ p then l (structureMapLinear M h x) else 0

name: TDA.Persistence.PrincipalDownsetInjective.extension_evaluation
statement:
@[simp] theorem extension_evaluation (p : P) (M : PModule.{u,v,u} k P)
    (f : M ⟶ module p) : extension p M (evaluation p M f) = f

name: TDA.Persistence.PrincipalDownsetInjective.extension_precomp
TDA.Persistence.PrincipalDownsetInjective.hom_ext
statement:
@[ext] theorem hom_ext (p : P) (M : PModule.{u,v,u} k P)
    {f g : M ⟶ module p} (h : evaluation p M f = evaluation p M g) : f = g

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInjectivePresentation.component_injective
statement: theorem component_injective (q : P) : Function.Injective ((embedding M).app q).hom

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInjectivePresentation.embedding_coordinate
statement:
@[simp] theorem embedding_coordinate (q : P) (j : Fin (Module.finrank k (M.obj q)))
    (x : M.obj q) :
    (((biproduct.π (family M) ⟨q, j⟩).app q).hom (((embedding M).app q).hom x) : k) =
      coordinate M q j x

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInjectivePresentation.embedding_retraction
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)] theorem embedding_retraction [Injective M] :
    embedding M ≫ retraction M = 𝟙 M

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInjectivePresentation.embedding_π
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem embedding_π (t : Index M) :
    embedding M ≫ biproduct.π (family M) t = summandMap M t

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInjectivePresentation.embedding_π_app_val
statement:
theorem embedding_π_app_val (t : Index M) (q : P) (x : M.obj q) :
    (((biproduct.π (family M) t).app q).hom (((embedding M).app q).hom x) : k) =
      if h : q ≤ t.1 then coordinate M t.1 t.2 (structureMapLinear M h x) else 0

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInjectivePresentation.injective_iff_splits
statement:
theorem injective_iff_splits : Injective M ↔
    ∃ r : module M ⟶ M, embedding M ≫ r = 𝟙 M

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInjectivePresentation.presentation_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem presentation_finiteDimensional (p : P) :
    FiniteDimensional k ((presentation M).J.obj p)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInjectivePresentation.Examples.Downset.earlier_fiber_nonzero
statement:
theorem earlier_fiber_nonzero :
    ∃ x : (PrincipalDownsetInjective.module (k := ℚ) (2 : ℕ)).obj 0, x ≠ 0

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInjectivePresentation.Examples.Downset.infinite_poset_injective
statement:
theorem infinite_poset_injective :
    Injective (PrincipalDownsetInjective.module (k := ℚ) (2 : ℕ))

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInjectivePresentation.Examples.Downset.off_endpoint_coefficient
statement:
theorem off_endpoint_coefficient :
    (((extension 2 scalarLine (LinearMap.id : ℚ →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)).app 0).hom (7 : ℚ) : ℚ) = 7

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInjectivePresentation.Examples.Downset.outside_coefficient
statement:
theorem outside_coefficient :
    (((extension 2 scalarLine (LinearMap.id : ℚ →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ)).app 3).hom (7 : ℚ) : ℚ) = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInjectivePresentation.Examples.downset_splitting
statement:
theorem downset_splitting :
    embedding (PrincipalDownsetInjective.module (k := ℚ) (1 : Fin 2)) ≫
        retraction (PrincipalDownsetInjective.module (k := ℚ) (1 : Fin 2)) =
      𝟙 (PrincipalDownsetInjective.module (k := ℚ) (1 : Fin 2))

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInjectivePresentation.Examples.empty_poset
statement:
theorem empty_poset :
    Fintype.card (Index (0 : PModule ℚ (Fin 0))) = 0 ∧
      Mono (embedding (0 : PModule ℚ (Fin 0)))

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInjectivePresentation.Examples.repeated_coordinate_values
statement:
theorem repeated_coordinate_values :
    ∃ (s t : Index doubleModule) (x : doubleModule.obj 0), s ≠ t ∧
      (((biproduct.π (family doubleModule) s).app 0).hom
        (((embedding doubleModule).app 0).hom x) : ℚ) = 1 ∧
      (((biproduct.π (family doubleModule) t).app 0).hom
        (((embedding doubleModule).app 0).hom x) : ℚ) = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInjectivePresentation.Examples.repeated_occurrence_count
statement: theorem repeated_occurrence_count : Fintype.card (Index doubleModule) = 2

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInjectivePresentation.Examples.repeated_occurrences_distinct
statement:
theorem repeated_occurrences_distinct :
    ∃ s t : Index doubleModule, s ≠ t ∧ family doubleModule s = family doubleModule t

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInjectivePresentation.Examples.zero_occurrences
statement: theorem zero_occurrences : Fintype.card (Index (0 : PModule ℚ (Fin 2))) = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInjectivePresentation.Examples.zero_presentation
statement:
theorem zero_presentation :
    Mono (presentation (0 : PModule ℚ (Fin 2))).f ∧
      Injective (presentation (0 : PModule ℚ (Fin 2))).J

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.adjacentRecovery_hom_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem adjacentRecovery_hom_app (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin N)) (i : Fin N) :
    (adjacentRecovery M).hom.app i = 𝟙 (M.obj i)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.adjacentRecovery_inv_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem adjacentRecovery_inv_app (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin N)) (i : Fin N) :
    (adjacentRecovery M).inv.app i = 𝟙 (M.obj i)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.adjacentRecovery_naturality
statement:
theorem adjacentRecovery_naturality {M W : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin N)} (α : M ⟶ W) :
    homOfAdjacent M.obj W.obj (adjacentMap M) (adjacentMap W) α.app
      (fun _ _ h => α.naturality (homOfLE (show _ ≤ _ by omega))) ≫
        (adjacentRecovery W).hom = (adjacentRecovery M).hom ≫ α

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.homMk_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem homMk_app {M W : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin N)} (α) (hα) (i : Fin N) :
    (homMk (M := M) (W := W) α hα).app i = α i

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.homOfAdjacent_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem homOfAdjacent_app (V W : Fin N → ModuleCat.{w} R) (step step') (α) (hα)
    (i : Fin N) : (homOfAdjacent V W step step' α hα).app i = α i

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.isoOfAdjacent_hom_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isoOfAdjacent_hom_app {M W : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin N)} (e) (he) (i : Fin N) :
    (isoOfAdjacent (M := M) (W := W) e he).hom.app i = (e i).hom

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.isoOfAdjacent_inv_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isoOfAdjacent_inv_app {M W : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin N)} (e) (he) (i : Fin N) :
    (isoOfAdjacent (M := M) (W := W) e he).inv.app i = (e i).inv

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.le_of_path
statement: theorem le_of_path {i j : FiniteLine N} (p : Quiver.Path i j) : i.index ≤ j.index

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.moduleOfAdjacent_obj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem moduleOfAdjacent_obj (V : Fin N → ModuleCat.{w} R)
    (step : ∀ (i j : Fin N), i.val + 1 = j.val → (V i ⟶ V j)) (i : Fin N) :
    (moduleOfAdjacent V step).obj i = V i

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.naturality_of_adjacent
statement:
theorem naturality_of_adjacent {M W : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin N)}
    (α : ∀ i, M.obj i ⟶ W.obj i)
    (hα : ∀ (i j : Fin N) (h : i.val + 1 = j.val),
      structureMap M (show i ≤ j by omega) ≫ α j =
        α i ≫ structureMap W (show i ≤ j by omega))
    {i j : Fin N} (h : i ≤ j) :
    structureMap M h ≫ α j = α i ≫ structureMap W h

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.pathEquivalence_functor_obj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pathEquivalence_functor_obj (i : Paths (FiniteLine N)) :
    (pathEquivalence N).functor.obj i = i.index

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.pathEquivalence_inverse_obj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pathEquivalence_inverse_obj (i : Fin N) :
    (pathEquivalence N).inverse.obj i = (⟨i⟩ : FiniteLine N)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.path_adjacent
statement:
theorem path_adjacent {i j : FiniteLine N} (h : i.index.val + 1 = j.index.val) :
    path (show i.index ≤ j.index by change i.index.val ≤ j.index.val; omega) =
      Quiver.Hom.toPath (⟨h⟩ : i ⟶ j)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.path_comp
statement:
theorem path_comp {i j k : FiniteLine N} (hij : i.index ≤ j.index)
    (hjk : j.index ≤ k.index) :
    (path hij).comp (path hjk) = path (hij.trans hjk)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.path_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem path_self (i : FiniteLine N) (h : i.index ≤ i.index) :
    path h = (Quiver.Path.nil : Quiver.Path i i)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.representationEquivalence_counitIso_hom_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem representationEquivalence_counitIso_hom_app
    (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin N)) (i : Fin N) :
    ((representationEquivalence R N).counitIso.hom.app M).app i = 𝟙 (M.obj i)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.representationEquivalence_inverse_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem representationEquivalence_inverse_map (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin N))
    {i j : Paths (FiniteLine N)} (p : i ⟶ j) :
    ((representationEquivalence R N).inverse.obj M).map p =
      structureMap M (le_of_path p)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.representationEquivalence_inverse_map_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem representationEquivalence_inverse_map_app
    {M W : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin N)} (α : M ⟶ W) (i : Paths (FiniteLine N)) :
    ((representationEquivalence R N).inverse.map α).app i = α.app i.index

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.representationEquivalence_map_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem representationEquivalence_map_app
    {F G : Paths (FiniteLine N) ⥤ ModuleCat.{w} R} (α : F ⟶ G) (i : Fin N) :
    ((representationEquivalence R N).functor.map α).app i = α.app ⟨i⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.representationEquivalence_map_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem representationEquivalence_map_comp
    {F G H : Paths (FiniteLine N) ⥤ ModuleCat.{w} R} (α : F ⟶ G) (β : G ⟶ H) :
    (representationEquivalence R N).functor.map (α ≫ β) =
      (representationEquivalence R N).functor.map α ≫
        (representationEquivalence R N).functor.map β

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.representationEquivalence_map_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem representationEquivalence_map_id (F : Paths (FiniteLine N) ⥤ ModuleCat.{w} R) :
    (representationEquivalence R N).functor.map (𝟙 F) =
      𝟙 ((representationEquivalence R N).functor.obj F)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.representationEquivalence_obj_obj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem representationEquivalence_obj_obj (F : Paths (FiniteLine N) ⥤ ModuleCat.{w} R)
    (i : Fin N) :
    ((representationEquivalence R N).functor.obj F).obj i = F.obj ⟨i⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.representationEquivalence_structureMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem representationEquivalence_structureMap
    (F : Paths (FiniteLine N) ⥤ ModuleCat.{w} R) {i j : Fin N} (h : i ≤ j) :
    structureMap ((representationEquivalence R N).functor.obj F) h = F.map (path h)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.representationEquivalence_unitIso_hom_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem representationEquivalence_unitIso_hom_app
    (F : Paths (FiniteLine N) ⥤ ModuleCat.{w} R) (i : Paths (FiniteLine N)) :
    ((representationEquivalence R N).unitIso.hom.app F).app i = 𝟙 (F.obj i)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.structureMap_adjacentRecovery
statement:
@[simp]
theorem structureMap_adjacentRecovery (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin N))
    {i j : Fin N} (h : i ≤ j) :
    structureMap (moduleOfAdjacent M.obj (adjacentMap M)) h = structureMap M h

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.structureMap_moduleOfAdjacent_adjacent
statement:
@[simp]
theorem structureMap_moduleOfAdjacent_adjacent (V : Fin N → ModuleCat.{w} R)
    (step : ∀ (i j : Fin N), i.val + 1 = j.val → (V i ⟶ V j))
    {i j : Fin N} (h : i.val + 1 = j.val) :
    structureMap (moduleOfAdjacent V step) (show i ≤ j by omega) = step i j h

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.structureMap_moduleOfAdjacent_last
statement:
theorem structureMap_moduleOfAdjacent_last (V : Fin N → ModuleCat.{w} R)
    (step : ∀ (i j : Fin N), i.val + 1 = j.val → (V i ⟶ V j))
    {i j k : Fin N} (hij : i ≤ j) (hjk : j.val + 1 = k.val) :
    structureMap (moduleOfAdjacent V step) (show i ≤ k by omega) =
      structureMap (moduleOfAdjacent V step) hij ≫ step j k hjk

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.structureMap_moduleOfAdjacent_path
statement:
theorem structureMap_moduleOfAdjacent_path (V : Fin N → ModuleCat.{w} R)
    (step : ∀ (i j : Fin N), i.val + 1 = j.val → (V i ⟶ V j))
    {i j : Fin N} (h : i ≤ j) :
    structureMap (moduleOfAdjacent V step) h =
      (Paths.lift (⟨fun a => V a.index,
        fun {a b} e => step a.index b.index e.down⟩ :
          FiniteLine N ⥤q ModuleCat.{w} R)).map (path h)

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.totalFiniteCost_finiteRestriction_le_card_mul_cost
statement:
theorem totalFiniteCost_finiteRestriction_le_card_mul_cost
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J E F) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ)
    (b : E → ℝ) (c : F → ℝ) :
    M.finiteRestriction.totalFiniteCost x y ≤
      ((Fintype.card I + Fintype.card J : ℕ) : ℝ) * (M.cost x y b c).toReal

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_le_card_mul_bottleneck
statement:
theorem finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_le_card_mul_bottleneck
    (D E : Diagram ℝ) (hfinite : bottleneck D E < ⊤) :
    finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost (fun p : D.finiteOccurrences => p.1)
        (fun p : E.finiteOccurrences => p.1) ≤
      ((Fintype.card D.finiteOccurrences + Fintype.card E.finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        (bottleneck D E).toReal

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMonoMatchingExamples.duplicate_occurrences_distinct
statement:
theorem duplicate_occurrences_distinct :
    ∃ i j : BarcodeOccurrence 1 (rankBarcode duplicates),
      i ≠ j ∧ monoEmbedding (𝟙 duplicates) (fun _ => Function.injective_id) i ≠
        monoEmbedding (𝟙 duplicates) (fun _ => Function.injective_id) j

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMonoMatchingExamples.duplicate_terminal_count
statement: theorem duplicate_terminal_count : deathPrefixCount (rankBarcode duplicates) 0 1 = 2

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMonoMatchingExamples.empty_chain
statement:
theorem empty_chain : IsEmpty (BarcodeOccurrence 0 (rankBarcode empty)) ∧
    monoEmbedding (𝟙 empty) (fun _ => Function.injective_id) = Function.Embedding.refl _

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMonoMatchingExamples.finite_death_count
statement:
theorem finite_death_count :
    deathPrefixCount (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) short)) 1 2 = 1 ∧
      deathPrefixCount (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) short)) 1 2 =
        Module.finrank ℚ (deathSubspace (intervalModule (k := ℚ) short) 1 2 (by decide) (by decide))

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMonoMatchingExamples.rank_domination_insufficient
statement:
theorem rank_domination_insufficient :
    (∀ (i j : Fin 3) (h : i ≤ j),
      structureMapRank (barcodeModule (k := ℚ) {short}) i j h ≤
        structureMapRank (barcodeModule (k := ℚ) {early}) i j h) ∧
    ¬ ∃ e : BarcodeOccurrence 3 ({short} : Multiset (FiniteInterval 3)) ↪
        BarcodeOccurrence 3 ({early} : Multiset (FiniteInterval 3)),
      ∀ i, (occurrence {early} (e i)).death = (occurrence {short} i).death

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMonoMatchingExamples.three_birth_composition
statement:
theorem three_birth_composition :
    monoEmbedding (first ≫ second) (fun i => (second_injective i).comp (first_injective i)) =
      (monoEmbedding first first_injective).trans (monoEmbedding second second_injective)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMonoMatchingExamples.unequal_birth_embedding
statement:
theorem unequal_birth_embedding :
    ∃ i : BarcodeOccurrence 3 (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) late)),
      (occurrence _ i).birth = 2 ∧
      (occurrence _ (monoEmbedding first first_injective i)).birth = 1 ∧
      (occurrence _ (monoEmbedding first first_injective i)).death = 3

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMonoTranslationExamples.duplicate_long_coverage
statement:
theorem duplicate_long_coverage :
    ∃ a b : BarcodeOccurrence 4 (rankBarcode duplicates), a ≠ b ∧
      (∃! i, monoEmbedding (𝟙 duplicates) (fun _ => Function.injective_id) i = a) ∧
      (∃! i, monoEmbedding (𝟙 duplicates) (fun _ => Function.injective_id) i = b)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMonoTranslationExamples.empty_chain
statement:
theorem empty_chain :
    TranslationTrivial OrderHom.id (fun _ : Fin 0 => le_rfl) (finiteCokernel (𝟙 empty)) ∧
      IsEmpty (BarcodeOccurrence 0 (rankBarcode empty))

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMonoTranslationExamples.finite_birth_bound_attained
statement:
theorem finite_birth_bound_attained :
    ∃ i : BarcodeOccurrence 4 (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) (late 3 (by decide) (by decide)))),
      (occurrence _ i).birth = 1 ∧
      (occurrence _ (monoEmbedding (delayed 3 (by decide) (by decide))
        (delayed_injective 3 (by decide) (by decide)) i)).birth = 0 ∧
      (occurrence _ i).birth =
        (theta (occurrence _ (monoEmbedding (delayed 3 (by decide) (by decide))
          (delayed_injective 3 (by decide) (by decide)) i)).birthStage).val ∧
      deathPrefixCount (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) (early 3 (by decide) (by decide)))) 0 3 ≤
        deathPrefixCount (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) (late 3 (by decide) (by decide)))) 1 3

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMonoTranslationExamples.fixed_point_rejects_shortness
statement:
theorem fixed_point_rejects_shortness :
    ¬ TranslationTrivial theta theta_forward (finiteCokernel fixedInclusion)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMonoTranslationExamples.identity_translation
statement:
theorem identity_translation :
    ∀ a : BarcodeOccurrence 4 (rankBarcode duplicates),
      (occurrence _ (monoEmbedding (𝟙 duplicates) (fun _ => Function.injective_id) a)).birth =
        (occurrence _ a).birth ∧
      ∃! i, monoEmbedding (𝟙 duplicates) (fun _ => Function.injective_id) i = a

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMonoTranslationExamples.noninjective_translation
statement:
theorem noninjective_translation : theta 0 = 1 ∧ theta 1 = 1 ∧
    ¬ Function.Injective theta

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMonoTranslationExamples.short_matched_birth_bound
statement:
theorem short_matched_birth_bound :
    ∃ a : BarcodeOccurrence 4 (rankBarcode shortTarget),
      (occurrence _ a).death = (theta (occurrence _ a).birthStage).val ∧
      (occurrence _ a).birth ≤ (theta (occurrence _ a).birthStage).val ∧
      monoEmbedding (𝟙 shortTarget) (fun _ => Function.injective_id) a = a

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMonoTranslationExamples.terminal_coverage
statement:
theorem terminal_coverage :
    ∀ a : BarcodeOccurrence 4 (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) (early 4 (by decide) (by decide)))),
      (occurrence _ a).death = 4 ∧
        ∃! i, monoEmbedding (delayed 4 (by decide) (by decide))
          (delayed_injective 4 (by decide) (by decide)) i = a

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMonoTranslationExamples.threshold_unmatched
statement:
theorem threshold_unmatched :
    TranslationTrivial theta theta_forward (finiteCokernel shortInclusion) ∧
      ∀ a : BarcodeOccurrence 4 (rankBarcode shortTarget),
        (occurrence _ a).death = (theta (occurrence _ a).birthStage).val ∧
          a ∉ Set.range (monoEmbedding shortInclusion short_injective)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteObservation.finite_family_rankBarcode
statement:
theorem finite_family_rankBarcode {k : Type*} [Field k] {J : Type} [Fintype J]
    (c : Fin N ↪o ℝ) (S : J → Set ℝ) (hS : ∀ a, (S a).OrdConnected) :
    rankBarcode (reindex c.toOrderHom (AlgebraicFamily.familyModule
      (fun a => SupportInterval.module (k := k) (S a) (hS a)))) =
      finiteFamilyBarcode c S

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteObservation.finite_family_sampled_rank
statement:
theorem finite_family_sampled_rank {k : Type*} [Field k] {J : Type} [Fintype J]
    (c : Fin N ↪o ℝ) (S : J → Set ℝ) (hS : ∀ j, (S j).OrdConnected)
    (i j : Fin N) (hij : i ≤ j) :
    structureMapRank
      (reindex c.toOrderHom (AlgebraicFamily.familyModule
        (fun a => SupportInterval.module (k := k) (S a) (hS a)))) i j hij =
      ∑ a : J, if c i ∈ S a ∧ c j ∈ S a then 1 else 0

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteObservation.finite_visible_occurrences
statement:
theorem finite_visible_occurrences {J : Type*} (c : Fin N ↪o ℝ) (S : J → Set ℝ)
    (hlocal : ∀ i : Fin N, {j : J | c i ∈ S j}.Finite) :
    {j : J | ∃ i : Fin N, c i ∈ S j}.Finite

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteObservation.finite_visible_of_decomposition
statement:
theorem finite_visible_of_decomposition {k : Type*} [Field k] {J : Type}
    (M : PModule.{_,0,_} k ℝ) [∀ t : ℝ, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj t)]
    (c : Fin N ↪o ℝ) (S : J → Set ℝ) (hS : ∀ a, (S a).OrdConnected)
    (e : M ≅ AlgebraicFamily.familyModule
      (fun a => SupportInterval.module (k := k) (S a) (hS a))) :
    {a : J | ∃ i : Fin N, c i ∈ S a}.Finite

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteObservation.rankBarcode_of_decomposition
statement:
theorem rankBarcode_of_decomposition {k : Type*} [Field k] {J : Type}
    (M : PModule.{_,0,_} k ℝ) [∀ t : ℝ, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj t)]
    (c : Fin N ↪o ℝ) (S : J → Set ℝ) (hS : ∀ a, (S a).OrdConnected)
    (e : M ≅ AlgebraicFamily.familyModule
      (fun a => SupportInterval.module (k := k) (S a) (hS a)))
    (hvisible : {a : J | ∃ i : Fin N, c i ∈ S a}.Finite) :
    rankBarcode (reindex c.toOrderHom M) =
      letI : Fintype {a : J | ∃ i : Fin N, c i ∈ S a}

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteObservation.rankBarcode_of_pfd_decomposition
TDA.Persistence.FiniteObservation.sampledInterval_alive_iff
statement:
theorem sampledInterval_alive_iff (c : Fin N ↪o ℝ) (S : Set ℝ)
    (hS : S.OrdConnected) (hne : (active c S).Nonempty) (i : Fin N) :
    (sampledInterval c S hne).alive i ↔ c i ∈ S

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteObservation.sampled_rankBarcode_empty
statement:
theorem sampled_rankBarcode_empty (c : Fin N ↪o ℝ) (S : Set ℝ)
    (hS : S.OrdConnected) (hempty : active c S = ∅) :
    rankBarcode (reindex c.toOrderHom (SupportInterval.module (k := k) S hS)) = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteObservation.sampled_rankBarcode_single
statement:
theorem sampled_rankBarcode_single (c : Fin N ↪o ℝ) (S : Set ℝ)
    (hS : S.OrdConnected) (hne : (active c S).Nonempty) :
    rankBarcode (reindex c.toOrderHom (SupportInterval.module (k := k) S hS)) =
      {(sampledInterval c S hne)}

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteObservation.sampled_structureMapRank_eq_interval
statement:
theorem sampled_structureMapRank_eq_interval (c : Fin N ↪o ℝ) (S : Set ℝ)
    (hS : S.OrdConnected) (hne : (active c S).Nonempty)
    (i j : Fin N) (hij : i ≤ j) :
    structureMapRank (reindex c.toOrderHom (SupportInterval.module (k := k) S hS)) i j hij =
      structureMapRank (intervalModule (k := k) (sampledInterval c S hne)) i j hij

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteOccurrenceMatching.exists_two_sided
statement:
theorem exists_two_sided {α β : Type} [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
    (P : α → Prop) (Q : β → Prop) (r : α → β → Prop)
    (f : {a // P a} → β) (hf : Injective f) (hfr : ∀ a, r a.val (f a))
    (g : {b // Q b} → α) (hg : Injective g) (hgr : ∀ b, r (g b) b.val) :
    ∃ M : OccurrenceMatching α β PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1},
      (∀ a b, M.finite a = some b → r a b) ∧
      (∀ a, P a → ∃ b, M.finite a = some b) ∧
      (∀ b, Q b → ∃ a, M.finite a = some b)

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.totalFinitePowerCost_finiteRestriction_le_card_mul_cost_rpow
statement:
theorem totalFinitePowerCost_finiteRestriction_le_card_mul_cost_rpow
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J E F) {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) (b : E → ℝ) (c : F → ℝ) :
    M.finiteRestriction.totalFinitePowerCost p x y ≤
      ((Fintype.card I + Fintype.card J : ℕ) : ℝ) * (M.cost x y b c).toReal ^ p

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePBoundaryTransportCost_le_cardBound_rpow_mul_of_bottleneck_le
statement:
theorem finitePBoundaryTransportCost_le_cardBound_rpow_mul_of_bottleneck_le
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (D E : Diagram ℝ) {m : ℕ}
    (hcard : Fintype.card D.finiteOccurrences + Fintype.card E.finiteOccurrences ≤ m)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hB : bottleneck D E ≤ ENNReal.ofReal r) :
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost p (fun q : D.finiteOccurrences => q.1)
        (fun q : E.finiteOccurrences => q.1) ≤ (m : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹ * r

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePBoundaryTransportCost_le_card_rpow_mul_bottleneck
statement:
theorem finitePBoundaryTransportCost_le_card_rpow_mul_bottleneck
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (D E : Diagram ℝ) (hfinite : bottleneck D E < ⊤) :
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost p (fun q : D.finiteOccurrences => q.1)
        (fun q : E.finiteOccurrences => q.1) ≤
      (((Fintype.card D.finiteOccurrences + Fintype.card E.finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹) *
        (bottleneck D E).toReal

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePBoundaryTransportCost_le_card_rpow_mul_of_bottleneck_le
statement:
theorem finitePBoundaryTransportCost_le_card_rpow_mul_of_bottleneck_le
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (D E : Diagram ℝ) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hB : bottleneck D E ≤ ENNReal.ofReal r) :
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost p (fun q : D.finiteOccurrences => q.1)
        (fun q : E.finiteOccurrences => q.1) ≤
      (((Fintype.card D.finiteOccurrences + Fintype.card E.finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹) *
        r

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePMatchingCost_le_card_rpow_mul_bottleneck
statement:
theorem finitePMatchingCost_le_card_rpow_mul_bottleneck
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (D E : Diagram ℝ) (hfinite : bottleneck D E < ⊤) :
    finitePMatchingCost p (fun q : D.finiteOccurrences => q.1)
        (fun q : E.finiteOccurrences => q.1) ≤

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePBoundaryTransportCost_abs_sub_bottleneck_le_uniformBound
statement:
theorem finitePBoundaryTransportCost_abs_sub_bottleneck_le_uniformBound
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (D E : Diagram ℝ)
    (hD : essentialPart D.points = 0) (hE : essentialPart E.points = 0)
    {m : ℕ}
    (hcard : Fintype.card D.finiteOccurrences + Fintype.card E.finiteOccurrences ≤ m)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hB : bottleneck D E ≤ ENNReal.ofReal R) :
    |finitePBoundaryTransportCost p (fun q : D.finiteOccurrences => q.1)
        (fun q : E.finiteOccurrences => q.1) - (bottleneck D E).toReal| ≤
      ((((max 1 m : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹) - 1) * R

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePBoundaryTransportCost_tendstoUniformlyOn_bottleneck
statement:

      (fun p : ℝ => fun z : Diagram ℝ × Diagram ℝ =>
        finitePBoundaryTransportCost p (fun q : z.1.finiteOccurrences => q.1)
          (fun q : z.2.finiteOccurrences => q.1))
      (fun z : Diagram ℝ × Diagram ℝ => (bottleneck z.1 z.2).toReal) atTop
      {z : Diagram ℝ × Diagram ℝ |
        essentialPart z.1.points = 0 ∧ essentialPart z.2.points = 0 ∧
        Fintype.card z.1.finiteOccurrences + Fintype.card z.2.finiteOccurrences ≤ m ∧
        bottleneck z.1 z.2 ≤ ENNReal.ofReal R}

    {m : ℕ}

    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hB : bottleneck D E ≤ ENNReal.ofReal R) :
    |finitePMatchingCost p (fun q : D.finiteOccurrences => q.1)
        (fun q : E.finiteOccurrences => q.1) - (bottleneck D E).toReal| ≤

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePBoundaryTransportCost_abs_sub_bottleneck_le_uniformBound_of_essentialParts_eq
statement:
theorem finitePBoundaryTransportCost_abs_sub_bottleneck_le_uniformBound_of_essentialParts_eq
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (D E : Diagram ℝ)
    (he : essentialPart D.points = essentialPart E.points)
    {m : ℕ}
    (hcard : Fintype.card D.finiteOccurrences + Fintype.card E.finiteOccurrences ≤ m)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hB : bottleneck D E ≤ ENNReal.ofReal R) :
    |finitePBoundaryTransportCost p (fun q : D.finiteOccurrences => q.1)
        (fun q : E.finiteOccurrences => q.1) - (bottleneck D E).toReal| ≤
      ((((max 1 m : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹) - 1) * R

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePBoundaryTransportCost_tendstoUniformlyOn_bottleneck_of_essentialParts_eq
statement:
theorem finitePBoundaryTransportCost_tendstoUniformlyOn_bottleneck_of_essentialParts_eq
    (m : ℕ) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) :
    TendstoUniformlyOn
      (fun p : ℝ => fun z : Diagram ℝ × Diagram ℝ =>
        finitePBoundaryTransportCost p (fun q : z.1.finiteOccurrences => q.1)
          (fun q : z.2.finiteOccurrences => q.1))
      (fun z : Diagram ℝ × Diagram ℝ => (bottleneck z.1 z.2).toReal) atTop
      {z : Diagram ℝ × Diagram ℝ |
        essentialPart z.1.points = essentialPart z.2.points ∧
        Fintype.card z.1.finiteOccurrences + Fintype.card z.2.finiteOccurrences ≤ m ∧
        bottleneck z.1 z.2 ≤ ENNReal.ofReal R}

theorem finitelyPresented_exists_finite_postcomp_tests
    (M : PModule.{u,v,max u w} R P)
    (hM : FinitelyPresented (R := R) (P := P) M) :
    ∃ S : Set P, S.Finite ∧
      ∀ {X Y : PModule.{u,v,max u w} R P} (ρ : X ⟶ Y),
        (∀ a ∈ S, Function.Bijective (ρ.app a)) →
          Function.Bijective (fun f : M ⟶ X => f ≫ ρ)

    (hM : FinitelyPresented (R := R) M) (hN : FinitelyPresented (R := R) N)
    (ε : ℝ≥0) :
    ∃ η : ℝ≥0, 0 < η ∧ ∀ δ : ℝ≥0, δ ≤ η →
      Function.Bijective (fun f : M ⟶ (shift ε).obj N =>
        f ≫ shiftLE (show ε ≤ ε + δ from le_self_add) N)

statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem Presentation.biprodComparison_cover
    (D E : Presentation.{u,v,w} (R := R) (P := P)) :
    (D.biprodPresentation E).cover ≫ (D.biprodComparison E).inv =
      sumDesc D.generators E.generators (D.cover ≫ biprod.inl)
        (E.cover ≫ biprod.inr)

      sumInl D.generators E.generators ≫ (D.biprodPresentation E).cover

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.cokernelComparison_cover
statement:

theorem Presentation.cokernelComparison_cover

    (f : D.presented ⟶ E.presented)
    (α : module (R := R) D.generators ⟶ module E.generators)
    (hα : α ≫ E.cover = D.cover ≫ f) :
    (D.cokernelPresentation E α).cover ≫
        (D.cokernelComparison E f α hα).inv = E.cover ≫ Limits.cokernel.π f

    (hα : α ≫ E.cover = D.cover ≫ f) :

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePresentationColimitsExamples.arbitrary_field_rank_exact_pushout_finitelyPresented
statement:
theorem arbitrary_field_rank_exact_pushout_finitelyPresented
    {k : Type u} [Field k] :
    let D := FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation k 2
    let hs := identityQuotient_rankExact (repeatedPresentation_finitelyPresented (k := k) (n := 2))
    FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := Fin 2 → ℝ)
        (Limits.pushout
          (0 : (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin 2 → ℝ)) ⟶ D.presented)
          (0 : (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin 2 → ℝ)) ⟶ D.presented)) ∧
      IsRankExact (Limits.pushout.inr
          (0 : (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin 2 → ℝ)) ⟶ D.presented)
          (0 : (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin 2 → ℝ)) ⟶ D.presented))
        (hs.toIsPointwiseShortExact.pushoutQuotient
          (0 : (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin 2 → ℝ)) ⟶ D.presented)) ∧
      ∃ x : (Limits.pushout
        (0 : (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin 2 → ℝ)) ⟶ D.presented)
        (0 : (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin 2 → ℝ)) ⟶ D.presented)).obj
          ((FinitePresentationKanExamples.generators 2).grade (1 : Fin 2)),
        x ≠ 0

      FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := Fin n → ℝ)
        (Limits.pushout (0 : (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ)) ⟶ 0)
          (0 : (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ)) ⟶ 0))

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePresentationColimitsExamples.relation_cokernel_finitelyPresented
statement:
theorem relation_cokernel_finitelyPresented {k : Type u} [Field k] {n : ℕ} :
    (FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation k n).relationMap ≠ 0 ∧

      FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := Fin 2 → ℝ)
        (GradedFree.module (R := k) (FinitePresentationKanExamples.generators 2)) ∧
      FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := Fin 2 → ℝ)
        (Limits.pullback (FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation k 2).cover
          (FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation k 2).cover) ∧
      ∃ x : (Limits.pullback (FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation k 2).cover
          (FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation k 2).cover).obj
          ((FinitePresentationKanExamples.relations 2).grade ()),
        ((Limits.pullback.fst (FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation k 2).cover
            (FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation k 2).cover).app
            ((FinitePresentationKanExamples.relations 2).grade ())).hom x ≠
          ((Limits.pullback.snd (FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation k 2).cover
            (FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation k 2).cover).app
            ((FinitePresentationKanExamples.relations 2).grade ())).hom x
