name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHom.homCondition_finite_infinite
statement:
@[simp] theorem homCondition_finite_infinite (ab : FiniteHookDeflation.StrictPair P)
    (c : P) : ¬ HomCondition (.inl ab) (.inr c)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHom.homCondition_infinite_finite
statement:
@[simp] theorem homCondition_infinite_finite (a : P)
    (cd : FiniteHookDeflation.StrictPair P) :
    HomCondition (.inr a) (.inl cd) ↔
      cd.val.1 ≤ a ∧ ¬ cd.val.2 ≤ a

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHom.homCondition_infinite_infinite
statement:
@[simp] theorem homCondition_infinite_infinite (a b : P) :
    HomCondition (.inr a) (.inr b) ↔ b ≤ a

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHom.hom_eq_smul_normalized
statement:
theorem hom_eq_smul_normalized (s t : HookTag P) (h : HomCondition s t)
    (f : hookModule (k := k) s ⟶ hookModule (k := k) t) :
    ∃ c : k, f = c • normalizedHom (k := k) s t h

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHom.hom_eq_zero_of_not_condition
statement:
theorem hom_eq_zero_of_not_condition (s t : HookTag P) (h : ¬ HomCondition s t)
    (f : hookModule (k := k) s ⟶ hookModule (k := k) t) : f = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHom.hom_nonzero_implies_condition
statement:
theorem hom_nonzero_implies_condition (s t : HookTag P)
    (f : hookModule (k := k) s ⟶ hookModule (k := k) t) (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    HomCondition s t

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHom.hom_scalar_unique
statement:
theorem hom_scalar_unique (s t : HookTag P) (h : HomCondition s t)
    (f : hookModule (k := k) s ⟶ hookModule (k := k) t) :
    ∃! c : k, f = c • normalizedHom (k := k) s t h

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHom.normalizedHom_app_birth
statement:
@[simp] theorem normalizedHom_app_birth (s t : HookTag P) (h : HomCondition s t) :
    ((normalizedHom (k := k) s t h).app (birth s)).hom (birthUnit (k := k) s) =
      unitAt (k := k) t (birth s) h.1

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHom.normalizedHom_app_unitAt
statement:
theorem normalizedHom_app_unitAt (s t : HookTag P) (h : HomCondition s t)
    {p : P} (hp : birth s ≤ p) :
    ((normalizedHom (k := k) s t h).app p).hom
      (unitAt (k := k) s p hp) =
        unitAt (k := k) t p (h.1.trans hp)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHom.normalizedHom_comp_of_condition
statement:
theorem normalizedHom_comp_of_condition (s t u : HookTag P)
    (hst : HomCondition s t) (htu : HomCondition t u) (hsu : HomCondition s u) :
    normalizedHom (k := k) s t hst ≫ normalizedHom (k := k) t u htu =
      normalizedHom (k := k) s u hsu

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHom.normalizedHom_comp_of_diagonal
statement:
theorem normalizedHom_comp_of_diagonal (s t u : HookTag P)
    (hst : HomCondition s t) (htu : HomCondition t u)
    (hdiag : death u ≤ birth s) :
    normalizedHom (k := k) s t hst ≫ normalizedHom (k := k) t u htu = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHom.normalizedHom_comp_of_not_condition
statement:
theorem normalizedHom_comp_of_not_condition (s t u : HookTag P)
    (hst : HomCondition s t) (htu : HomCondition t u)
    (hsu : ¬ HomCondition s u) :
    normalizedHom (k := k) s t hst ≫ normalizedHom (k := k) t u htu = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHom.normalizedHom_ne_zero
statement:
theorem normalizedHom_ne_zero (s t : HookTag P) (h : HomCondition s t) :
    normalizedHom (k := k) s t h ≠ 0

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHom.unitAt_ne_zero
statement:
theorem unitAt_ne_zero (t : HookTag P) (p : P) (hp : birth t ≤ p)
    (hdeath : ¬ death t ≤ p) : unitAt (k := k) t p hp ≠ 0

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHom.unitAt_span
statement:
theorem unitAt_span (t : HookTag P) (p : P) (hp : birth t ≤ p)
    (x : (hookModule (k := k) t).obj p) :
    x = unitCoefficient (k := k) t p hp x • unitAt (k := k) t p hp

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.crossingDeltaSpan_coeff_zero_of_not_crosses
statement:
theorem crossingDeltaSpan_coeff_zero_of_not_crosses
    (f : Incidence (k := k) (S := S))
    (hf : f ∈ crossingDeltaSpan (k := k) (S := S))
    (p q : PairPoset S) (hnc : ¬ CrossesDiagonal (S := S) p q) :
    f p q = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.crossingDeltaSpan_le_diagonalIdeal
statement:
theorem crossingDeltaSpan_le_diagonalIdeal (f : Incidence (k := k) (S := S))
    (hf : f ∈ crossingDeltaSpan (k := k) (S := S)) :
    f ∈ diagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.delta_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem delta_apply (p q : PairPoset S) (hpq : p ≤ q) (x y : PairPoset S) :
    delta (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq x y = if x = p ∧ y = q then 1 else 0

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.delta_mul
statement:
theorem delta_mul (p q r s : PairPoset S) (hpq : p ≤ q) (hrs : r ≤ s) :
    delta (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq * delta (k := k) (S := S) r s hrs =
      if h : q = r then delta (k := k) (S := S) p s (by
        subst r
        exact hpq.trans hrs)
      else 0

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.diagonalGenerator_apply_eq_zero_of_not_crosses
statement:
theorem diagonalGenerator_apply_eq_zero_of_not_crosses
    (a b : Incidence (k := k) (S := S))
    (p q : PairPoset S) (hpq : p ≤ q)
    (hnc : ¬ CrossesDiagonal (S := S) p q) :
    (a * diagonalIdempotent (k := k) (S := S) * b) p q = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.diagonalIdeal_eq_incidenceToEndAlgHom_ker
statement:
theorem diagonalIdeal_eq_incidenceToEndAlgHom_ker :
    diagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S) =
      RingHom.ker (incidenceToEndAlgHom (k := k) (S := S))

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.diagonalIdeal_isTwoSided
statement:
theorem diagonalIdeal_isTwoSided :
    (diagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S)).IsTwoSided

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.diagonalIdeal_le_crossingDeltaSpan
statement:
theorem diagonalIdeal_le_crossingDeltaSpan (f : Incidence (k := k) (S := S))
    (hf : f ∈ diagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S)) :
    f ∈ crossingDeltaSpan (k := k) (S := S)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.diagonalIdeal_le_incidenceToEndAlgHom_ker
statement:
theorem diagonalIdeal_le_incidenceToEndAlgHom_ker :
    diagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S) ≤
      RingHom.ker (incidenceToEndAlgHom (k := k) (S := S))

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.diagonalIdeal_mem_delta_of_cross
statement:
theorem diagonalIdeal_mem_delta_of_cross (p q : PairPoset S)
    (hpq : p ≤ q) (hcross : CrossesDiagonal (S := S) p q) :
    delta (k := k) p q hpq ∈ diagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.diagonalIdempotent_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem diagonalIdempotent_apply (x y : PairPoset S) :
    diagonalIdempotent (k := k) (S := S) x y =
      if x = y ∧ IsDiagonal x then 1 else 0

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.diagonalIdempotent_mul_self
statement:
theorem diagonalIdempotent_mul_self :
    diagonalIdempotent (k := k) (S := S) *
        diagonalIdempotent (k := k) (S := S) =
      diagonalIdempotent (k := k) (S := S)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.diagonal_between_iff_crosses
statement:
theorem diagonal_between_iff_crosses (p q : PairPoset S) (hpq : p ≤ q) :
    (∃ d : PairPoset S, IsDiagonal (S := S) d ∧ p ≤ d ∧ d ≤ q) ↔
      CrossesDiagonal (S := S) p q

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.homCondition_iff_pairRel
statement:
theorem homCondition_iff_pairRel (s t : HookTag (S := S)) :
    HomCondition (P := S) s t ↔
      tagPoint (S := S) t ≤ tagPoint (S := S) s ∧
        ¬ (tagPoint (S := S) t).val.2 ≤ (tagPoint (S := S) s).val.1

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.hookEndAlgEquivIncidenceQuotient_symm_mk_delta
statement:
@[simp] theorem hookEndAlgEquivIncidenceQuotient_symm_mk_delta
    (p q : PairPoset S) (hpq : p ≤ q) :
    (hookEndAlgEquivIncidenceQuotient (k := k) (S := S)).symm
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (diagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S))
          (delta (k := k) p q hpq)) =
      if h : CrossesDiagonal (S := S) p q then 0 else
        hookMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S)
          (strictTag (S := S) (noCrossSourceVertex (S := S) p q hpq h))
          (strictTag (S := S) (noCrossTargetVertex (S := S) p q hpq h))
          (noCrossHomCondition (S := S) p q hpq h)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.hookMatrixUnit_comp
statement:
theorem hookMatrixUnit_comp (s t u : HookTag (S := S))
    (hst : HomCondition (P := S) s t) (htu : HomCondition (P := S) t u)
    (hsu : HomCondition (P := S) s u) :
    hookMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) s t hst ≫
      hookMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) t u htu =
      hookMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) s u hsu

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.hookMatrixUnit_comp_of_middle_eq
statement:
theorem hookMatrixUnit_comp_of_middle_eq (s t r u : HookTag (S := S))
    (hst : HomCondition (P := S) s t) (hru : HomCondition (P := S) r u)
    (htr : t = r) (hsu : HomCondition (P := S) s u) :
    hookMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) s t hst ≫
      hookMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) r u hru =
        hookMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) s u hsu

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.hookMatrixUnit_comp_of_middle_eq_not_condition
statement:
theorem hookMatrixUnit_comp_of_middle_eq_not_condition
    (s t r u : HookTag (S := S))
    (hst : HomCondition (P := S) s t) (hru : HomCondition (P := S) r u)
    (htr : t = r) (hsu : ¬ HomCondition (P := S) s u) :
    hookMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) s t hst ≫
      hookMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) r u hru = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.hookMatrixUnit_comp_of_ne
statement:
theorem hookMatrixUnit_comp_of_ne (s t r u : HookTag (S := S))
    (hst : HomCondition (P := S) s t) (hru : HomCondition (P := S) r u)
    (htr : t ≠ r) :
    hookMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) s t hst ≫
      hookMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) r u hru = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.hookMatrixUnit_comp_of_not_condition
statement:
theorem hookMatrixUnit_comp_of_not_condition (s t u : HookTag (S := S))
    (hst : HomCondition (P := S) s t) (htu : HomCondition (P := S) t u)
    (hsu : ¬ HomCondition (P := S) s u) :
    hookMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) s t hst ≫
      hookMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) t u htu = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.hookMatrixUnit_components_zero_of_left_ne
statement:
@[simp] theorem hookMatrixUnit_components_zero_of_left_ne
    (s t : HookTag (S := S)) (h : HomCondition (P := S) s t)
    (a b : HookTag (S := S)) (ha : a ≠ s) :
    biproduct.components (hookMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) s t h) a b = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.hookMatrixUnit_components_zero_of_right_ne
statement:
@[simp] theorem hookMatrixUnit_components_zero_of_right_ne
    (s t : HookTag (S := S)) (h : HomCondition (P := S) s t)
    (a b : HookTag (S := S)) (hb : b ≠ t) :
    biproduct.components (hookMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) s t h) a b = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.hookMatrixUnit_diagonal_components
statement:
@[simp] theorem hookMatrixUnit_diagonal_components (s t : HookTag (S := S))
    (h : HomCondition (P := S) s t) :
    biproduct.components (hookMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) s t h) s t =
      normalizedHom (k := k) s t h

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.incidenceToEndAlgHom_diagonalIdempotent_eq_zero
statement:
theorem incidenceToEndAlgHom_diagonalIdempotent_eq_zero :
    incidenceToEndAlgHom (k := k) (S := S)
        (diagonalIdempotent (k := k) (S := S)) = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.incidenceToEndAlgHom_ker_le_diagonalIdeal
statement:
theorem incidenceToEndAlgHom_ker_le_diagonalIdeal :
    RingHom.ker (incidenceToEndAlgHom (k := k) (S := S)) ≤
      diagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.incidenceToEndAlgHom_kernel_coefficient_zero
statement:
theorem incidenceToEndAlgHom_kernel_coefficient_zero
    (f : Incidence (k := k) (S := S))
    (hker : incidenceToEndAlgHom (k := k) (S := S) f = 0)
    (p q : PairPoset S) (hpq : p ≤ q)
    (hcross : ¬ CrossesDiagonal (S := S) p q) :
    f p q = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.incidenceToEndAlgHom_surjective
statement:
theorem incidenceToEndAlgHom_surjective :
    Function.Surjective (incidenceToEndAlgHom (k := k) (S := S))

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.incidenceToEndLinear_components
statement:
@[simp] theorem incidenceToEndLinear_components
    (f : Incidence (k := k) (S := S)) (s t : HookTag (S := S)) :
    biproduct.components (incidenceToEndLinear (k := k) (S := S) f) s t =
      incidenceComponent (k := k) (S := S) f s t

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.incidenceToEndLinear_map_mul
statement:
theorem incidenceToEndLinear_map_mul (f g : Incidence (k := k) (S := S)) :
    incidenceToEndLinear (k := k) (S := S) (f * g) =
      incidenceToEndLinear (k := k) (S := S) f *
        incidenceToEndLinear (k := k) (S := S) g

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.incidenceToEndLinear_map_mul_delta
statement:
theorem incidenceToEndLinear_map_mul_delta
    (p q r s : PairPoset S) (hpq : p ≤ q) (hrs : r ≤ s) :
    incidenceToEndLinear (k := k) (S := S)
        (delta (k := k) p q hpq * delta (k := k) r s hrs) =
      incidenceToEndLinear (k := k) (S := S) (delta (k := k) p q hpq) *
        incidenceToEndLinear (k := k) (S := S) (delta (k := k) r s hrs)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.incidenceToEndLinear_map_one
statement:
theorem incidenceToEndLinear_map_one :
    incidenceToEndLinear (k := k) (S := S) (1 : Incidence (k := k) (S := S)) =
      1

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.incidenceToEnd_delta_cases
statement:
theorem incidenceToEnd_delta_cases (p q : PairPoset S) (hpq : p ≤ q) :
    incidenceToEndLinear (k := k) (S := S) (delta (k := k) p q hpq) =
      if h : CrossesDiagonal (S := S) p q then 0 else
        hookMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S)
          (strictTag (S := S) (noCrossSourceVertex (S := S) p q hpq h))
          (strictTag (S := S) (noCrossTargetVertex (S := S) p q hpq h))
          (noCrossHomCondition (S := S) p q hpq h)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.incidenceToEnd_delta_of_cross
statement:
theorem incidenceToEnd_delta_of_cross
    (p q : PairPoset S) (hpq : p ≤ q)
    (hcross : CrossesDiagonal (S := S) p q) :
    incidenceToEndLinear (k := k) (S := S) (delta (k := k) p q hpq) = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.incidenceToEnd_delta_of_no_cross
statement:
theorem incidenceToEnd_delta_of_no_cross
    (p q : StrictVertex S) (hpq : p.val ≤ q.val)
    (hcross : ¬ CrossesDiagonal (S := S) p.val q.val) :
    incidenceToEndLinear (k := k) (S := S)
        (delta (k := k) p.val q.val hpq) =
      hookMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) (strictTag (S := S) q)
        (strictTag (S := S) p)
        ((homCondition_iff_pairRel (S := S)
          (strictTag (S := S) q) (strictTag (S := S) p)).2
          ⟨by simpa [tagPoint_strictTag] using hpq, by
            simpa [CrossesDiagonal, tagPoint_strictTag] using hcross⟩)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.incidenceToEnd_delta_of_no_cross_pair
statement:
theorem incidenceToEnd_delta_of_no_cross_pair
    (p q : PairPoset S) (hpq : p ≤ q)
    (hcross : ¬ CrossesDiagonal (S := S) p q) :
    incidenceToEndLinear (k := k) (S := S) (delta (k := k) p q hpq) =
      hookMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S)
        (strictTag (S := S) (noCrossSourceVertex (S := S) p q hpq hcross))
        (strictTag (S := S) (noCrossTargetVertex (S := S) p q hpq hcross))
        (noCrossHomCondition (S := S) p q hpq hcross)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.incidence_eq_deltaExpansion
statement:
theorem incidence_eq_deltaExpansion (f : Incidence (k := k) (S := S)) :
    f = deltaExpansion (k := k) (S := S) f

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.left_strict_of_not_crosses
statement:
theorem left_strict_of_not_crosses (p q : PairPoset S) (hpq : p ≤ q)
    (h : ¬ CrossesDiagonal (S := S) p q) : p.val.1 < p.val.2

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.mem_diagonalIdeal_iff_mem_crossingDeltaSpan
statement:
theorem mem_diagonalIdeal_iff_mem_crossingDeltaSpan
    (f : Incidence (k := k) (S := S)) :
    f ∈ diagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S) ↔
      f ∈ crossingDeltaSpan (k := k) (S := S)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.normalizedHom_self
statement:
theorem normalizedHom_self (s : HookTag (S := S))
    (h : HomCondition (P := S) s s) :
    normalizedHom (k := k) s s h = 𝟙 (hookModule (k := k) s)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.right_strict_of_not_crosses
statement:
theorem right_strict_of_not_crosses (p q : PairPoset S) (hpq : p ≤ q)
    (h : ¬ CrossesDiagonal (S := S) p q) : q.val.1 < q.val.2

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.tagPoint_eq_strictTag_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem tagPoint_eq_strictTag_iff (t : HookTag (S := S))
    (p : StrictVertex S) :
    tagPoint (S := S) t = p.val ↔ t = strictTag (S := S) p

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.tagPoint_strict
statement:
@[simp] theorem tagPoint_strict
    (t : FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.RankProjectiveHookTag S) :
    (tagPoint t).val.1 < (tagPoint t).val.2

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.tagPoint_strictTag
statement:
@[simp] theorem tagPoint_strictTag (p : StrictVertex S) :
    tagPoint (strictTag (S := S) p) = p.val

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveDiagonalIdealProjective.assembleColumns_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem assembleColumns_apply
    (g : ColumnModule (k := k) (S := S)) (p q : PairPoset S) :
    (assembleColumns (k := k) (S := S) g).1 p q =
      g q p (diagonalFloor (S := S) q)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveDiagonalIdealProjective.assembleColumns_comp_includeColumns
statement:
theorem assembleColumns_comp_includeColumns :
    (assembleColumns (k := k) (S := S)).comp
      (includeColumns (k := k) (S := S)) = LinearMap.id

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveDiagonalIdealProjective.assembleColumns_eq_sum_mul_delta
statement:
theorem assembleColumns_eq_sum_mul_delta
    (g : ColumnModule (k := k) (S := S)) :
    (assembleColumns (k := k) (S := S) g).1 =
      ∑ q : PairPoset S,
        g q * delta (k := k) (S := S) (diagonalFloor (S := S) q) q
          (diagonalFloor_le (S := S) q)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveDiagonalIdealProjective.columnModule_projective
statement:
theorem columnModule_projective :
    Module.Projective (Incidence (k := k) (S := S))
      (ColumnModule (k := k) (S := S))

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveDiagonalIdealProjective.diagonalFloor_fst
statement:
@[simp] theorem diagonalFloor_fst (q : PairPoset S) :
    (diagonalFloor (S := S) q).val.1 = q.val.1

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveDiagonalIdealProjective.diagonalFloor_isDiagonal
statement:
theorem diagonalFloor_isDiagonal (q : PairPoset S) :
    IsDiagonal (S := S) (diagonalFloor (S := S) q)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveDiagonalIdealProjective.diagonalFloor_le
statement: theorem diagonalFloor_le (q : PairPoset S) : diagonalFloor (S := S) q ≤ q

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveDiagonalIdealProjective.diagonalFloor_snd
statement:
@[simp] theorem diagonalFloor_snd (q : PairPoset S) :
    (diagonalFloor (S := S) q).val.2 = q.val.1

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveDiagonalIdealProjective.diagonalIdeal_coeff_zero_of_not_crosses
statement:
theorem diagonalIdeal_coeff_zero_of_not_crosses
    (f : DiagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S)) (p q : PairPoset S)
    (h : ¬ CrossesDiagonal (S := S) p q) : f.1 p q = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveDiagonalIdealProjective.diagonalIdeal_projective
statement:
theorem diagonalIdeal_projective :
    Module.Projective (Incidence (k := k) (S := S))
      (DiagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S))

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveDiagonalIdealProjective.diagonalIdeal_projective_object
statement:
theorem diagonalIdeal_projective_object :
    CategoryTheory.Projective
      (ModuleCat.of (Incidence (k := k) (S := S))
        (DiagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S)))

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveDiagonalIdealProjective.includeColumns_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem includeColumns_apply
    (f : DiagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S)) (q p t : PairPoset S) :
    includeColumns (k := k) (S := S) f q p t =
      if t = diagonalFloor (S := S) q then f.1 p q else 0

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveDiagonalIdealProjective.includeColumns_mul_diagonalFloorIdempotent
statement:
theorem includeColumns_mul_diagonalFloorIdempotent
    (f : DiagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S)) (q : PairPoset S) :
    includeColumns (k := k) (S := S) f q *
        delta (k := k) (S := S) (diagonalFloor (S := S) q)
          (diagonalFloor (S := S) q) le_rfl =

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveDiagonalIdealProjective.mem_diagonalIdeal_iff_coeff_zero_of_not_crosses

    postcompose (k := k) (S := S) (preimage M N T) = T

theorem preimage_app (M N : PModule.{u,0,u} k S)

      (L (k := k) (S := S) ⟶ N)) (a : S) (x : M.obj a) :
    ((preimage M N T).app a).hom x =
      (((inclusion (k := k) (S := S) a ≫ T (encode M a x)).app a).hom

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.Hom.comp_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem comp_app (F : Hom A B) (G : Hom B C) (i : Fin N) :
    (F.comp G).app i = G.app i * F.app i

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.Hom.comp_assoc
statement:
theorem comp_assoc {D : MatrixSequence R N} (F : Hom A B) (G : Hom B C) (H : Hom C D) :
    (F.comp G).comp H = F.comp (G.comp H)

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.Hom.comp_id
statement: @[simp] theorem comp_id (F : Hom A B) : F.comp (id B) = F

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.Hom.compositeMatrix_comm
statement:
theorem compositeMatrix_comm (F : Hom A B) {i j : Fin N} (h : i ≤ j) :
    B.compositeMatrix h * F.app i = F.app j * A.compositeMatrix h

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.Hom.ext
statement: @[ext] theorem ext {F G : Hom A B} (h : ∀ i, F.app i = G.app i) : F = G

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.Hom.id_app
statement: @[simp] theorem id_app (A : MatrixSequence R N) (i : Fin N) : (id A).app i = 1

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.Hom.id_comp
statement: @[simp] theorem id_comp (F : Hom A B) : (id A).comp F = F

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.Hom.toNatTrans_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem toNatTrans_app (F : Hom A B) (i : Fin N) :
    (F.toNatTrans.app i).hom = (F.app i).toLin'

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.Hom.toNatTrans_comp
statement:
@[simp] theorem toNatTrans_comp (F : Hom A B) (G : Hom B C) :
    (F.comp G).toNatTrans = F.toNatTrans ≫ G.toNatTrans

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.Hom.toNatTrans_id
statement:
@[simp] theorem toNatTrans_id (A : MatrixSequence R N) :
    (id A).toNatTrans = 𝟙 A.toPModule

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.barcode_basisChange
statement:
theorem barcode_basisChange (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin N)) (d e : Fin N → ℕ)
    (b : ∀ i, Basis (Fin (d i)) k (M.obj i))
    (c : ∀ i, Basis (Fin (e i)) k (M.obj i)) :
    (ofBases M d b).barcode = (ofBases M e c).barcode

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.barcode_eq_of_linearEquiv
statement:
theorem barcode_eq_of_linearEquiv (A B : MatrixSequence k N)
    (e : ∀ i, (Fin (A.dim i) → k) ≃ₗ[k] (Fin (B.dim i) → k))
    (he : ∀ i j (h : i.val + 1 = j.val),
      (e j).toLinearMap.comp (A.step i j h).toLin' =
        (B.step i j h).toLin'.comp (e i).toLinearMap) : A.barcode = B.barcode

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.barcode_ofBases
statement:
theorem barcode_ofBases (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin N))
    [∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj i)] (d : Fin N → ℕ)
    (b : ∀ i, Basis (Fin (d i)) k (M.obj i)) :
    (ofBases M d b).barcode = rankBarcode M

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.basisChangeIso_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem basisChangeIso_hom_app (M : PModule.{u,0,u} R (Fin N)) (d e : Fin N → ℕ)
    (b : ∀ i, Basis (Fin (d i)) R (M.obj i))
    (c : ∀ i, Basis (Fin (e i)) R (M.obj i)) (i : Fin N) :
    ((basisChangeIso M d e b c).hom.app i).hom =
      (c i).equivFun.toLinearMap.comp (b i).equivFun.symm.toLinearMap

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.compositeMatrix_adjacent
statement:
@[simp] theorem compositeMatrix_adjacent (A : MatrixSequence R N)
    (i j : Fin N) (h : i.val + 1 = j.val) :
    A.compositeMatrix (show i ≤ j by omega) = A.step i j h

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.compositeMatrix_comp
TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.compositeMatrix_self
statement:
@[simp] theorem compositeMatrix_self (A : MatrixSequence R N) (i : Fin N) :
    A.compositeMatrix (le_refl i) = 1

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.compositeMatrix_succ
statement:
theorem compositeMatrix_succ (A : MatrixSequence R N) {i j l : Fin N}
    (hij : i ≤ j) (hjl : j.val + 1 = l.val) :
    A.compositeMatrix (hij.trans (show j ≤ l by omega)) =
      A.step j l hjl * A.compositeMatrix hij

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.coordinateHom_standard_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem coordinateHom_standard_app {A B : MatrixSequence R N} (F : Hom A B)
    (i : Fin N) :
    (coordinateHom F.toNatTrans A.dim B.dim
      (fun j => Pi.basisFun R (Fin (A.dim j)))
      (fun j => Pi.basisFun R (Fin (B.dim j)))).app i = F.app i

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.coordinateHom_toNatTrans
statement:
theorem coordinateHom_toNatTrans {M L : PModule.{u,0,u} R (Fin N)} (α : M ⟶ L)
    (d e : Fin N → ℕ) (b : ∀ i, Basis (Fin (d i)) R (M.obj i))
    (c : ∀ i, Basis (Fin (e i)) R (L.obj i)) :
    (coordinateHom α d e b c).toNatTrans =
      (coordinateIso M d b).inv ≫ α ≫ (coordinateIso L e c).hom

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.coordinateIso_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem coordinateIso_hom_app (M : PModule.{u,0,u} R (Fin N)) (d : Fin N → ℕ)
    (b : ∀ i, Basis (Fin (d i)) R (M.obj i)) (i : Fin N) :
    ((coordinateIso M d b).hom.app i).hom = (b i).equivFun.toLinearMap

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.coordinateIso_inv_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem coordinateIso_inv_app (M : PModule.{u,0,u} R (Fin N)) (d : Fin N → ℕ)
    (b : ∀ i, Basis (Fin (d i)) R (M.obj i)) (i : Fin N) :
    ((coordinateIso M d b).inv.app i).hom = (b i).equivFun.symm.toLinearMap

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.coordinateIso_naturality
statement:
theorem coordinateIso_naturality (M : PModule.{u,0,u} R (Fin N)) (d : Fin N → ℕ)
    (b : ∀ i, Basis (Fin (d i)) R (M.obj i)) {i j : Fin N} (h : i ≤ j) :
    (b j).equivFun.toLinearMap.comp (structureMapLinear M h) =
      (structureMapLinear (ofBases M d b).toPModule h).comp (b i).equivFun.toLinearMap

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.ofBases_dim
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofBases_dim (M : PModule.{u,0,u} R (Fin N)) (d : Fin N → ℕ)
    (b : ∀ i, Basis (Fin (d i)) R (M.obj i)) (i : Fin N) :
    (ofBases M d b).dim i = d i

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.ofBases_standard
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofBases_standard (A : MatrixSequence R N) :
    ofBases A.toPModule A.dim (fun i => Pi.basisFun R (Fin (A.dim i))) = A

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.ofBases_step
statement:
theorem ofBases_step (M : PModule.{u,0,u} R (Fin N)) (d : Fin N → ℕ)
    (b : ∀ i, Basis (Fin (d i)) R (M.obj i)) (i j : Fin N)
    (h : i.val + 1 = j.val) :
    (ofBases M d b).step i j h =
      LinearMap.toMatrix (b i) (b j) (structureMapLinear M (show i ≤ j by omega))

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.ofBases_step_toLin
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofBases_step_toLin (M : PModule.{u,0,u} R (Fin N)) (d : Fin N → ℕ)
    (b : ∀ i, Basis (Fin (d i)) R (M.obj i)) (i j : Fin N)
    (h : i.val + 1 = j.val) :
    ((ofBases M d b).step i j h).toLin' =
      (b j).equivFun.toLinearMap.comp ((structureMapLinear M (show i ≤ j by omega)).comp
        (b i).equivFun.symm.toLinearMap)

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.structureMapLinear_adjacent
statement:
@[simp] theorem structureMapLinear_adjacent (A : MatrixSequence R N)
    (i j : Fin N) (h : i.val + 1 = j.val) :
    structureMapLinear A.toPModule (show i ≤ j by omega) = (A.step i j h).toLin'

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.structureMapLinear_apply
TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.toLin_compositeMatrix
statement:
@[simp] theorem toLin_compositeMatrix (A : MatrixSequence R N) {i j : Fin N} (h : i ≤ j) :
    (A.compositeMatrix h).toLin' = structureMapLinear A.toPModule h

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.toPModule_obj
statement:
@[simp] theorem toPModule_obj (A : MatrixSequence R N) (i : Fin N) :

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.kernel_eq_gaussian
statement:
theorem kernel_eq_gaussian (σ : ℝ) (p q : ℝ × ℝ) :
    kernel σ p q =
      Real.exp (-‖WithLp.toLp 2 p - WithLp.toLp 2 q‖ ^ 2 / (2 * σ ^ 2))

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.kernel_pos

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.kernel_self

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.kernel_symm
statement: theorem kernel_symm (σ : ℝ) (p q : ℝ × ℝ) : kernel σ p q = kernel σ q p

theorem posSemidef_innerKernel {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.posSemidef_kernel

theorem posSemidef_kernel (σ : ℝ) :

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.posSemidef_kernel_family

theorem posSemidef_kernel_family {I : Type*} (σ : ℝ) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) :

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.posSemidef_map_exp
statement:
theorem posSemidef_map_exp {M : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hM : M.PosSemidef) :

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.posSemidef_map_pow
statement:
theorem posSemidef_map_pow {M : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hM : M.PosSemidef) :

  | 0 => by

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.gaussianKernelOp_apply
statement:
theorem gaussianKernelOp_apply (τ : ℝ) (a b : E) (t : ℝ) :

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.norm_sub_le_of_inner_eq_gaussian
statement:
theorem norm_sub_le_of_inner_eq_gaussian {u v : H} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    {r s : ℝ} (huv : ⟪u, v⟫_ℝ = Real.exp (-r ^ 2 / (2 * s ^ 2))) :
    ‖u - v‖ ≤ |r| / |s|

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.norm_sub_sq_eq_of_inner_eq_gaussian
statement:
theorem norm_sub_sq_eq_of_inner_eq_gaussian {u v : H} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    {r s : ℝ} (huv : ⟪u, v⟫_ℝ = Real.exp (-r ^ 2 / (2 * s ^ 2))) :
    ‖u - v‖ ^ 2 = 2 - 2 * Real.exp (-r ^ 2 / (2 * s ^ 2))

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.two_sub_two_mul_exp_le
statement:
theorem two_sub_two_mul_exp_le (r s : ℝ) :

name: TDA.Persistence.GaussianKernel.density1D_formula
statement:
theorem density1D_formula {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (u x : ℝ) :

      Real.exp (-(x - u) ^ 2 / (2 * σ ^ 2))

name: TDA.Persistence.GaussianKernel.integral_abs_density1D_sub_le

        (show p ≤ (fun i => p i + δ) from fun _i => le_add_of_nonneg_right hδ) = 0) ↔

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleFamily.component_composite
statement:
theorem component_composite {ι κ ν : Type}
    [Finite ι] [Fintype κ] [Finite ν]
    (R : ι → Rectangle n) (S : κ → Rectangle n) (T : ν → Rectangle n)
    (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (f : module (k := k) R ⟶ (shift ε).obj (module S))
    (g : module (k := k) S ⟶ (shift ε).obj (module T))
    (i : ι) (i' : ν) :
    ∑ j : κ, component (k := k) R S ε f i j ≫
        (shift ε).map (component (k := k) S T ε g j i') =
      inclusion (k := k) R i ≫ f ≫ (shift ε).map g ≫
        (shift ε).map ((shift ε).map (projection (k := k) T i'))

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleFamily.component_interleaving_sum
statement:
theorem component_interleaving_sum {ι κ : Type}
    [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (R : ι → Rectangle n) (S : κ → Rectangle n) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (I : CoordinateInterleaving ε (module (k := k) R) (module S))
    (i i' : ι) :
    (∑ j : κ, component (k := k) R S ε I.φ i j ≫
      (shift ε).map (component S R ε I.ψ j i')) ≫
        (compIso ε ε ((R i').module (k := k))).hom =
      inclusion (k := k) R i ≫ transition (ε + ε) (module R) ≫
        (shift (ε + ε)).map (projection R i')

    {i i' : ι} (h : i ≠ i') :

      (shift ε).map (component S R ε I.ψ j i')) ≫

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleHall.component_sum_neighbors
statement:
theorem component_sum_neighbors {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    {k : Type*} [Field k] {ι κ : Type} [Finite ι] [Fintype κ]
    (R : ι → Rectangle n) (S : κ → Rectangle n) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (f : RectangleFamily.module (k := k) R ⟶
      (shift ε).obj (RectangleFamily.module S))
    (g : RectangleFamily.module (k := k) S ⟶
      (shift ε).obj (RectangleFamily.module R))
    (A : Finset ι) {i i' : ι} (hi : i ∈ A) (hi' : i' ∈ A)
    (hα : RectangleStabilityGeometry.alphaLE (R i) (R i')) :
    ∑ j ∈ neighbors (k := k) R S A (RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε),
      RectangleFamily.component R S ε f i j ≫
        (shift ε).map (RectangleFamily.component S R ε g j i') =
      ∑ j : κ, RectangleFamily.component R S ε f i j ≫
        (shift ε).map (RectangleFamily.component S R ε g j i')

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleHall.composite_ne_zero_of_significant
statement:
theorem composite_ne_zero_of_significant {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleHall.shiftedCoefficient_composite
statement:
theorem shiftedCoefficient_composite {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    {k : Type*} [Field k] (R S T : Rectangle n) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (hRT : RectangleStabilityGeometry.alphaLE R T)
    (hR : ∃ p, p ∈ R.support ∧
      translation (RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε +
        RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε) p ∈ R.support)
    (hT : ∃ p, p ∈ T.support ∧
      translation (RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε +
        RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε) p ∈ T.support)
    (f : R.module (k := k) ⟶ (shift ε).obj S.module)
    (g : S.module (k := k) ⟶ (shift ε).obj T.module) :
    shiftedCoefficient R T (ε + ε)

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleHall.shiftedCoefficient_eq_at

name: TDA.Persistence.HookMatching.component_composite
statement:
theorem component_composite {m ℓ q : ℕ}
    (F : Fin m → RealHookTag (n := n)) (G : Fin ℓ → RealHookTag (n := n))
    (H : Fin q → RealHookTag (n := n)) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (f : familyModule (k := k) F ⟶ (shift ε).obj (familyModule (k := k) G))
    (g : familyModule (k := k) G ⟶ (shift ε).obj (familyModule (k := k) H))
    (i : Fin m) (l : Fin q) :
    ∑ j : Fin ℓ, component (k := k) F G ε f i j ≫
      (shift ε).map (component (k := k) G H ε g j l) =
      inclusion (k := k) F i ≫ f ≫ (shift ε).map g ≫
        (shift ε).map ((shift ε).map (projection (k := k) H l))

name: TDA.Persistence.HookMatching.component_interleaving_sum
statement:
theorem component_interleaving_sum {m ℓ : ℕ}
    (F : Fin m → RealHookTag (n := n)) (G : Fin ℓ → RealHookTag (n := n))
    (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (I : CoordinateInterleaving ε (familyModule (k := k) F)
      (familyModule (k := k) G)) (i i' : Fin m) :
    (∑ j : Fin ℓ, component (k := k) F G ε I.φ i j ≫
      (shift ε).map (component (k := k) G F ε I.ψ j i')) ≫
        (compIso ε ε (tagModule (k := k) (F i'))).hom =
      inclusion (k := k) F i ≫ transition (ε + ε) (familyModule (k := k) F) ≫
        (shift (ε + ε)).map (projection (k := k) F i')

name: TDA.Persistence.HookMatching.component_interleaving_sum_ne

name: TDA.Persistence.HookMatching.component_interleaving_sum_self

statement:

      (CoordinateShift.shift ε).obj (Hook.module (k := k) c d)) :

name: TDA.Persistence.HookMatching.finiteHookCoefficient_composite_at
statement:
theorem finiteHookCoefficient_composite_at {a b c d e f p : Fin n → ℝ}

    (u : Hook.module (k := k) a b ⟶

      (CoordinateShift.shift ε).obj (Hook.module (k := k) e f))

    (hpB : CoordinateShift.translation ε p ∈ Hook.support c d)
    (hpC : CoordinateShift.translation (ε + ε) p ∈ Hook.support e f) :
    finiteHookCoefficient (k := k) hab (ε + ε)
      (u ≫ (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map v ≫
        (CoordinateShift.compIso ε ε (Hook.module (k := k) e f)).hom) =

    (v : Hook.module (k := k) c d ⟶

statement:
theorem finiteHook_endpoint_close_interleaving {a b c d : Fin n → ℝ}

    (hca : ∀ i, c i ≤ a i + (ρ : ℝ))
    (hdb : ∀ i, d i ≤ b i + (ρ : ℝ))
    (hac : ∀ i, a i ≤ c i + (ρ : ℝ))
    (hbd : ∀ i, b i ≤ d i + (ρ : ℝ)) :
    Nonempty (CoordinateInterleaving ρ
      (Hook.module (k := k) a b) (Hook.module (k := k) c d))

name: TDA.Persistence.HookMatching.finiteHook_map_birth_active
statement:
theorem finiteHook_map_birth_active {a b c d : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hab : a < b) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (f : Hook.module (k := k) a b ⟶
      (CoordinateShift.shift ε).obj (Hook.module (k := k) c d))
    (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    CoordinateShift.translation ε a ∈ Hook.support c d

name: TDA.Persistence.HookMatching.finiteHook_map_birth_value_ne_zero
statement:
theorem finiteHook_map_birth_value_ne_zero {a b c d : Fin n → ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (f : Hook.module (k := k) a b ⟶
      (CoordinateShift.shift ε).obj (Hook.module (k := k) c d)) (hf : f ≠ 0) :

      (Hook.birth_mem hab)) ≠ 0

name: TDA.Persistence.HookMatching.finiteHook_map_component_ne_zero
statement:
theorem finiteHook_map_component_ne_zero {a b c d p : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hab : a < b) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (f : Hook.module (k := k) a b ⟶
      (CoordinateShift.shift ε).obj (Hook.module (k := k) c d))
    (hf : f ≠ 0) (hap : a ≤ p) (hp : p ∈ Hook.support a b)
    (hpT : CoordinateShift.translation ε p ∈ Hook.support c d) :
    (f.app p).hom (SupportInterval.one (Hook.support a b) hp) ≠ 0

name: TDA.Persistence.HookMatching.finiteHook_support_transition_iff
statement:
theorem finiteHook_support_transition_iff (δ : ℝ≥0)
    (ab : FiniteHookTag (n := n)) :
    (∃ p : Fin n → ℝ, p ∈ Hook.support ab.val.1 ab.val.2 ∧
      CoordinateShift.translation δ p ∈ Hook.support ab.val.1 ab.val.2) ↔
        finiteSignificant δ ab

name: TDA.Persistence.HookMatching.finiteHook_to_principal_zero
statement:
theorem finiteHook_to_principal_zero {a b c : Fin n → ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (f : Hook.module (k := k) a b ⟶
      (CoordinateShift.shift ε).obj (HookInfinity.module (R := k) c)) :
    f = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.HookMatching.finiteInterleaved_zero_iff
statement:
theorem finiteInterleaved_zero_iff (ab : FiniteHookTag (n := n)) (ρ : ℝ≥0) :
    Nonempty (CoordinateInterleaving ρ
      (Hook.module (k := k) ab.val.1 ab.val.2) 0) ↔
        ¬ finiteSignificant (ρ + ρ) ab

name: TDA.Persistence.HookMatching.finiteSignificant_iff_transition_ne_zero
statement:
theorem finiteSignificant_iff_transition_ne_zero (δ : ℝ≥0)
    (ab : FiniteHookTag (n := n)) :
    finiteSignificant δ ab ↔
      CoordinateShift.transition δ
        (Hook.module (k := k) ab.val.1 ab.val.2) ≠ 0

name: TDA.Persistence.HookMatching.finite_endpoint_reverse_bounds
statement:
theorem finite_endpoint_reverse_bounds (hn : 0 < n) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    {a b c d : Fin n → ℝ} (hα :
      (∑ i, a i) + (∑ i, b i) ≤ (∑ i, c i) + (∑ i, d i))
    (hca : ∀ i, c i ≤ a i + (ε : ℝ))
    (hdb : ∀ i, d i ≤ b i + (ε : ℝ)) :
    (∀ i, a i ≤ c i + (2 * (n : ℝ) - 1) * (ε : ℝ)) ∧
      (∀ i, b i ≤ d i + (2 * (n : ℝ) - 1) * (ε : ℝ))

name: TDA.Persistence.HookMatching.finite_hook_path_endpoint_close
statement:
theorem finite_hook_path_endpoint_close (hn : 0 < n) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    {a b c d e f : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hRT : (∑ i, a i) + (∑ i, b i) ≤ (∑ i, e i) + (∑ i, f i))
    (hRS₁ : ∀ i, c i ≤ a i + (ε : ℝ))
    (hRS₂ : ∀ i, d i ≤ b i + (ε : ℝ))
    (hST₁ : ∀ i, e i ≤ c i + (ε : ℝ))
    (hST₂ : ∀ i, f i ≤ d i + (ε : ℝ)) :
    FiniteEndpointClose ((2 * (n : ℝ) - 1) * (ε : ℝ)) a b c d ∨
      FiniteEndpointClose ((2 * (n : ℝ) - 1) * (ε : ℝ)) c d e f

name: TDA.Persistence.HookMatching.finite_hook_path_endpoint_close_of_maps
statement:
theorem finite_hook_path_endpoint_close_of_maps (hn : 0 < n) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    {a b c d e f : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hRT : (∑ i, a i) + (∑ i, b i) ≤ (∑ i, e i) + (∑ i, f i))
    (hab : a < b)
    (u : Hook.module (k := k) a b ⟶
      (CoordinateShift.shift ε).obj (Hook.module (k := k) c d)) (hu : u ≠ 0)
    (hcd : c < d)
    (v : Hook.module (k := k) c d ⟶
      (CoordinateShift.shift ε).obj (Hook.module (k := k) e f)) (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    FiniteEndpointClose ((2 * (n : ℝ) - 1) * (ε : ℝ)) a b c d ∨
      FiniteEndpointClose ((2 * (n : ℝ) - 1) * (ε : ℝ)) c d e f

name: TDA.Persistence.HookMatching.finite_hook_path_neighbor_of_maps
statement:
theorem finite_hook_path_neighbor_of_maps (hn : 0 < n) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    {a b c d e f : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hRT : (∑ i, a i) + (∑ i, b i) ≤ (∑ i, e i) + (∑ i, f i))
    (hab : a < b)
    (u : Hook.module (k := k) a b ⟶
      (CoordinateShift.shift ε).obj (Hook.module (k := k) c d)) (hu : u ≠ 0)
    (hcd : c < d) (hef : e < f)
    (v : Hook.module (k := k) c d ⟶
      (CoordinateShift.shift ε).obj (Hook.module (k := k) e f)) (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    Nonempty (CoordinateInterleaving (RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε)
      (Hook.module (k := k) a b) (Hook.module (k := k) c d)) ∨
    Nonempty (CoordinateInterleaving (RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε)
      (Hook.module (k := k) c d) (Hook.module (k := k) e f))

name: TDA.Persistence.HookMatching.hookTagMultiset_card

statement:
theorem nonzero_finiteHook_map_endpoint_bounds {a b c d : Fin n → ℝ}

name: TDA.Persistence.HookMatching.nonzero_principalHook_map_birth_bound
statement:
theorem nonzero_principalHook_map_birth_bound {a c : Fin n → ℝ}

name: TDA.Persistence.HookMatching.not_interleaved_finite_principal
statement:
theorem not_interleaved_finite_principal {a b c : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hab : a < b) (ρ : ℝ≥0) :

      (HookInfinity.module (R := k) c))

name: TDA.Persistence.HookMatching.not_interleaved_principal_finite
statement:
theorem not_interleaved_principal_finite {a b c : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hab : a < b) (ρ : ℝ≥0) :

name: TDA.Persistence.HookMatching.principalHookCoefficient_add
statement:
theorem principalHookCoefficient_add {a c : Fin n → ℝ} (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (f g : HookInfinity.module (R := k) a ⟶
      (CoordinateShift.shift ε).obj (HookInfinity.module (R := k) c)) :
    principalHookCoefficient (k := k) ε (f + g) =
      principalHookCoefficient (k := k) ε f +
        principalHookCoefficient (k := k) ε g

name: TDA.Persistence.HookMatching.principalHookCoefficient_composite
statement:
theorem principalHookCoefficient_composite {a c e : Fin n → ℝ}
    (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (f : HookInfinity.module (R := k) a ⟶
      (CoordinateShift.shift ε).obj (HookInfinity.module (R := k) c))
    (g : HookInfinity.module (R := k) c ⟶
      (CoordinateShift.shift ε).obj (HookInfinity.module (R := k) e)) :
    principalHookCoefficient (k := k) (ε + ε)
      (f ≫ (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map g ≫
        (CoordinateShift.compIso ε ε (HookInfinity.module (R := k) e)).hom) =
      principalHookCoefficient (k := k) ε f *
        principalHookCoefficient (k := k) ε g

name: TDA.Persistence.HookMatching.principalHookCoefficient_ne_zero_iff
statement:
theorem principalHookCoefficient_ne_zero_iff {a c : Fin n → ℝ} (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (f : HookInfinity.module (R := k) a ⟶
      (CoordinateShift.shift ε).obj (HookInfinity.module (R := k) c)) :
    principalHookCoefficient (k := k) ε f ≠ 0 ↔ f ≠ 0

name: TDA.Persistence.HookMatching.principalHookCoefficient_sum
statement:
theorem principalHookCoefficient_sum {a c : Fin n → ℝ} {ι : Type*}
    (ε : ℝ≥0) (A : Finset ι)
    (f : ι → (HookInfinity.module (R := k) a ⟶
      (CoordinateShift.shift ε).obj (HookInfinity.module (R := k) c))) :
    principalHookCoefficient (k := k) ε (∑ i ∈ A, f i) =
      ∑ i ∈ A, principalHookCoefficient (k := k) ε (f i)

name: TDA.Persistence.HookMatching.principalHookCoefficient_transition
statement:
theorem principalHookCoefficient_transition {a : Fin n → ℝ} (δ : ℝ≥0) :
    principalHookCoefficient (k := k) δ
      (CoordinateShift.transition δ (HookInfinity.module (R := k) a)) = 1

name: TDA.Persistence.HookMatching.principalHookCoefficient_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem principalHookCoefficient_zero {a c : Fin n → ℝ} (ε : ℝ≥0) :
    principalHookCoefficient (k := k) ε
      (0 : HookInfinity.module (R := k) a ⟶
        (CoordinateShift.shift ε).obj (HookInfinity.module (R := k) c)) = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.HookMatching.principal_hook_path_birth_close
statement:
theorem principal_hook_path_birth_close (hn : 0 < n) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    {a c e : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hAE : (∑ i, a i) ≤ ∑ i, e i)
    (hAC : ∀ i, c i ≤ a i + (ε : ℝ))
    (hCE : ∀ i, e i ≤ c i + (ε : ℝ)) :
    ∀ i, c i ≤ a i +
        (RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε : ℝ) ∧
      a i ≤ c i + (RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε : ℝ)

name: TDA.Persistence.HookMatching.principal_hook_path_neighbor_of_maps
statement:
theorem principal_hook_path_neighbor_of_maps (hn : 0 < n) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    {a c e : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hAE : (∑ i, a i) ≤ ∑ i, e i)
    (u : HookInfinity.module (R := k) a ⟶
      (CoordinateShift.shift ε).obj (HookInfinity.module (R := k) c)) (hu : u ≠ 0)
    (v : HookInfinity.module (R := k) c ⟶
      (CoordinateShift.shift ε).obj (HookInfinity.module (R := k) e)) (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    Nonempty (CoordinateInterleaving
      (RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε)
      (HookInfinity.module (R := k) a) (HookInfinity.module (R := k) c))

name: TDA.Persistence.HookMatching.sum_projection_inclusion
statement:
theorem sum_projection_inclusion {m : ℕ} (F : Fin m → RealHookTag (n := n)) :
    ∑ i, projection (k := k) F i ≫ inclusion F i = 𝟙 (familyModule (k := k) F)

name: TDA.Persistence.HookMatching.tagScalar_composite
statement:
theorem tagScalar_composite (hn : 0 < n) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    {t s u : RealHookTag (n := n)}
    (hα : tagOrderValue t ≤ tagOrderValue u)
    (hT : tagSignificant
      (RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε +
        RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε) t)
    (hU : tagSignificant
      (RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε +
        RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε) u)
    (f : tagModule (k := k) t ⟶
      (CoordinateShift.shift ε).obj (tagModule (k := k) s))
    (g : tagModule (k := k) s ⟶
      (CoordinateShift.shift ε).obj (tagModule (k := k) u)) :
    tagScalar (k := k) (ε + ε) t u
      (f ≫ (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map g ≫
        (CoordinateShift.compIso ε ε (tagModule (k := k) u)).hom) =
      tagScalar (k := k) ε t s f * tagScalar (k := k) ε s u g

name: TDA.Persistence.HookMatching.transition_ne_zero_iff_support
statement:
theorem transition_ne_zero_iff_support {S : Set (Fin n → ℝ)}
    (hS : S.OrdConnected) (δ : ℝ≥0) :
    CoordinateShift.transition δ (SupportInterval.module (k := k) S hS) ≠ 0 ↔
      ∃ p, p ∈ S ∧ CoordinateShift.translation δ p ∈ S

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteHookSumPresentation.hookTagMultiset_biproduct
statement:
theorem FiniteHookSumPresentation.hookTagMultiset_biproduct
    {J : Type} [Fintype J]
    (X : J → PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ))
    (P : ∀ j, FiniteHookSumPresentation (k := k) (n := n) (X j)) :
    hookTagMultiset (FiniteHookSumPresentation.biproduct
      (k := k) (n := n) X P).tag =
      ∑ j, hookTagMultiset (P j).tag

name: TDA.Persistence.HasMultisetMatching.elim
statement:
theorem HasMultisetMatching.elim {ρ : ℝ≥0}
    {A B : Multiset (RealHookTag (n := n))}
    (h : HasMultisetMatching (k := k) ρ A B) :
    ∃ (m ℓ : ℕ) (F : Fin m → RealHookTag (n := n))
        (G : Fin ℓ → RealHookTag (n := n)),
      hookTagMultiset F = A ∧ hookTagMultiset G = B ∧
        ∃ M : OccurrenceMatching (Fin m) (Fin ℓ) PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1},
          HookMatching.IsMatching (k := k) ρ F G M

name: TDA.Persistence.HasMultisetMatching.intro
statement:
theorem HasMultisetMatching.intro {ρ : ℝ≥0}
    {A B : Multiset (RealHookTag (n := n))} {m ℓ : ℕ}
    (F : Fin m → RealHookTag (n := n)) (G : Fin ℓ → RealHookTag (n := n))
    (hF : hookTagMultiset F = A) (hG : hookTagMultiset G = B)
    (M : OccurrenceMatching (Fin m) (Fin ℓ) PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1})
    (hM : HookMatching.IsMatching (k := k) ρ F G M) :
    HasMultisetMatching (k := k) ρ A B

name: TDA.Persistence.hookMultisetBottleneckDistance_le_of_matching
statement:
theorem hookMultisetBottleneckDistance_le_of_matching
    {A B : Multiset (RealHookTag (n := n))} {ρ : ℝ≥0}

    hookMultisetBottleneckDistance (k := k) A B ≤ ρ

name: TDA.Persistence.hookMultisetBottleneckDistance_lt_iff
statement:
theorem hookMultisetBottleneckDistance_lt_iff
    (A B : Multiset (RealHookTag (n := n))) (r : ℝ≥0∞) :
    hookMultisetBottleneckDistance (k := k) A B < r ↔
      ∃ ρ, ∃ _h : HasMultisetMatching (k := k) ρ A B, (ρ : ℝ≥0∞) < r

name: TDA.Persistence.le_hookMultisetBottleneckDistance_iff
statement:
theorem le_hookMultisetBottleneckDistance_iff
    (A B : Multiset (RealHookTag (n := n))) (r : ℝ≥0∞) :
    r ≤ hookMultisetBottleneckDistance (k := k) A B ↔
      ∀ ρ, ∀ _h : HasMultisetMatching (k := k) ρ A B, r ≤ (ρ : ℝ≥0∞)

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensor.crossingDelta_killed_in_diagonalIdealVertexCoinvariants

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensor.diagonalQuotientVertexTensorEvaluation_unit

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensor.diagonalQuotientVertexTensorUnit_ne_zero

theorem diagonalQuotientVertexTensorUnit_ne_zero

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensor.diagonalQuotientVertexTensor_reconstruct

theorem diagonalQuotientVertexTensor_reconstruct

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensor.vertexBalancedFactor_pure
statement:
@[simp] theorem vertexBalancedFactor_pure {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V]
    (f : k →ₗ[k] N →ₗ[k] V) (hbal : IsVertexBalanced χ f)

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensor.vertexBalanced_universal
statement:
theorem vertexBalanced_universal {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V]

    ∃! F : VertexCoinvariants (k := k) (R := R) (N := N) χ →ₗ[k] V,
      ∀ x n, F (vertexPure χ x n) = f x n

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensor.vertexCharacter_algebraMap

@[simp] theorem vertexCharacter_algebraMap (v : FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.StrictVertex S)
    (c : k) :

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensor.vertexCharacter_delta
statement:
@[simp] theorem vertexCharacter_delta (v : FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.StrictVertex S)
    (p q : PairPoset S) (hpq : p ≤ q) :
    vertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v (delta (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq) =

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensor.vertexCharacter_mul

@[simp] theorem vertexCharacter_mul (v : FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.StrictVertex S)

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensor.vertexCharacter_zero_on_diagonalIdeal

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensor.vertexPureBilinear_apply

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensor.vertexQuotientCharacter_mk

@[simp] theorem vertexQuotientCharacter_mk

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensor.vertexQuotientCharacter_smul
statement:
theorem vertexQuotientCharacter_smul

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensor.vertexRightAction_mul

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensor.vertexRightAction_one

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensorFunctor.coinvariantsEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem coinvariantsEquiv_mk {N : Type u} [AddCommGroup N] [Module k N]
    [Module (Incidence (k := k) (S := S)) N]
    (e : M ≃+ N)
    (hk : ∀ (c : k) (x : M), e ((algebraMap k (Incidence (k := k) (S := S)) c) • x) =
      c • e x)
    (hA : ∀ (a : Incidence (k := k) (S := S)) (x : M), e (a • x) = a • e x)
    (x : M) :
    coinvariantsEquiv (k := k) (S := S) v e hk hA
      (mk (k := k) (S := S) v M x) =
        (vertexRelation (k := k) (R := Incidence (k := k) (S := S))
          (N := N) (vertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v)).mkQ (e x)

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensorFunctor.coinvariantsEquiv_mkQ
statement:
@[simp] theorem coinvariantsEquiv_mkQ {N : Type u} [AddCommGroup N] [Module k N]
    [Module (Incidence (k := k) (S := S)) N]
    (e : M ≃+ N)
    (hk : ∀ (c : k) (x : M), e ((algebraMap k (Incidence (k := k) (S := S)) c) • x) =
      c • e x)
    (hA : ∀ (a : Incidence (k := k) (S := S)) (x : M), e (a • x) = a • e x)
    (x : M) :
    coinvariantsEquiv (k := k) (S := S) v e hk hA
      ((relation (k := k) (S := S) v M).mkQ x) =
        (vertexRelation (k := k) (R := Incidence (k := k) (S := S))
          (N := N) (vertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v)).mkQ (e x)

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensorFunctor.map_mkQ
statement:
@[simp] theorem map_mkQ {M N : ModuleCat (Incidence (k := k) (S := S))}
    (f : M ⟶ N) (m : M) :
    map (k := k) (S := S) v f ((relation (k := k) (S := S) v M).mkQ m) =
      (relation (k := k) (S := S) v N).mkQ (f.hom m)

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensorFunctor.mkQ_smul

@[simp] theorem mkQ_smul (M : ModuleCat (Incidence (k := k) (S := S)))
    (a : Incidence (k := k) (S := S)) (m : M) :
    (relation (k := k) (S := S) v M).mkQ (a • m) =

statement:
theorem restrictedScalarsTower (M : ModuleCat (Incidence (k := k) (S := S))) :

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensorFunctor.vertexTensor_map_apply_mkQ

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTor.diagonalQuotientResolutionComplex_differential_one

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTor.diagonalQuotientResolutionComplex_differential_two_and_above

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTor.diagonalQuotientResolutionComplex_term_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem diagonalQuotientResolutionComplex_term_one :

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTor.diagonalQuotientResolutionComplex_term_two_and_above

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTor.diagonalQuotientResolutionComplex_term_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem diagonalQuotientResolutionComplex_term_zero :

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTor.diagonalQuotientVertexCoinvariantsEquiv_mkQ
statement:
@[simp] theorem diagonalQuotientVertexCoinvariantsEquiv_mkQ

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTor.diagonalQuotientVertexCoinvariantsIso_hom_mkQ
statement:
@[simp] theorem diagonalQuotientVertexCoinvariantsIso_hom_mkQ
    (b : DiagonalQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) :

      (mk (k := k) (S := S) v

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTor.diagonalQuotient_leftDerivedZeroIso_hom_unit
statement:
@[simp] theorem diagonalQuotient_leftDerivedZeroIso_hom_unit :
    (diagonalQuotient_leftDerivedZeroIso (k := k) (S := S) v).hom
      (((Functor.leftDerivedZeroIsoSelf (vertexTensor (k := k) (S := S) v)).app
        (diagonalQuotientModule (k := k) (S := S))).inv.hom
        (mk (k := k) (S := S) v
          (diagonalQuotientModule (k := k) (S := S))
          (1 : DiagonalQuotient (k := k) (S := S)))) =
      (1 : k)

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTor.diagonalQuotient_leftDerivedZero_not_isZero
statement:
theorem diagonalQuotient_leftDerivedZero_not_isZero :

statement:
theorem diagonalQuotient_leftDerived_pos_isZero (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :

theorem mappedResolution_exactAt_pos (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :

theorem mappedResolution_homology_pos_isZero (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :

theorem mappedResolution_term_isZero_of_two_le (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) :

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientSimple.incidence_sum_diagonal_delta
statement:
theorem incidence_sum_diagonal_delta :
    (∑ p : PairPoset S, delta (k := k) (S := S) p p le_rfl) =
      (1 : Incidence (k := k) (S := S))

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientSimple.rightMatrixUnit_diagonal_sum
statement:
@[simp] theorem rightMatrixUnit_diagonal_sum :
    (∑ p : PairPoset S,
      rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p p le_rfl) = 1

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientSimple.rightMatrixUnit_eq_zero_of_isDiagonal
statement:
theorem rightMatrixUnit_eq_zero_of_isDiagonal (p : PairPoset S)
    (hp : IsDiagonal (S := S) p) :
    rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p p le_rfl = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientSimple.rightMatrixUnit_mul
statement:
@[simp] theorem rightMatrixUnit_mul (p q r s : PairPoset S)
    (hpq : p ≤ q) (hrs : r ≤ s) :
    rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq *
        rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) r s hrs =
      if h : s = p then
        rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) r q (by subst p; exact hrs.trans hpq)
      else 0

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientSimple.rightMatrixUnit_smul
statement:
@[simp] theorem rightMatrixUnit_smul (v : StrictVertex S)
    (p q : PairPoset S) (hpq : p ≤ q) (t : RightVertexModule (k := k) (S := S) v) :
    rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq • t =
      (if v.1 = p ∧ v.1 = q then t else 0)

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientSimple.rightVertexCharacter_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem rightVertexCharacter_algebraMap (v : StrictVertex S) (a : k) :
    rightVertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v
      (algebraMap k (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) a) = a

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientSimple.rightVertexCharacter_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem rightVertexCharacter_apply (v : StrictVertex S)
    (c : RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) :
    rightVertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v c =
      vertexQuotientCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v (MulOpposite.unop c)

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientSimple.rightVertexCharacter_matrixScalar
statement:
theorem rightVertexCharacter_matrixScalar (v : StrictVertex S)
    (p q : PairPoset S) (hpq : p ≤ q) (a : k) :
    rightVertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v
      (algebraMap k (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) a *
        rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq) =
      a * rightVertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v
        (rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq)

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientSimple.rightVertexCharacter_rightMatrixUnit
statement:
@[simp] theorem rightVertexCharacter_rightMatrixUnit (v : StrictVertex S)
    (p q : PairPoset S) (hpq : p ≤ q) :
    rightVertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v
      (rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq) =
        if v.1 = p ∧ v.1 = q then 1 else 0

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientSimple.rightVertexCharacter_surjective
statement:
theorem rightVertexCharacter_surjective (v : StrictVertex S) :
    Function.Surjective (rightVertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v)

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientSimple.rightVertexModuleGeneratedMap_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem rightVertexModuleGeneratedMap_apply
    [Module (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) k]
    (M : ModuleCat (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)))
    (v : StrictVertex S) (x : M)
    (hscalar : ∀ (c : RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) (t : k),
      c • t = rightVertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v c • t)
    (hχ : ∀ c : RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S),
      c • x = algebraMap k (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S))
        (rightVertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v c) • x) (t : k) :
    rightVertexModuleGeneratedMap (k := k) (S := S) M v x hscalar hχ t =
      algebraMap k (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) t • x

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientSimple.rightVertexModule_isSimpleModule
statement:
theorem rightVertexModule_isSimpleModule (v : StrictVertex S) :
    IsSimpleModule (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S))
      (RightVertexModule (k := k) (S := S) v)

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientSimple.rightVertexModule_iso_iff
statement:
theorem rightVertexModule_iso_iff (v w : StrictVertex S) :
    Nonempty (RightVertexModule (k := k) (S := S) v ≅
      RightVertexModule (k := k) (S := S) w) ↔ v = w

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientSimple.rightVertexModule_smul
statement:
@[simp] theorem rightVertexModule_smul (v : StrictVertex S)
    (c : RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S))
    (t : RightVertexModule (k := k) (S := S) v) :
    c • t = rightVertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v c • t

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientSimple.simpleModule_existsUnique_vertex
statement:
theorem simpleModule_existsUnique_vertex
    (M : ModuleCat (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)))
    [IsSimpleModule (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) M] :
    ∃! v : StrictVertex S,
      Nonempty (M ≅ RightVertexModule (k := k) (S := S) v)

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientSimple.simpleModule_existsUnique_vertex_and_derivedZero
statement:
theorem simpleModule_existsUnique_vertex_and_derivedZero
    (M : ModuleCat (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)))
    [IsSimpleModule (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) M] :
    ∃! v : StrictVertex S,
      Nonempty (M ≅ RightVertexModule (k := k) (S := S) v) ∧
      Nonempty (restrictRightQuotientModule (k := k) (S := S) M ≅
        (((TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensorFunctor.vertexTensor (k := k) (S := S) v).leftDerived 0).obj
          (TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTor.diagonalQuotientModule
            (k := k) (S := S))))

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientSimple.simpleModule_existsUnique_vertex_positiveLeftDerived_isZero
statement:
theorem simpleModule_existsUnique_vertex_positiveLeftDerived_isZero
    (M : ModuleCat (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)))
    [IsSimpleModule (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) M]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    ∃! v : StrictVertex S,
      Nonempty (M ≅ RightVertexModule (k := k) (S := S) v) ∧
      CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero (((TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensorFunctor.vertexTensor
        (k := k) (S := S) v).leftDerived n).obj
        (TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTor.diagonalQuotientModule (k := k) (S := S)))

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.extensionAdjunction_counit_eq_extensionRestrictionIso
statement:
theorem extensionAdjunction_counit_eq_extensionRestrictionIso
    (N : ModuleCat (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S))) :

      (extensionRestrictionIso (k := k) (S := S)).hom.app N

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.extensionMap_mkQ
statement:
@[simp] theorem extensionMap_mkQ {M N : ModuleCat (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))}
    (g : M ⟶ N) (m : M) :
    (extensionMap (k := k) (S := S) g).hom
      ((relation (k := k) (S := S) M).mkQ m) =
        (relation (k := k) (S := S) N).mkQ (g.hom m)

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.extensionRestrictionIso_hom_mkQ
statement:
@[simp] theorem extensionRestrictionIso_hom_mkQ
    (N : ModuleCat (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S))) (n : N) :
    (extensionRestrictionIso (k := k) (S := S)).hom.app N
      ((relation (k := k) (S := S)
        ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (quotientHom (k := k) (S := S))).obj N)).mkQ n) = n

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.extensionRestrictionIso_inv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem extensionRestrictionIso_inv_apply
    (N : ModuleCat (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S))) (n : N) :

      (relation (k := k) (S := S)
        ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (quotientHom (k := k) (S := S))).obj N)).mkQ n

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.extensionRightVertexIso_hom_mkQ
statement:
@[simp] theorem extensionRightVertexIso_hom_mkQ (v : StrictVertex S)

      ((relation (k := k) (S := S)
        (RightVertexRestrictedModule (k := k) (S := S) v)).mkQ t) = t

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.kernel_action_annihilates
statement:
theorem kernel_action_annihilates
    (M : ModuleCat (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S)))

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.liftCLinearMap_mkQ
statement:
@[simp] theorem liftCLinearMap_mkQ
    {M : ModuleCat (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))}
    {N : ModuleCat (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S))}

    liftCLinearMap (k := k) (S := S) g
      ((relation (k := k) (S := S) M).mkQ m) = g.hom m

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.liftMap_mkQ
statement:
@[simp] theorem liftMap_mkQ
    {M : ModuleCat (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))}
    {N : ModuleCat (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S))}
    (g : M ⟶ (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (quotientHom (k := k) (S := S))).obj N)

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.liftQuotient_mkQ
statement:
@[simp] theorem liftQuotient_mkQ
    {M : ModuleCat (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))}
    {N : ModuleCat (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S))}

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.mapQuotient_mkQ
statement:
@[simp] theorem mapQuotient_mkQ {M N : ModuleCat (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))}

statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientAction_comp_apply
    (M : ModuleCat (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S)))
    (r : RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S)) (x : quotient (k := k) (S := S) M) :
    quotientAction (k := k) (S := S) M (quotientHom (k := k) (S := S) r) x = r • x

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.quotientHom_rightIncidenceMatrixUnit
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientHom_rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (p q : PairPoset S) (hpq : p ≤ q) :
    quotientHom (k := k) (S := S)

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexRepresentation.diagonalProjector_apply_vertex
statement:
@[simp] theorem diagonalProjector_apply_vertex
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))) (p q : PairPoset S)
    (x : vertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M q) :
    diagonalProjector (k := k) (S := S) M p x = if p = q then x else 0

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexRepresentation.diagonalProjector_idempotent
statement:
theorem diagonalProjector_idempotent
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))) (p : PairPoset S)
    (m : restrictedKModule (k := k) (S := S) M) :
    diagonalProjector (k := k) (S := S) M p
        (diagonalProjector (k := k) (S := S) M p m) =
      diagonalProjector (k := k) (S := S) M p m

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexRepresentation.diagonalProjector_sum
statement:
theorem diagonalProjector_sum
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S)))
    (m : restrictedKModule (k := k) (S := S) M) :
    (∑ p : PairPoset S, diagonalProjector (k := k) (S := S) M p m) = m

statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_iff_vertexFibers
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))) :
    FiniteDimensional k (restrictedKModule (k := k) (S := S) M) ↔
      ∀ p : PairPoset S, FiniteDimensional k (vertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M p)

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexRepresentation.mapOnVertexFiber_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem mapOnVertexFiber_val
    {M N : ModuleCat.{u} (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))} (f : M ⟶ N)
    (p : PairPoset S) (x : vertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M p) :
    (mapOnVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) f p x : N) = f.hom x

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexRepresentation.mem_vertexFiber_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_vertexFiber_iff
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))) (p : PairPoset S)
    (m : restrictedKModule (k := k) (S := S) M) :
    m ∈ vertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M p ↔
      diagonalProjector (k := k) (S := S) M p m = m

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexRepresentation.naturalTransformationComponent_naturality
statement:
theorem naturalTransformationComponent_naturality
    {M N : ModuleCat.{u} (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))}
    (α : vertexRepresentation (k := k) (S := S) M ⟶
      vertexRepresentation (k := k) (S := S) N)
    {p q : PairPoset S} (hpq : p ≤ q) (x : vertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M p) :
    naturalTransformationComponent (k := k) (S := S) α q
        (vertexStructureMap (k := k) (S := S) M hpq x) =
      vertexStructureMap (k := k) (S := S) N hpq
        (naturalTransformationComponent (k := k) (S := S) α p x)

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexRepresentation.projectToVertexFiber_map
statement:
theorem projectToVertexFiber_map
    {M N : ModuleCat.{u} (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))} (f : M ⟶ N)
    (p : PairPoset S) (m : restrictedKModule (k := k) (S := S) M) :
    projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) N p (f.hom m) =
      mapOnVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) f p
        (projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M p m)

statement:
theorem projectToVertexFiber_reconstructVertexNaturalTransformation
    {M N : ModuleCat.{u} (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))}
    (α : vertexRepresentation (k := k) (S := S) M ⟶
      vertexRepresentation (k := k) (S := S) N)
    (p : PairPoset S) (m : restrictedKModule (k := k) (S := S) M) :
    projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) N p
      (reconstructVertexNaturalTransformation (k := k) (S := S) α m) =
        naturalTransformationComponent (k := k) (S := S) α p
          (projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M p m)

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexRepresentation.projectToVertexFiber_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem projectToVertexFiber_val
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))) (p : PairPoset S)
    (m : restrictedKModule (k := k) (S := S) M) :
    (projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M p m : M) =
      diagonalProjector (k := k) (S := S) M p m

      ((vertexFunctor (k := k) (S := S)).map f) = f.hom

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexRepresentation.reconstructVertexNaturalTransformation_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem reconstructVertexNaturalTransformation_apply
    {M N : ModuleCat.{u} (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))}
    (α : vertexRepresentation (k := k) (S := S) M ⟶
      vertexRepresentation (k := k) (S := S) N)
    (m : restrictedKModule (k := k) (S := S) M) :
    reconstructVertexNaturalTransformation (k := k) (S := S) α m =
      ∑ p : PairPoset S,
        ((naturalTransformationComponent (k := k) (S := S) α p
          (projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M p m)) : N)

statement:
theorem reconstructVertexNaturalTransformation_apply_vertex
    {M N : ModuleCat.{u} (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))}
    (α : vertexRepresentation (k := k) (S := S) M ⟶
      vertexRepresentation (k := k) (S := S) N)
    (p : PairPoset S) (x : vertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M p) :
    reconstructVertexNaturalTransformation (k := k) (S := S) α x =
      ((naturalTransformationComponent (k := k) (S := S) α p x) : N)

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexRepresentation.reconstructVertexNaturalTransformation_map_rightMatrixUnit
statement:
theorem reconstructVertexNaturalTransformation_map_rightMatrixUnit
    {M N : ModuleCat.{u} (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))}
    (α : vertexRepresentation (k := k) (S := S) M ⟶
      vertexRepresentation (k := k) (S := S) N)
    {p q : PairPoset S} (hpq : p ≤ q)
    (m : restrictedKModule (k := k) (S := S) M) :
    reconstructVertexNaturalTransformation (k := k) (S := S) α
        (IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S)
          p q hpq • m) =
      IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S)
        p q hpq • reconstructVertexNaturalTransformation (k := k) (S := S) α m

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexRepresentation.rightIncidenceMap_injective_iff_vertexFibers
statement:
theorem rightIncidenceMap_injective_iff_vertexFibers
    {M N : ModuleCat.{u} (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))} (f : M ⟶ N) :

      ∀ p : PairPoset S, Function.Injective (mapOnVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) f p)

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexRepresentation.rightIncidenceMap_surjective_iff_vertexFibers

theorem rightIncidenceMap_surjective_iff_vertexFibers

      ∀ p : PairPoset S, Function.Surjective (mapOnVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) f p)

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexRepresentation.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit_mul
statement:
@[simp] theorem rightIncidenceMatrixUnit_mul
    (p q r s : PairPoset S) (hpq : p ≤ q) (hrs : r ≤ s) :
    IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq *
        IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) r s hrs =
      if h : s = p then
        IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) r q
          (by subst p; exact hrs.trans hpq)
      else 0

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexRepresentation.rightIncidenceRange_eq_ker_iff_vertexFibers
statement:
theorem rightIncidenceRange_eq_ker_iff_vertexFibers
    {L M N : ModuleCat.{u} (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))}
    (f : L ⟶ M) (g : M ⟶ N) (hfg : f ≫ g = 0) :
    LinearMap.range f.hom = LinearMap.ker g.hom ↔
      ∀ p : PairPoset S,
        LinearMap.range (mapOnVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) f p) =
          LinearMap.ker (mapOnVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) g p)

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexRepresentation.rightIncidenceShortExact_iff_vertexPointwise
statement:
theorem rightIncidenceShortExact_iff_vertexPointwise
    {L M N : ModuleCat.{u} (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))}
    (f : L ⟶ M) (g : M ⟶ N) (hfg : f ≫ g = 0) :
    (ShortComplex.mk f g hfg).ShortExact ↔
      IsPointwiseShortExact
        ((vertexFunctor (k := k) (S := S)).map f)
        ((vertexFunctor (k := k) (S := S)).map g)

statement:

      IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p p le_rfl) =
      (1 : RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexRepresentation.rightMatrixUnitAction_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem rightMatrixUnitAction_apply

    rightMatrixUnitAction (k := k) (S := S) M p q hpq m =
      IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq • m

statement:
theorem rightMatrixUnit_smul_projector
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S)))
    {p q : PairPoset S} (hpq : p ≤ q)
    (m : restrictedKModule (k := k) (S := S) M) :
    IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq • m =
      IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq •
        (projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M p m : M)

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexRepresentation.rightMatrixUnit_smul_vertex
statement:
theorem rightMatrixUnit_smul_vertex
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S)))
    {p q : PairPoset S} (hpq : p ≤ q) {r : PairPoset S}
    (x : vertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M r) :
    IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq •
        (x : M) =
      if r = p then
        IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq •
          (x : M)
      else 0

statement:
theorem vertexFunctor_map_naturalTransformationToRightIncidenceHom

theorem contentMultiplicity_eq_count (hC : IsSetSemiring C) {x : X}
    (hSep : ∀ y : X, x ≠ y → ∃ U ∈ C, x ∈ U ∧ y ∉ U)
    (m : AddContent ℕ C) {K : Set X} (hK : K ∈ C) (points : Multiset X)
    (hRepr : ∀ U ∈ C, U ⊆ K → m U = (points.filter (· ∈ U)).card)
    (hxK : x ∈ K) : contentMultiplicity m x = points.count x

    {K : Set X} (hSep : ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y : X, x ≠ y → ∃ U ∈ C, x ∈ U ∧ y ∉ U)
    (hK : K ∈ C) (hCompact : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ S : Finset X, (∀ x, x ∈ S ↔ x ∈ K ∧ 0 < contentMultiplicity m x) ∧
      m K = ∑ x ∈ S, contentMultiplicity m x

    ∃ U ∈ C, x ∈ U ∧ U ⊆ K ∧ ∀ y ∈ points, y ∈ U → y = x

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.crossing_factorization
statement:
theorem crossing_factorization (i : RealInterleaving ε M N) {b C : ℝ}
    (h : b + (ε : ℝ) ≤ C) :
    (i.ψ.app C).hom.comp
        ((structureMapLinear N h).comp (i.φ.app b).hom) =
      structureMapLinear M (show b ≤ C + (ε : ℝ) by
        have := ε.coe_nonneg; linarith)

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.persistenceMeasureValue_box_le
statement:
theorem persistenceMeasureValue_box_le (i : RealInterleaving ε M N)
    {a b c d : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c ≤ d)
    (hgap : b + (ε : ℝ) ≤ c - (ε : ℝ))
    [FiniteDimensional k (persistenceImage N hgap)] :
    persistenceMeasureValue M hab
        (show b ≤ c by have := ε.coe_nonneg; linarith) hcd ≤
      persistenceMeasureValue N
        (show a - (ε : ℝ) ≤ b + (ε : ℝ) by have := ε.coe_nonneg; linarith)
        hgap (show c - (ε : ℝ) ≤ d + (ε : ℝ) by have := ε.coe_nonneg; linarith)

statement:
theorem persistenceMeasureValue_box_le_of_qTame (i : RealInterleaving ε M N)
    (hN : N.QTame) {a b c d : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c ≤ d)
    (hgap : 2 * (ε : ℝ) < c - b) :
    persistenceMeasureValue M hab
        (show b ≤ c by have := ε.coe_nonneg; linarith) hcd ≤
      persistenceMeasureValue N
        (show a - (ε : ℝ) ≤ b + (ε : ℝ) by have := ε.coe_nonneg; linarith)
        (show b + (ε : ℝ) ≤ c - (ε : ℝ) by linarith)
        (show c - (ε : ℝ) ≤ d + (ε : ℝ) by have := ε.coe_nonneg; linarith)

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceMeasureMatching.exists_matching_of_separated_box_bounds
statement:
theorem exists_matching_of_separated_box_bounds
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hy : ∀ j, (y j).1 ≤ (y j).2)
    (hgap : ∀ i, 4 * ε < (x i).2 - (x i).1)
    (hsep : ∀ i i', x i ≠ x i' → 2 * ε < dist (x i) (x i'))
    (hxy : ∀ p r, 0 < r → 2 * (r + ε) < p.2 - p.1 →
      finiteBoxCount x p r ≤ finiteBoxCount y p (r + ε))
    (hyx : ∀ p r, 0 < r → 2 * (r + ε) < p.2 - p.1 →
      finiteBoxCount y p r ≤ finiteBoxCount x p (r + ε)) :
    ∃ M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1},
      (∀ i, ∃ j, M.finite i = some j) ∧
      M.cost x y PEmpty.elim PEmpty.elim ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ε

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceMeasureMatching.finiteBoxCount_box_le
statement:
theorem finiteBoxCount_box_le (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ)
    {ε : ℝ} (hbox : ∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ) (r : ℝ), 0 < r →
      2 * (r + ε) < p.2 - p.1 → finiteBoxCount x p r ≤ finiteBoxCount y p (r + ε))
    (p : ℝ × ℝ) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hgap : 2 * (r + ε) < p.2 - p.1) :
    finiteBoxCount x p r ≤ finiteBoxCount y p (r + ε)

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceMeasureWindowMatching.exists_finite_window_matching_of_center_counts
statement:
theorem exists_finite_window_matching_of_center_counts
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) (exit : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) {δ : ℝ}
    (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hsepX : ∀ i i', x i ≠ x i' → 2 * δ < dist (x i) (x i'))
    (hxy0 : ∀ i, (pointBall x (x i) 0).card ≤ (pointBall y (x i) δ).card)
    (hyxδ : ∀ i, (pointBall y (x i) δ).card ≤ (pointBall x (x i) (2 * δ)).card)
    (hyx0 : ∀ j, δ < exit (y j) →
      (pointBall y (y j) 0).card ≤ (pointBall x (y j) δ).card) :
    ∃ f : I → J,
      Function.Injective f ∧
      (∀ i, dist (x i) (y (f i)) ≤ δ) ∧
      (∀ j, δ < exit (y j) → ∃ i, f i = j)
