name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.exists_finite_saturating_matching
statement:
theorem RealInterleaving.exists_finite_saturating_matching
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {ε : ℝ≥0} {M N : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ}
    (i : RealInterleaving ε M N) (hM : M.QTame) (hN : N.QTame)
    (F_M : Finset ((LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ofQModule hM).finiteOccurrences))
    (F_N : Finset ((LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ofQModule hN).finiteOccurrences))
    (hLongM : ∀ x ∈ F_M, 2 * (ε : ℝ) <
      ((LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ofQModule hM).finitePoint x).2 -
        ((LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ofQModule hM).finitePoint x).1)
    (hLongN : ∀ x ∈ F_N, 2 * (ε : ℝ) <
      ((LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ofQModule hN).finitePoint x).2 -
        ((LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ofQModule hN).finitePoint x).1)
    (E_M : Finset ((LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ofQModule hM).essentialOccurrences))
    (E_N : Finset ((LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ofQModule hN).essentialOccurrences)) :
    FiniteSaturatingMatching ε
      (LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ofQModule hM)
      (LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ofQModule hN) F_M F_N E_M E_N

name: TDA.Persistence.exists_occurrenceMatching_cost_le_of_realInterleaving
statement:
theorem exists_occurrenceMatching_cost_le_of_realInterleaving
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {ε : ℝ≥0} {M N : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ}
    (i : RealInterleaving ε M N) (hM : M.QTame) (hN : N.QTame) :
    ∃ m : OccurrenceMatching
        (LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ofQModule hM).finiteOccurrences
        (LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ofQModule hN).finiteOccurrences
        (LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ofQModule hM).essentialOccurrences
        (LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ofQModule hN).essentialOccurrences,
      LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.matchingCost m ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (ε : ℝ)

name: TDA.Persistence.qTame_bottleneck_le_of_realInterleaving
statement:
theorem qTame_bottleneck_le_of_realInterleaving
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {ε : ℝ≥0} {M N : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ}
    (i : RealInterleaving ε M N) (hM : M.QTame) (hN : N.QTame) :
    LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.bottleneck
      (LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ofQModule hM)
      (LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ofQModule hN) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (ε : ℝ)

name: TDA.Persistence.RealBarcode.comparison_app_val
statement:
theorem comparison_app_val (ε : ℝ≥0) (p q : ℝ × WithTop ℝ)
    (hb : q.1 ≤ p.1 + (ε : ℝ))
    (hd : q.2 ≤ p.2 + ((ε : ℝ) : WithTop ℝ)) (t : ℝ)
    (x : fiber (k := k) p t) :
    ((show fiber (k := k) q (t + (ε : ℝ)) from ((comparison ε p q hb hd).app t).hom x) : k) =
      if alive q (t + (ε : ℝ)) then (x : k) else 0

name: TDA.Persistence.RealBarcode.comparison_eq_zero_of_death_le
statement:
theorem comparison_eq_zero_of_death_le (ε : ℝ≥0) (p q : ℝ × WithTop ℝ)
    (hb : q.1 ≤ p.1 + (ε : ℝ))
    (hd : q.2 ≤ p.2 + ((ε : ℝ) : WithTop ℝ))
    (htouch : q.2 ≤ ((p.1 + (ε : ℝ) : ℝ) : WithTop ℝ)) :
    comparison (k := k) ε p q hb hd = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.RealBarcode.comparison_ne_zero_iff
statement:
theorem comparison_ne_zero_iff (ε : ℝ≥0) (p q : ℝ × WithTop ℝ)
    (hp : (p.1 : WithTop ℝ) < p.2)
    (hb : q.1 ≤ p.1 + (ε : ℝ))
    (hd : q.2 ≤ p.2 + ((ε : ℝ) : WithTop ℝ)) :
    comparison (k := k) ε p q hb hd ≠ 0 ↔
      ((p.1 + (ε : ℝ) : ℝ) : WithTop ℝ) < q.2

name: TDA.Persistence.RealBarcode.essential_not_interleaved_zero
statement:
theorem essential_not_interleaved_zero (ε : ℝ≥0) (b : ℝ) :
    ¬ Nonempty (RealInterleaving ε (intervalModule (k := k) (b, ⊤)) 0)

name: TDA.Persistence.RealBarcode.interleaved_zero_iff
statement:
theorem interleaved_zero_iff (ε : ℝ≥0) (b d : ℝ) :
    Nonempty (RealInterleaving ε (intervalModule (k := k) (b, (d : WithTop ℝ))) 0) ↔
      d - b ≤ 2 * (ε : ℝ)

name: TDA.Persistence.RealBarcode.map_val
statement:
theorem map_val (p : ℝ × WithTop ℝ) {s t : ℝ} (f : s ⟶ t)
    (x : fiber (k := k) p s) :
    ((show fiber (k := k) p t from ((intervalModule p).map f).hom x) : k) = if alive p t then (x : k) else 0

name: TDA.Persistence.RealBarcode.transition_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem transition_eq_zero_iff (ε : ℝ≥0) (b d : ℝ) :
    transition (ε + ε) (intervalModule (k := k) (b, (d : WithTop ℝ))) = 0 ↔
      d - b ≤ 2 * (ε : ℝ)

name: TDA.Persistence.RealBarcode.finite_positive
statement:
theorem finite_positive {D : Diagram ℝ} (hD : D.IsPositive)
    (i : D.finiteOccurrences) : i.1.1 < i.1.2

name: TDA.Persistence.RealBarcode.occurrencePoint_multiset
statement:
theorem occurrencePoint_multiset (D : Diagram ℝ) :
    (Finset.univ : Finset (Occurrences D)).val.map (occurrencePoint D) = D.points

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.distance_le_bottleneck
statement:
theorem distance_le_bottleneck (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (d : Fin m ↪o ℝ)
    (M N : PModule.{u,0,u} k ℝ) (hM : IsConstructible c M) (hN : IsConstructible d N)
    (hfdM : ∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj (c i)))
    (hfdN : ∀ j, FiniteDimensional k (N.obj (d j))) :
    realInterleavingDistance M N ≤
      bottleneck (moduleDiagram c M hfdM) (moduleDiagram d N hfdN)

name: TDA.Persistence.RealBarcode.distance_le_bottleneck
statement:
theorem distance_le_bottleneck (D E : Diagram ℝ) (hD : D.IsPositive) (hE : E.IsPositive) :
    realInterleavingDistance (realize (k := k) D) (realize E) ≤ bottleneck D E

name: TDA.Persistence.RealBarcode.distance_le_matching_cost
statement:
theorem distance_le_matching_cost (D E : Diagram ℝ) (hD : D.IsPositive) (hE : E.IsPositive)
    (M : OccurrenceMatching D.finiteOccurrences E.finiteOccurrences
      D.essentialOccurrences E.essentialOccurrences) :
    realInterleavingDistance (realize (k := k) D) (realize E) ≤
      M.cost (fun p => p.1) (fun p => p.1) (fun b => b.1) (fun b => b.1)

name: TDA.Persistence.MatchingInterleavingDistanceExamples.different_grid_bound
statement:
theorem different_grid_bound : realInterleavingDistance step step ≤
    bottleneck (moduleDiagram oneGrid step (fun i => step_finite (oneGrid i)))
      (moduleDiagram twoGrid step (fun j => step_finite (twoGrid j)))

name: TDA.Persistence.MatchingInterleavingDistanceExamples.different_grids_nonzero
statement: theorem different_grids_nonzero : ¬ IsZero (step.obj 0)

name: TDA.Persistence.MatchingInterleavingDistanceExamples.duplicate_deletion_bound
statement:
theorem duplicate_deletion_bound :
    realInterleavingDistance (realize (k := ℚ) copies) (realize emptyDiagram) ≤ 1

name: TDA.Persistence.MatchingInterleavingDistanceExamples.empty_distance
statement:
theorem empty_distance :
    realInterleavingDistance (realize (k := ℚ) emptyDiagram) (realize emptyDiagram) = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.MatchingInterleavingDistanceExamples.empty_grid_bound
statement:
theorem empty_grid_bound : realInterleavingDistance (0 : PModule.{0,0,0} ℚ ℝ) 0 ≤
    bottleneck (moduleDiagram (k := ℚ) emptyGrid 0 (fun i => Fin.elim0 i))
      (moduleDiagram (k := ℚ) emptyGrid 0 (fun i => Fin.elim0 i))

name: TDA.Persistence.MatchingInterleavingDistanceExamples.essential_matching_empty
statement:
theorem essential_matching_empty : IsEmpty (OccurrenceMatching essentialDiagram.finiteOccurrences
    emptyDiagram.finiteOccurrences essentialDiagram.essentialOccurrences
    emptyDiagram.essentialOccurrences)

name: TDA.Persistence.MatchingInterleavingDistanceExamples.essential_mismatch_bound
statement:
theorem essential_mismatch_bound : bottleneck essentialDiagram emptyDiagram = ⊤ ∧
    realInterleavingDistance (realize (k := ℚ) essentialDiagram) (realize emptyDiagram) ≤
      bottleneck essentialDiagram emptyDiagram

name: TDA.Persistence.MatchingInterleavingExamples.essential_deletion_fails
statement:
theorem essential_deletion_fails (ε : ℝ≥0) (b : ℝ) :
    ¬ Nonempty (RealInterleaving ε (RealBarcode.intervalModule (k := k) (b, ⊤)) 0)

name: TDA.Persistence.MatchingInterleavingExamples.finite_essential_no_matching
statement:
theorem finite_essential_no_matching :
    ¬ Nonempty (OccurrenceMatching (Fin 1) (Fin 0) (Fin 0) (Fin 1))

name: TDA.Persistence.MatchingInterleavingExamples.forward_comparison_ne_zero
statement:
theorem forward_comparison_ne_zero :
    (comparison (k := k) 1 (0, (2 : WithTop ℝ)) (1, (3 : WithTop ℝ))
      (by norm_num) (by norm_num [← WithTop.coe_add, WithTop.coe_le_coe])) ≠ 0

name: TDA.Persistence.MatchingInterleavingExamples.longer_interval_fails
statement:
theorem longer_interval_fails :
    ¬ Nonempty (RealInterleaving 1 (RealBarcode.intervalModule (k := k) (0, (3 : WithTop ℝ))) 0)

name: TDA.Persistence.MatchingInterleavingExamples.reverse_comparison_zero
statement:
theorem reverse_comparison_zero :
    (interleavingOfBounds (k := k) 1 (0, (2 : WithTop ℝ)) (1, (3 : WithTop ℝ))
      (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
      (by norm_num [← WithTop.coe_add, WithTop.coe_le_coe])
      (by exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr (show (2 : ℝ) ≤ 3 + 1 by norm_num))).ψ = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.PModule.scaleHom_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem scaleHom_apply (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (t : ℝ) :
    scaleHom c hc t = c⁻¹ * t

name: TDA.Persistence.PModule.scaleInvIso_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem scaleInvIso_hom_app {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c)
    (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    (scaleInvIso hc M).hom.app t = M.map (eqToHom (scaleInvIndex c hc t))

name: TDA.Persistence.PModule.scaleInvIso_naturality
statement:
theorem scaleInvIso_naturality {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c)
    {M N : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    reindexNatTrans (scaleHom c⁻¹ (inv_pos.2 hc))
        (reindexNatTrans (scaleHom c hc) f) ≫ (scaleInvIso hc N).hom =
      (scaleInvIso hc M).hom ≫ f

name: TDA.Persistence.PModule.scaleOneIso_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem scaleOneIso_hom_app (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    (scaleOneIso M).hom.app t = M.map (eqToHom (scaleOneIndex t))

name: TDA.Persistence.PModule.scaleOneIso_naturality
statement:
theorem scaleOneIso_naturality {M N : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    reindexNatTrans (scaleHom 1 one_pos) f ≫ (scaleOneIso N).hom =
      (scaleOneIso M).hom ≫ f

name: TDA.Persistence.PModule.scaleScaleIso_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem scaleScaleIso_hom_app (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    (scaleScaleIso a b ha hb M).hom.app t =
      M.map (eqToHom (scaleScaleIndex a b ha hb t))

name: TDA.Persistence.PModule.scaleScaleIso_naturality
statement:
theorem scaleScaleIso_naturality (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    {M N : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    reindexNatTrans (scaleHom b hb) (reindexNatTrans (scaleHom a ha) f) ≫
        (scaleScaleIso a b ha hb N).hom =
      (scaleScaleIso a b ha hb M).hom ≫
        reindexNatTrans (scaleHom (b * a) (mul_pos hb ha)) f

name: TDA.Persistence.PModule.scaleShiftIso_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem scaleShiftIso_hom_app (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    (scaleShiftIso c hc ε M).hom.app t =
      M.map (eqToHom (scaleShiftIndex c hc ε t))

name: TDA.Persistence.PModule.scaleShiftIso_naturality
statement:
theorem scaleShiftIso_naturality (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    {M N : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    (shift (Real.toNNReal c * ε)).map (reindexNatTrans (scaleHom c hc) f) ≫
        (scaleShiftIso c hc ε N).hom =
      (scaleShiftIso c hc ε M).hom ≫
        reindexNatTrans (scaleHom c hc) ((shift ε).map f)

name: TDA.Persistence.PModule.scale_obj
statement:
@[simp] theorem scale_obj (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    (scale c hc M).obj t = M.obj (c⁻¹ * t)

name: TDA.Persistence.PModule.structureMap_scale
statement:
theorem structureMap_scale (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ)
    {s t : ℝ} (h : s ≤ t) :
    structureMap (scale c hc M) h =
      structureMap M ((scaleHom c hc).monotone h)

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.scale_φ_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem scale_φ_app (i : RealInterleaving ε M N) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (t : ℝ) :
    (i.scale c hc).φ.app t =
      i.φ.app (PModule.scaleHom c hc t) ≫
        (PModule.scaleShiftIso c hc ε N).inv.app t

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.scale_ψ_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem scale_ψ_app (i : RealInterleaving ε M N) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (t : ℝ) :
    (i.scale c hc).ψ.app t =
      i.ψ.app (PModule.scaleHom c hc t) ≫
        (PModule.scaleShiftIso c hc ε M).inv.app t

name: TDA.Persistence.nonempty_realInterleaving_scale_iff
statement:
theorem nonempty_realInterleaving_scale_iff (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (ε : ℝ≥0) :
    Nonempty (RealInterleaving (Real.toNNReal c * ε)
      (PModule.scale c hc M) (PModule.scale c hc N)) ↔
      Nonempty (RealInterleaving ε M N)

name: TDA.Persistence.realInterleavingDistance_scale
statement:
theorem realInterleavingDistance_scale (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (M N : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) :
    realInterleavingDistance (PModule.scale c hc M) (PModule.scale c hc N) =
      ENNReal.ofReal c * realInterleavingDistance M N

name: TDA.Persistence.realInterleavingDistance_scale_eq_top_iff
statement:
theorem realInterleavingDistance_scale_eq_top_iff (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (M N : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) :
    realInterleavingDistance (PModule.scale c hc M) (PModule.scale c hc N) = ⊤ ↔
      realInterleavingDistance M N = ⊤

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceImage.birthPersistence_l1_sub_le
statement:
theorem birthPersistence_l1_sub_le (p q : ℝ × ℝ) :
    |(birthPersistence p).1 - (birthPersistence q).1| +
      |(birthPersistence p).2 - (birthPersistence q).2| ≤ 3 * ‖p - q‖

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceImage.feature_apply
statement:
theorem feature_apply {A B : ℝ} (σ : ℝ) (w : Weight A B)
    (P : K → Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (p : ℝ × ℝ) (k : K) :
    feature σ w P p k = ∫ z in P k, w (birthPersistence p) *
      density2D σ (birthPersistence p) z

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceImage.image_apply
statement:
theorem image_apply {I : Type*} [Fintype I] {A B : ℝ} (σ : ℝ) (w : Weight A B)
    (P : K → Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (k : K) :
    image σ w P x k = ∫ z in P k, ∑ i, w (birthPersistence (x i)) *
      density2D σ (birthPersistence (x i)) z

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceImage.integrable_weighted_density
statement:
theorem integrable_weighted_density {A B : ℝ} (σ : ℝ) (w : Weight A B)
    (p : ℝ × ℝ) : Integrable (fun z => w (birthPersistence p) *
      density2D σ (birthPersistence p) z)

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceImage.norm_feature_diagonal_le
statement:
theorem norm_feature_diagonal_le {σ A B : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (w : Weight A B) (P : K → Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (hm : ∀ k, MeasurableSet (P k))
    (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (P i) (P j))) (p : ℝ × ℝ) (hp : p.1 < p.2) :
    ‖feature σ w P p‖ ≤ stabilityConstant σ A B * (diagonalCost p).toReal

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceImage.norm_feature_le_weight
statement:
theorem norm_feature_le_weight {σ A B : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (w : Weight A B)
    (P : K → Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (hm : ∀ k, MeasurableSet (P k))
    (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (P i) (P j))) (p : ℝ × ℝ) :
    ‖feature σ w P p‖ ≤ w (birthPersistence p)

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceImage.norm_feature_sub_le
statement:
theorem norm_feature_sub_le {σ A B : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (w : Weight A B) (P : K → Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (hm : ∀ k, MeasurableSet (P k))
    (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (P i) (P j))) (p q : ℝ × ℝ) :
    ‖feature σ w P p - feature σ w P q‖ ≤ stabilityConstant σ A B * ‖p - q‖

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceImage.norm_gaussianPixels_le_one
statement:
theorem norm_gaussianPixels_le_one {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (P : K → Set (ℝ × ℝ))
    (hm : ∀ k, MeasurableSet (P k)) (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (P i) (P j)))
    (u : ℝ × ℝ) : ‖pixelIntegral P (density2D σ u)‖ ≤ 1

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceImage.norm_gaussianPixels_sub_le
statement:
theorem norm_gaussianPixels_sub_le {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (P : K → Set (ℝ × ℝ))
    (hm : ∀ k, MeasurableSet (P k)) (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (P i) (P j)))
    (u v : ℝ × ℝ) :
    ‖pixelIntegral P (density2D σ u) - pixelIntegral P (density2D σ v)‖ ≤
      translationConstant σ * (|u.1 - v.1| + |u.2 - v.2|)

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceImage.norm_image_sub_le_matching
statement:
theorem norm_image_sub_le_matching {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    {σ A B : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (w : Weight A B)
    (P : K → Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (hm : ∀ k, MeasurableSet (P k))
    (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (P i) (P j)))
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1})
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i, (x i).1 < (x i).2) (hy : ∀ j, (y j).1 < (y j).2) :
    ‖image σ w P x - image σ w P y‖ ≤
      stabilityConstant σ A B * M.totalFiniteCost x y

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceImage.norm_pixelIntegral_le
statement:
theorem norm_pixelIntegral_le (P : K → Set (ℝ × ℝ))
    (hm : ∀ k, MeasurableSet (P k)) (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (P i) (P j)))
    (f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (hf : Integrable f) :
    ‖pixelIntegral P f‖ ≤ ∫ z, |f z|

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceImage.norm_pixelIntegral_sub_le
statement:
theorem norm_pixelIntegral_sub_le (P : K → Set (ℝ × ℝ))
    (hm : ∀ k, MeasurableSet (P k)) (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (P i) (P j)))
    (f g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (hf : Integrable f) (hg : Integrable g) :
    ‖pixelIntegral P f - pixelIntegral P g‖ ≤ ∫ z, |f z - g z|

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceImage.pixelIntegral_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem pixelIntegral_apply (P : K → Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (k : K) :
    pixelIntegral P f k = ∫ z in P k, f z

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceImage.stabilityConstant_nonneg
statement:
theorem stabilityConstant_nonneg {σ A B : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B) :
    0 ≤ stabilityConstant σ A B

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceImage.norm_image_sub_le_finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost
statement:
theorem norm_image_sub_le_finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost
    {I J K : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype K]
    {σ A B : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (w : Weight A B)
    (P : K → Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (hm : ∀ k, MeasurableSet (P k))
    (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (P i) (P j)))
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i, (x i).1 < (x i).2) (hy : ∀ j, (y j).1 < (y j).2) :
    ‖image σ w P x - image σ w P y‖ ≤
      stabilityConstant σ A B * finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost x y

name: TDA.Persistence.Diagram.IsPositive.finiteOccurrence
statement:
theorem Diagram.IsPositive.finiteOccurrence {D : Diagram ℝ} (hD : D.IsPositive)
    (p : D.finiteOccurrences) : p.1.1 < p.1.2

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceImage.finiteDiagramImage_eq_zero_of_finitePart_eq_zero
statement:
theorem finiteDiagramImage_eq_zero_of_finitePart_eq_zero
    {K : Type*} [Fintype K] {A B : ℝ} (σ : ℝ) (w : Weight A B)
    (P : K → Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (D : Diagram ℝ) (hD : finitePart D.points = 0) :
    finiteDiagramImage σ w P D = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceImage.norm_finiteDiagramImage_sub_le_card_mul_bottleneck
statement:
theorem norm_finiteDiagramImage_sub_le_card_mul_bottleneck
    {K : Type*} [Fintype K] {σ A B : ℝ}
    (hσ : 0 < σ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (w : Weight A B)
    (P : K → Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (hm : ∀ k, MeasurableSet (P k))
    (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (P i) (P j)))
    (D E : Diagram ℝ) (hD : D.IsPositive) (hE : E.IsPositive)
    (hfinite : bottleneck D E < ⊤) :
    ‖finiteDiagramImage σ w P D - finiteDiagramImage σ w P E‖ ≤
      stabilityConstant σ A B *
        ((Fintype.card D.finiteOccurrences + Fintype.card E.finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) *
          (bottleneck D E).toReal

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleFamily.component_composite_shift
statement:
theorem component_composite_shift {ι κ ν : Type}
    [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [Fintype ν]
    (R : ι → Rectangle n) (S : κ → Rectangle n) (T : ν → Rectangle n) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (f : module (k := k) R ⟶ (shift ε).obj (module S))
    (g : module (k := k) S ⟶ (shift ε).obj (module T)) (i : ι) (l : ν) :
    (∑ j, component R S ε f i j ≫ (shift ε).map (component S T ε g j l)) ≫
        (compIso ε ε ((T l).module (k := k))).hom =
      component R T (ε + ε) (f ≫ (shift ε).map g ≫ (compIso ε ε (module T)).hom) i l

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleFamily.component_ext
statement:
theorem component_ext {ι κ : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (R : ι → Rectangle n) (S : κ → Rectangle n) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    {f g : module (k := k) R ⟶ (shift ε).obj (module S)}
    (h : ∀ i j, component R S ε f i j = component R S ε g i j) : f = g

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleFamily.component_mapOfComponents
statement:
theorem component_mapOfComponents {ι κ : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (R : ι → Rectangle n) (S : κ → Rectangle n) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (f : ∀ i j, (R i).module (k := k) ⟶ (shift ε).obj (S j).module)
    (i : ι) (j : κ) :
    component R S ε (mapOfComponents R S ε f) i j = f i j

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleFamily.component_transition_ne
statement:

    (R : ι → Rectangle n) (ε : ℝ≥0) {i l : ι} (h : i ≠ l) :
    component R R ε (transition ε (module (k := k) R)) i l = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleFamily.component_transition_self
statement:
theorem component_transition_self {ι : Type} [Fintype ι]
    (R : ι → Rectangle n) (ε : ℝ≥0) (i : ι) :
    component R R ε (transition ε (module (k := k) R)) i i =
      transition ε ((R i).module (k := k))

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleFamily.mapOfComponents_component
statement:
theorem mapOfComponents_component {ι κ : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (R : ι → Rectangle n) (S : κ → Rectangle n) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (f : module (k := k) R ⟶ (shift ε).obj (module S)) :
    mapOfComponents R S ε (component R S ε f) = f

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMatching.IsMatching.interleaving_component_zero
TDA.Persistence.RectangleMatching.IsMatching.interleaving_components
statement:
theorem IsMatching.interleaving_components {ι κ : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    {R : ι → Rectangle n} {S : κ → Rectangle n} {ε : ℝ≥0}
    {M : OccurrenceMatching ι κ PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1}}
    (hM : IsMatching (k := k) ε R S M) (i : ι) (j : κ) (h : M.finite i = some j) :
    ∃ I : CoordinateInterleaving ε ((R i).module (k := k)) (S j).module,
      component R S ε hM.interleaving.φ i j = I.φ ∧
      component S R ε hM.interleaving.ψ j i = I.ψ

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMatching.bottleneckDistance_le_interleavingDistance
statement:
theorem bottleneckDistance_le_interleavingDistance (hn : 0 < n)
    (R : ι → Rectangle n) (S : κ → Rectangle n) :
    bottleneckDistance (k := k) R S ≤ ((2 * n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) *
      coordinateInterleavingDistance (module (k := k) R) (module S)

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMatching.bottleneckDistance_le_of_matching
TDA.Persistence.RectangleMatching.bottleneckDistance_lt_iff
statement:
theorem bottleneckDistance_lt_iff (R : ι → Rectangle n) (S : κ → Rectangle n) (r : ℝ≥0∞) :
    bottleneckDistance (k := k) R S < r ↔
      ∃ (ε : ℝ≥0) (M : OccurrenceMatching ι κ PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1}),
        (ε : ℝ≥0∞) < r ∧ IsMatching (k := k) ε R S M

statement:

    (R : ι → Rectangle n) (S : κ → Rectangle n) :

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMatching.le_bottleneckDistance_iff
statement:
theorem le_bottleneckDistance_iff (R : ι → Rectangle n) (S : κ → Rectangle n) (r : ℝ≥0∞) :
    r ≤ bottleneckDistance (k := k) R S ↔ ∀ ε M, IsMatching (k := k) ε R S M → r ≤ ε

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMatching.two_sided_distance_bounds
statement:

      bottleneckDistance (k := k) R S ∧
    bottleneckDistance (k := k) R S ≤ ((2 * n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) *
      coordinateInterleavingDistance (module (k := k) R) (module S)

    realInterleavingDistance (RealBarcode.realize (k := ℚ) (diagram source source_pos))
      (RealBarcode.realize (diagram target target_pos)) = 1 ∧

      ∃ A : OccurrenceMatching Unit Unit PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1},
        A.cost farSource farTarget PEmpty.elim PEmpty.elim ≤ 1 ∧ A.finite () = none

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.cancelColumn_apply_above
statement:
theorem cancelColumn_apply_above [DecidableEq k] (a b : Fin m → k) (p r : Fin m)
    (ha : columnPivot a = some p) (hb : columnPivot b = some p) (hpr : p < r) :
    cancelColumn a b p r = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.cancelColumn_apply_pivot
statement:
theorem cancelColumn_apply_pivot [DecidableEq k] (a b : Fin m → k) (p : Fin m)
    (ha : columnPivot a = some p) : cancelColumn a b p p = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.col_mul_transvection
statement:
theorem col_mul_transvection (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (i j : Fin m) (c : k) :
    (M * Matrix.transvection i j c).col j = M.col j + c • M.col i

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.col_mul_transvection_of_ne
statement:
theorem col_mul_transvection_of_ne (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (i j q : Fin m) (c : k) (hq : q ≠ j) :
    (M * Matrix.transvection i j c).col q = M.col q

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.columnPivot_none_iff
statement:
theorem columnPivot_none_iff [DecidableEq k] (c : Fin m → k) :
    columnPivot c = none ↔ ∀ r, c r = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.columnPivot_some_iff
statement:
theorem columnPivot_some_iff [DecidableEq k] (c : Fin m → k) (p : Fin m) :
    columnPivot c = some p ↔ c p ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ r, p < r → c r = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.columnPivot_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem columnPivot_zero [DecidableEq k] :
    columnPivot (0 : Fin m → k) = none

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.pivotHeight_cancelColumn_lt
statement:
theorem pivotHeight_cancelColumn_lt [DecidableEq k] (a b : Fin m → k) (p : Fin m)
    (ha : columnPivot a = some p) (hb : columnPivot b = some p) :
    pivotHeight (columnPivot (cancelColumn a b p)) < pivotHeight (some p)

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.pivotHeight_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem pivotHeight_eq_zero_iff (q : Option (Fin m)) :
    pivotHeight q = 0 ↔ q = none

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.pivotHeight_mul_transvection_lt
statement:
theorem pivotHeight_mul_transvection_lt [DecidableEq k]
    (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (i j p : Fin m) (hij : i < j)
    (hi : columnPivot (M.col i) = some p) (hj : columnPivot (M.col j) = some p) :
    pivotHeight (columnPivot
      ((M * Matrix.transvection i j (-(M p j / M p i))).col j)) <
        pivotHeight (columnPivot (M.col j))

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.pivotHeight_none
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pivotHeight_none : pivotHeight (none : Option (Fin m)) = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.pivotHeight_some
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pivotHeight_some (p : Fin m) : pivotHeight (some p) = p.val + 1

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.col_mem_prefixSpan
statement:
theorem col_mem_prefixSpan (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (t : ℕ) (q : Fin m) (hq : q.val < t) :
    M.col q ∈ prefixSpan M t

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.prefixSpan_cancel
statement:
theorem prefixSpan_cancel (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (i j p : Fin m) (hij : i < j) (t : ℕ) :
    prefixSpan (M * Matrix.transvection i j (-(M p j / M p i))) t =
      prefixSpan M t

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.prefixSpan_eq_full
statement:
theorem prefixSpan_eq_full (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (t : ℕ) (ht : m ≤ t) :
    prefixSpan M t = Submodule.span k (Set.range M.col)

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.prefixSpan_mono
statement:
theorem prefixSpan_mono (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (s t : ℕ) (hst : s ≤ t) :
    prefixSpan M s ≤ prefixSpan M t

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.prefixSpan_mul_transvection
statement:
theorem prefixSpan_mul_transvection (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (i j : Fin m) (c : k) (hij : i < j) (t : ℕ) :
    prefixSpan (M * Matrix.transvection i j c) t = prefixSpan M t

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.prefixSpan_zero
statement:
theorem prefixSpan_zero (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) :
    prefixSpan M 0 = ⊥

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.prefixSpan_mul_traceChange
statement:
theorem prefixSpan_mul_traceChange (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (ops : List (EarlierColumnOp m k)) (t : ℕ) :
    prefixSpan (M * traceChange ops) t = prefixSpan M t

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.prefixSpan_replay
statement:
theorem prefixSpan_replay (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (ops : List (EarlierColumnOp m k)) (t : ℕ) :
    prefixSpan (replay M ops) t = prefixSpan M t

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.replay_append
statement:
theorem replay_append (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (xs ys : List (EarlierColumnOp m k)) :
    replay M (xs ++ ys) = replay (replay M xs) ys

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.replay_cons
statement:
theorem replay_cons (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (op : EarlierColumnOp m k) (ops : List (EarlierColumnOp m k)) :
    replay M (op :: ops) = replay (M * op.1.toMatrix) ops

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.replay_eq_mul_traceChange
statement:
theorem replay_eq_mul_traceChange (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (ops : List (EarlierColumnOp m k)) :
    replay M ops = M * traceChange ops

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.replay_nil
statement: theorem replay_nil (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) : replay M [] = M

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.traceChange_append
statement:
theorem traceChange_append (xs ys : List (EarlierColumnOp m k)) :
    traceChange (xs ++ ys) = traceChange xs * traceChange ys

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.traceChange_cons
statement:
theorem traceChange_cons (op : EarlierColumnOp m k)
    (ops : List (EarlierColumnOp m k)) :
    traceChange (op :: ops) = op.1.toMatrix * traceChange ops

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.traceChange_nil
statement: theorem traceChange_nil : traceChange ([] : List (EarlierColumnOp m k)) = 1

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.degree_eq_of_common_pivot
statement:
theorem degree_eq_of_common_pivot [DecidableEq k] (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (hM : LowersDegree degree M)
    (i j p : Fin m) (hi : columnPivot (M.col i) = some p)
    (hj : columnPivot (M.col j) = some p) : degree i = degree j

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.replay_inverseTrace
statement:
theorem replay_inverseTrace (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (ops : List (EarlierColumnOp m k)) :
    replay (replay M ops) (inverseTrace ops) = M

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.replay_lowersDegree
statement:
theorem replay_lowersDegree (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (ops : List (EarlierColumnOp m k))
    (hM : LowersDegree degree M) (hops : TraceRespectsDegree degree ops) :
    LowersDegree degree (replay M ops)

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.traceChangeInv_append
statement:
theorem traceChangeInv_append (xs ys : List (EarlierColumnOp m k)) :
    traceChangeInv (xs ++ ys) = traceChangeInv ys * traceChangeInv xs

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.traceChangeInv_cons
statement:
theorem traceChangeInv_cons (op : EarlierColumnOp m k)
    (ops : List (EarlierColumnOp m k)) :
    traceChangeInv (op :: ops) = traceChangeInv ops * op.1.inv.toMatrix

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.traceChangeInv_mul_traceChange
statement:
theorem traceChangeInv_mul_traceChange (ops : List (EarlierColumnOp m k)) :
    traceChangeInv ops * traceChange ops = 1

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.traceChangeInv_nil
statement:
theorem traceChangeInv_nil :
    traceChangeInv ([] : List (EarlierColumnOp m k)) = 1

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.traceChange_apply_diag
statement:
theorem traceChange_apply_diag (ops : List (EarlierColumnOp m k)) (i : Fin m) :
    traceChange ops i i = 1

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.traceChange_apply_of_degree_ne
statement:
theorem traceChange_apply_of_degree_ne (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (ops : List (EarlierColumnOp m k)) (hops : TraceRespectsDegree degree ops)
    (i j : Fin m) (hij : degree i ≠ degree j) :
    traceChange ops i j = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.traceChange_certificate
statement:
theorem traceChange_certificate (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (ops : List (EarlierColumnOp m k)) (hops : TraceRespectsDegree degree ops) :
    TraceChangeCertificate degree (traceChange ops) (traceChangeInv ops)

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.traceChange_isUpperTriangular
statement:
theorem traceChange_isUpperTriangular (ops : List (EarlierColumnOp m k)) :
    (traceChange ops).IsUpperTriangular

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.traceChange_mul_traceChangeInv
statement:
theorem traceChange_mul_traceChangeInv (ops : List (EarlierColumnOp m k)) :
    traceChange ops * traceChangeInv ops = 1

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.traceRespectsDegree_inverseTrace
statement:
theorem traceRespectsDegree_inverseTrace (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (ops : List (EarlierColumnOp m k)) (hops : TraceRespectsDegree degree ops) :
    TraceRespectsDegree degree (inverseTrace ops)

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.columnReductionTrace_col_of_ne
statement:
theorem columnReductionTrace_col_of_ne
    (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (j q : Fin m) (hq : q ≠ j) :
    (replay M (columnReductionTrace M j)).col q = M.col q

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.columnReductionTrace_eq_nil_iff
statement:
theorem columnReductionTrace_eq_nil_iff
    (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (j : Fin m) :
    columnReductionTrace M j = [] ↔
      ∀ i : Fin m, i < j → ∀ p : Fin m,
        columnPivot (M.col i) = some p → columnPivot (M.col j) ≠ some p

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.columnReductionTrace_length_le
statement:
theorem columnReductionTrace_length_le
    (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (j : Fin m) :
    (columnReductionTrace M j).length ≤
      pivotHeight (columnPivot (M.col j))

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.columnReductionTrace_respectsDegree
statement:
theorem columnReductionTrace_respectsDegree
    (degree : Fin m → ℕ) (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (j : Fin m)
    (hM : LowersDegree degree M) :
    TraceRespectsDegree degree (columnReductionTrace M j)

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.columnReductionTrace_step_spec
statement:
theorem columnReductionTrace_step_spec
    (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (j : Fin m)
    (pre post : List (EarlierColumnOp m k)) (op : EarlierColumnOp m k)
    (htrace : columnReductionTrace M j = pre ++ (op :: post)) :
    let A := replay M pre
    op.1.j = j ∧ ∃ p : Fin m,
      columnPivot (A.col j) = some p ∧
      columnPivot (A.col op.1.i) = some p ∧
      (∀ i : Fin m, i < j → columnPivot (A.col i) = some p → op.1.i ≤ i) ∧
      op.1.c = -(A p j / A p op.1.i) ∧
      pivotHeight (columnPivot ((A * op.1.toMatrix).col j)) <
        pivotHeight (columnPivot (A.col j))

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.columnReductionTrace_target
statement:
theorem columnReductionTrace_target
    (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (j : Fin m)
    (op : EarlierColumnOp m k) (hop : op ∈ columnReductionTrace M j) :
    op.1.j = j

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.columnReductionTrace_terminal
statement:
theorem columnReductionTrace_terminal
    (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (j i : Fin m) (hij : i < j)
    (p : Fin m) (hi : columnPivot (M.col i) = some p) :
    columnPivot ((replay M (columnReductionTrace M j)).col j) ≠ some p

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.matrixReductionTrace_certificate
statement:
theorem matrixReductionTrace_certificate
    (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) :
    let ops := matrixReductionTrace M
    let R := replay M ops
    let V := traceChange ops
    let W := traceChangeInv ops
    R = M * V ∧ V * W = 1 ∧ W * V = 1 ∧
    V.IsUpperTriangular ∧ (∀ i, V i i = 1) ∧
    W.IsUpperTriangular ∧ (∀ i, W i i = 1) ∧
    replay R (inverseTrace ops) = M ∧
    (∀ s : ℕ, prefixSpan R s = prefixSpan M s)

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.matrixReductionTrace_graded_certificate
statement:
theorem matrixReductionTrace_graded_certificate
    (degree : Fin m → ℕ) (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hM : LowersDegree degree M) :
    let ops := matrixReductionTrace M
    let R := replay M ops
    let V := traceChange ops
    let W := traceChangeInv ops
    R = M * V ∧ V * W = 1 ∧ W * V = 1 ∧
    V.IsUpperTriangular ∧ (∀ i, V i i = 1) ∧
    W.IsUpperTriangular ∧ (∀ i, W i i = 1) ∧
    replay R (inverseTrace ops) = M ∧
    (∀ s : ℕ, prefixSpan R s = prefixSpan M s) ∧
    TraceChangeCertificate degree V W ∧ LowersDegree degree R

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.matrixReductionTrace_length_le
statement:
theorem matrixReductionTrace_length_le
    (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) :
    (matrixReductionTrace M).length ≤
      ∑ j : Fin m, pivotHeight (columnPivot (M.col j))

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.matrixReductionTrace_pivots_distinct
statement:
theorem matrixReductionTrace_pivots_distinct
    (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (i j p : Fin m)
    (hi : columnPivot ((replay M (matrixReductionTrace M)).col i) = some p)
    (hj : columnPivot ((replay M (matrixReductionTrace M)).col j) = some p) :
    i = j

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.matrixReductionTrace_respectsDegree
statement:
theorem matrixReductionTrace_respectsDegree
    (degree : Fin m → ℕ) (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hM : LowersDegree degree M) :
    TraceRespectsDegree degree (matrixReductionTrace M)

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.matrixReductionTrace_step_spec
statement:
theorem matrixReductionTrace_step_spec
    (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (pre post : List (EarlierColumnOp m k)) (op : EarlierColumnOp m k)
    (htrace : matrixReductionTrace M = pre ++ (op :: post)) :
    let A := replay M pre
    ∃ p : Fin m,
      columnPivot (A.col op.1.j) = some p ∧
      columnPivot (A.col op.1.i) = some p ∧
      (∀ i : Fin m, i < op.1.j →
        columnPivot (A.col i) = some p → op.1.i ≤ i) ∧
      op.1.c = -(A p op.1.j / A p op.1.i) ∧
      pivotHeight (columnPivot ((A * op.1.toMatrix).col op.1.j)) <
        pivotHeight (columnPivot (A.col op.1.j))

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.deathOfPivot_spec
statement:
theorem deathOfPivot_spec (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (i : Fin m) (hi : IsPivot R i) :
    columnPivot (R.col (deathOfPivot R i hi)) = some i

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.deathOfPivot_unique
statement:
theorem deathOfPivot_unique (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hpiv : DistinctPivots R) (i j : Fin m)
    (hi : IsPivot R i) (hj : columnPivot (R.col j) = some i) :
    deathOfPivot R i hi = j

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.degree_zero_boundary
statement:
theorem degree_zero_boundary (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (D : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (hdegree : LowersDegree degree D)
    (j : Fin m) (hj : degree j = 0) : D.col j = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.matrixReductionTrace_normalForm_input
statement:
theorem matrixReductionTrace_normalForm_input (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (D : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hD2 : D * D = 0) (hstrict : StrictBoundary D)
    (hdegree : LowersDegree degree D) :
    let ops := matrixReductionTrace D
    let R := replay D ops
    let V := traceChange ops
    let W := traceChangeInv ops
    R = D * V ∧ TraceChangeCertificate degree V W ∧
      LowersDegree degree R ∧ StrictBoundary R ∧ DistinctPivots R ∧
      (∀ j i, columnPivot (R.col j) = some i → columnPivot (R.col i) = none)

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.normalColumn_death_boundary
statement:
theorem normalColumn_death_boundary (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (D R V W : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hD2 : D * D = 0) (hR : R = D * V)
    (hcert : TraceChangeCertificate degree V W)
    (hpiv : DistinctPivots R) (j i : Fin m)
    (hji : columnPivot (R.col j) = some i) :
    D.mulVec (normalColumn R V j) = R i j • normalColumn R V i

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.normalColumn_nonpivot
statement:
theorem normalColumn_nonpivot (R V : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (i : Fin m) (hi : ¬ IsPivot R i) : normalColumn R V i = V.col i

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.normalColumn_pivot
statement:
theorem normalColumn_pivot (R V : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (i : Fin m) (hi : IsPivot R i) :
    normalColumn R V i =
      (R i (deathOfPivot R i hi))⁻¹ • R.col (deathOfPivot R i hi)

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.normalColumn_pivot_boundary
statement:
theorem normalColumn_pivot_boundary (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (D R V W : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hD2 : D * D = 0) (hR : R = D * V)
    (i : Fin m) (hi : IsPivot R i) :
    D.mulVec (normalColumn R V i) = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.normalColumn_zero_boundary
statement:
theorem normalColumn_zero_boundary (D R V : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hR : R = D * V) (i : Fin m)
    (hzero : columnPivot (R.col i) = none)
    (hi : ¬ IsPivot R i) : D.mulVec (normalColumn R V i) = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.normalDifferential_cycle_iff
statement:
theorem normalDifferential_cycle_iff (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hpiv : DistinctPivots R) (x : Fin m → k) :
    (normalDifferential R).mulVec x = 0 ↔
      ∀ j, IsDeath R j → x j = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.normalDifferential_degree
statement:
theorem normalDifferential_degree (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hR : LowersDegree degree R) :
    LowersDegree degree (normalDifferential R)

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.normalDifferential_image_nonpivot
statement:
theorem normalDifferential_image_nonpivot (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (x : Fin m → k) (i : Fin m) (hi : ¬ IsPivot R i) :
    (normalDifferential R).mulVec x i = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.normalDifferential_mulVec_nonpivot
statement:
theorem normalDifferential_mulVec_nonpivot (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (x : Fin m → k) (i : Fin m) (hi : ¬ IsPivot R i) :
    (normalDifferential R).mulVec x i = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.normalDifferential_mulVec_pivot
statement:
theorem normalDifferential_mulVec_pivot (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hpiv : DistinctPivots R) (x : Fin m → k)
    (i : Fin m) (hi : IsPivot R i) :
    (normalDifferential R).mulVec x i =
      R i (deathOfPivot R i hi) * x (deathOfPivot R i hi)

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.normalDifferential_pair_column
statement:
theorem normalDifferential_pair_column (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (j i : Fin m) (hji : columnPivot (R.col j) = some i) :
    (normalDifferential R).col j = R i j • Pi.single i (1 : k)

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.normalDifferential_strict
statement:
theorem normalDifferential_strict (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hR : StrictBoundary R) : StrictBoundary (normalDifferential R)

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.normalDifferential_zero_column
statement:
theorem normalDifferential_zero_column (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (j : Fin m) (hj : columnPivot (R.col j) = none) :
    (normalDifferential R).col j = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.normalMatrix_conjugates_boundary
statement:
theorem normalMatrix_conjugates_boundary (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (D R V W : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hD2 : D * D = 0) (hR : R = D * V)
    (hcert : TraceChangeCertificate degree V W)
    (hpiv : DistinctPivots R) :
    D * normalMatrix R V = normalMatrix R V * normalDifferential R

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.normalMatrix_degree
statement:
theorem normalMatrix_degree (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (R V : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hdegree : LowersDegree degree R)
    (hV : ∀ r i, degree r ≠ degree i → V r i = 0)
    (r i : Fin m) (hri : degree r ≠ degree i) :
    normalMatrix R V r i = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.normalMatrix_det
statement:
theorem normalMatrix_det (R V : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hV : V.IsUpperTriangular) (hdiag : ∀ i, V i i = 1) :
    (normalMatrix R V).det = 1

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.normalMatrix_diag
statement:
theorem normalMatrix_diag (R V : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hV : ∀ i, V i i = 1) (i : Fin m) : normalMatrix R V i i = 1

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.normalMatrix_inv_degree
statement:
theorem normalMatrix_inv_degree (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (R V : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hVupper : V.IsUpperTriangular) (hVdiag : ∀ i, V i i = 1)
    (hdegree : LowersDegree degree R)
    (hVdegree : ∀ r i, degree r ≠ degree i → V r i = 0)
    (r i : Fin m) (hri : degree r ≠ degree i) :
    (normalMatrix R V)⁻¹ r i = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.normalMatrix_inv_mul
statement:
theorem normalMatrix_inv_mul (R V : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hV : V.IsUpperTriangular) (hdiag : ∀ i, V i i = 1) :
    (normalMatrix R V)⁻¹ * normalMatrix R V = 1

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.normalMatrix_inv_prefix
statement:
theorem normalMatrix_inv_prefix (R V : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hV : V.IsUpperTriangular) (hdiag : ∀ i, V i i = 1)
    (t : ℕ) (x : Fin m → k) (hx : PrefixSupported t x) :

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.normalMatrix_inv_upper
statement:
theorem normalMatrix_inv_upper (R V : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hV : V.IsUpperTriangular) (hdiag : ∀ i, V i i = 1) :
    ((normalMatrix R V)⁻¹).IsUpperTriangular

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.normalMatrix_isUnit
statement:
theorem normalMatrix_isUnit (R V : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hV : V.IsUpperTriangular) (hdiag : ∀ i, V i i = 1) :
