name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.normalMatrix_mul_inv
statement:
theorem normalMatrix_mul_inv (R V : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hV : V.IsUpperTriangular) (hdiag : ∀ i, V i i = 1) :
    normalMatrix R V * (normalMatrix R V)⁻¹ = 1

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.normalMatrix_prefix
statement:
theorem normalMatrix_prefix (R V : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hV : V.IsUpperTriangular) (t : ℕ) (x : Fin m → k)
    (hx : PrefixSupported t x) :
    PrefixSupported t ((normalMatrix R V).mulVec x)

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.normalMatrix_upper
statement:
theorem normalMatrix_upper (R V : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hV : V.IsUpperTriangular) : (normalMatrix R V).IsUpperTriangular

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.pivot_column_zero
statement:
theorem pivot_column_zero (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (D R V W : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hD2 : D * D = 0) (hR : R = D * V)
    (hcert : TraceChangeCertificate degree V W)
    (hpiv : DistinctPivots R) (j i : Fin m)
    (hji : columnPivot (R.col j) = some i) :
    columnPivot (R.col i) = none

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.pivot_death_essential
statement:
theorem pivot_death_essential (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (D R V W : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hD2 : D * D = 0) (hR : R = D * V)
    (hcert : TraceChangeCertificate degree V W)
    (hpiv : DistinctPivots R) (i : Fin m) :
    (IsPivot R i ∧ ¬ IsDeath R i ∧ ¬ IsEssential R i) ∨
    (IsDeath R i ∧ ¬ IsPivot R i ∧ ¬ IsEssential R i) ∨
    (IsEssential R i ∧ ¬ IsPivot R i ∧ ¬ IsDeath R i)

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.pivot_not_death
statement:
theorem pivot_not_death (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (D R V W : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hD2 : D * D = 0) (hR : R = D * V)
    (hcert : TraceChangeCertificate degree V W)
    (hpiv : DistinctPivots R) (i : Fin m) (hi : IsPivot R i) :
    columnPivot (R.col i) = none

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.pivot_order_degree
statement:
theorem pivot_order_degree (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hstrict : StrictBoundary R) (hdegree : LowersDegree degree R)
    (j i : Fin m) (hji : columnPivot (R.col j) = some i) :
    i < j ∧ degree j = degree i + 1

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.reduced_mulVec_kernel
statement:
theorem reduced_mulVec_kernel (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hpiv : DistinctPivots R) (a : Fin m → k) (hker : R.mulVec a = 0)
    (j : Fin m) (hj : IsDeath R j) : a j = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.reduced_strict
statement:
theorem reduced_strict (D V R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hD : StrictBoundary D) (hV : V.IsUpperTriangular) (hR : R = D * V) :
    StrictBoundary R

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.strict_boundary_prefix
statement:
theorem strict_boundary_prefix (D : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hD : StrictBoundary D) (t : ℕ) (x : Fin m → k)
    (hx : PrefixSupported t x) : PrefixSupported t (D.mulVec x)

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.upper_mulVec_prefix
statement:
theorem upper_mulVec_prefix (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hA : A.IsUpperTriangular) (t : ℕ) (x : Fin m → k)
    (hx : PrefixSupported t x) : PrefixSupported t (A.mulVec x)

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.aliveRepresentative_cycle
statement:
theorem aliveRepresentative_cycle (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (D R V W : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hD2 : D * D = 0) (hR : R = D * V)
    (hcert : TraceChangeCertificate degree V W)
    (hpiv : DistinctPivots R) (p t : ℕ) (x : Fin m → k) :
    NormalCycle degree R p t (aliveRepresentative degree R p t x)

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.aliveRepresentative_degree
statement:
theorem aliveRepresentative_degree (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (p t : ℕ) (x : Fin m → k) :
    Homogeneous degree p (aliveRepresentative degree R p t x)

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.aliveRepresentative_mem_aliveSpace
statement:
theorem aliveRepresentative_mem_aliveSpace (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (p t : ℕ) (x : Fin m → k) :
    aliveRepresentative degree R p t x ∈ aliveSpace degree R p t

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.aliveRepresentative_of_mem
statement:
theorem aliveRepresentative_of_mem (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (p t : ℕ)
    (x : Fin m → k) (hx : x ∈ aliveSpace degree R p t) :
    aliveRepresentative degree R p t x = x

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.aliveRepresentative_prefix
statement:
theorem aliveRepresentative_prefix (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (p t : ℕ) (x : Fin m → k) :
    PrefixSupported t (aliveRepresentative degree R p t x)

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.aliveRepresentative_single_dies
statement:
theorem aliveRepresentative_single_dies (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (p t : ℕ)
    (i : Fin m) (hi : ¬ AliveCoordinate degree R p t i) :
    aliveRepresentative degree R p t ((Pi.single i (1 : k)) : Fin m → k) = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.aliveRepresentative_single_survives
statement:
theorem aliveRepresentative_single_survives (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (p t : ℕ)
    (i : Fin m) (hi : AliveCoordinate degree R p t i) :
    aliveRepresentative degree R p t ((Pi.single i (1 : k)) : Fin m → k) =
      Pi.single i (1 : k)

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.aliveRepresentative_transition
statement:
theorem aliveRepresentative_transition (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (p s t : ℕ) (hst : s ≤ t)
    (x : Fin m → k) (hx : PrefixSupported s x) :
    aliveRepresentative degree R p t (aliveRepresentative degree R p s x) =
      aliveRepresentative degree R p t x

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.aliveSpaceMap_comp
statement:
theorem aliveSpaceMap_comp (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (p s t u : ℕ)
    (hst : s ≤ t) (htu : t ≤ u) :
    (aliveSpaceMap degree R p t u).comp (aliveSpaceMap degree R p s t) =
      aliveSpaceMap degree R p s u

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.aliveSpaceMap_id
statement:
theorem aliveSpaceMap_id (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (p t : ℕ) :
    aliveSpaceMap degree R p t t = LinearMap.id

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.aliveSpaceMap_range_iff
statement:
theorem aliveSpaceMap_range_iff (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (p s t : ℕ)
    (y : aliveSpace degree R p t) :
    y ∈ LinearMap.range (aliveSpaceMap degree R p s t) ↔
      ∀ i, ¬ AliveCoordinate degree R p s i → y.1 i = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.aliveSpaceMap_rank
statement:
theorem aliveSpaceMap_rank (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (p s t : ℕ) :
    Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (aliveSpaceMap degree R p s t)) =
      (survivorFinset degree R p s t).card

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.aliveSpaceMap_rank_formula
statement:
theorem aliveSpaceMap_rank_formula (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (hpiv : DistinctPivots R)
    (p s t : ℕ) (hst : s ≤ t) :
    Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (aliveSpaceMap degree R p s t)) =
      (deathSurvivorFinset degree R p s t).card +
        (essentialSurvivorFinset degree R p s).card

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.aliveSpace_eq_spanSubset
statement:
theorem aliveSpace_eq_spanSubset (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (p t : ℕ) :
    aliveSpace degree R p t =
      Pi.spanSubset k {i | AliveCoordinate degree R p t i}

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.aliveSpace_prefix
statement:
theorem aliveSpace_prefix (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (p t : ℕ)
    (x : aliveSpace degree R p t) : PrefixSupported t x.1

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.cycleLiveMap_surjective
statement:
theorem cycleLiveMap_surjective (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (D R V W : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hD2 : D * D = 0) (hR : R = D * V)
    (hcert : TraceChangeCertificate degree V W)
    (hpiv : DistinctPivots R) (p t : ℕ) :
    Function.Surjective (cycleLiveMap degree R p t)

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.essentialAlive_iff_essentialInterval
statement:
theorem essentialAlive_iff_essentialInterval (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (i : Fin m) (hi : IsEssential R i) (t : Fin (m + 1)) :
    EssentialAlive R t.val i ↔ (essentialInterval i).alive t

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.essentialInterval_alive_iff
statement:
theorem essentialInterval_alive_iff (i : Fin m) (t : Fin (m + 1)) :
    (essentialInterval i).alive t ↔ i.val < t.val

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.expiredBoundary_pivot
statement:
theorem expiredBoundary_pivot (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (hpiv : DistinctPivots R)
    (p t : ℕ) (x : Fin m → k) (i : Fin m) (hi : IsPivot R i) :
    (normalDifferential R).mulVec (expiredPreimage degree R p t x) i =
      if (deathOfPivot R i hi).val < t ∧ degree i = p then x i else 0

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.expiredPreimage_degree
statement:
theorem expiredPreimage_degree (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hdegree : LowersDegree degree R) (p t : ℕ) (x : Fin m → k) :
    Homogeneous degree (p + 1) (expiredPreimage degree R p t x)

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.expiredPreimage_pivot
statement:
theorem expiredPreimage_pivot (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (p t : ℕ)
    (x : Fin m → k) (j i : Fin m)
    (hji : columnPivot (R.col j) = some i) :
    expiredPreimage degree R p t x j =
      if j.val < t ∧ degree i = p then x i / R i j else 0

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.expiredPreimage_prefix
statement:
theorem expiredPreimage_prefix (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (p t : ℕ) (x : Fin m → k) :
    PrefixSupported t (expiredPreimage degree R p t x)

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.lowers_mulVec_homogeneous
statement:
theorem lowers_mulVec_homogeneous (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (hM : LowersDegree degree M)
    (p : ℕ) (x : Fin m → k) (hx : Homogeneous degree (p + 1) x) :
    Homogeneous degree p (M.mulVec x)

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.normalBoundary_alive_zero
statement:
theorem normalBoundary_alive_zero (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (hpivR : DistinctPivots R) (p t : ℕ)
    (x : Fin m → k) (hx : NormalBoundary degree R p t x)
    (i : Fin m) (hi : AliveCoordinate degree R p t i) : x i = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.normalBoundary_isCycle
statement:
theorem normalBoundary_isCycle (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (D R V W : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hD2 : D * D = 0) (hR : R = D * V)
    (hcert : TraceChangeCertificate degree V W)
    (hpiv : DistinctPivots R) (p t : ℕ)
    (x : Fin m → k) (hx : NormalBoundary degree R p t x) :
    (normalDifferential R).mulVec x = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.normalBoundary_prefix_inclusion
statement:
theorem normalBoundary_prefix_inclusion (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (p s t : ℕ) (hst : s ≤ t)
    (x : Fin m → k) (hx : NormalBoundary degree R p s x) :
    NormalBoundary degree R p t x

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.normalCycle_boundary_iff_live_zero
statement:
theorem normalCycle_boundary_iff_live_zero (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (D R V W : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hD2 : D * D = 0) (hR : R = D * V)
    (hcert : TraceChangeCertificate degree V W)
    (hdegreeR : LowersDegree degree R)
    (hpiv : DistinctPivots R) (p t : ℕ)
    (x : Fin m → k) (hx : NormalCycle degree R p t x) :
    NormalBoundary degree R p t x ↔
      aliveRepresentative degree R p t x = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.normalCycle_decompose
statement:
theorem normalCycle_decompose (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (D R V W : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hD2 : D * D = 0) (hR : R = D * V)
    (hcert : TraceChangeCertificate degree V W)
    (hpiv : DistinctPivots R) (p t : ℕ)
    (x : Fin m → k) (hx : NormalCycle degree R p t x) :
    x = aliveRepresentative degree R p t x +
      (normalDifferential R).mulVec (expiredPreimage degree R p t x)

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.normalCycle_prefix_inclusion
statement:
theorem normalCycle_prefix_inclusion (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (p s t : ℕ) (hst : s ≤ t)
    (x : Fin m → k) (hx : NormalCycle degree R p s x) :
    NormalCycle degree R p t x

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.normalDifferential_sq_zero
statement:
theorem normalDifferential_sq_zero (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (D R V W : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hD2 : D * D = 0) (hR : R = D * V)
    (hcert : TraceChangeCertificate degree V W)
    (hpiv : DistinctPivots R) (x : Fin m → k) :
    (normalDifferential R).mulVec ((normalDifferential R).mulVec x) = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.normalHomologyMap_mk
statement:
theorem normalHomologyMap_mk (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (D R V W : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hD2 : D * D = 0) (hR : R = D * V)
    (hcert : TraceChangeCertificate degree V W)
    (hpiv : DistinctPivots R) (p s t : ℕ) (hst : s ≤ t)
    (x : normalCycleSpace degree R p s) :
    (normalHomologyEquivAlive degree D R V W hD2 hR hcert hpiv p t)
      (normalHomologyMap degree D R V W hD2 hR hcert hpiv p s t
        (Submodule.Quotient.mk x)) =
      ⟨aliveRepresentative degree R p t x.1,
        aliveRepresentative_mem_aliveSpace degree R p t x.1⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.normalHomologyMap_rank_formula
statement:
theorem normalHomologyMap_rank_formula (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (D R V W : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hD2 : D * D = 0) (hR : R = D * V)
    (hcert : TraceChangeCertificate degree V W)
    (hpiv : DistinctPivots R) (p s t : ℕ) (hst : s ≤ t) :
    Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range
      (normalHomologyMap degree D R V W hD2 hR hcert hpiv p s t)) =
      (deathSurvivorFinset degree R p s t).card +
        (essentialSurvivorFinset degree R p s).card

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.normalHomologyMap_transport
statement:
theorem normalHomologyMap_transport (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (D R V W : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hD2 : D * D = 0) (hR : R = D * V)
    (hcert : TraceChangeCertificate degree V W)
    (hpiv : DistinctPivots R) (p s t : ℕ)
    (x : normalHomology degree R p s) :
    (normalHomologyEquivAlive degree D R V W hD2 hR hcert hpiv p t)
      (normalHomologyMap degree D R V W hD2 hR hcert hpiv p s t x) =
    aliveSpaceMap degree R p s t
      ((normalHomologyEquivAlive degree D R V W hD2 hR hcert hpiv p s) x)

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.normalHomology_kernel_eq_boundaries
statement:
theorem normalHomology_kernel_eq_boundaries (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (D R V W : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hD2 : D * D = 0) (hR : R = D * V)
    (hcert : TraceChangeCertificate degree V W)
    (hdegreeR : LowersDegree degree R)
    (hpiv : DistinctPivots R) (p t : ℕ)
    (x : normalCycleSpace degree R p t) :
    x ∈ LinearMap.ker (cycleLiveMap degree R p t) ↔
      NormalBoundary degree R p t x.1

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.pair_essential_disjoint
statement:
theorem pair_essential_disjoint (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (p s t : ℕ) :
    Disjoint (pairSurvivorFinset degree R p s t)
      (essentialSurvivorFinset degree R p s)

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.pair_survivor_card_eq_death_card
statement:
theorem pair_survivor_card_eq_death_card (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (hpiv : DistinctPivots R)
    (p s t : ℕ) :
    (pairSurvivorFinset degree R p s t).card =
      (deathSurvivorFinset degree R p s t).card

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.pairedInterval_alive_iff
statement:
theorem pairedInterval_alive_iff (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hstrict : StrictBoundary R) (j i : Fin m)
    (hji : columnPivot (R.col j) = some i) (t : Fin (m + 1)) :
    (pairedInterval R hstrict j i hji).alive t ↔
      i.val < t.val ∧ t.val ≤ j.val

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.pivotAlive_iff
statement:
theorem pivotAlive_iff (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (t : ℕ) (i : Fin m) (hi : IsPivot R i) :
    PivotAlive R t i ↔ i.val < t ∧ t ≤ (deathOfPivot R i hi).val

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.pivotAlive_iff_pairedInterval
statement:
theorem pivotAlive_iff_pairedInterval (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hstrict : StrictBoundary R) (i : Fin m) (hi : IsPivot R i)
    (t : Fin (m + 1)) :
    PivotAlive R t.val i ↔
      (pairedInterval R hstrict (deathOfPivot R i hi) i
        (deathOfPivot_spec R i hi)).alive t

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.survivorFinset_partition
statement:
theorem survivorFinset_partition (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (p s t : ℕ) (hst : s ≤ t) :
    survivorFinset degree R p s t =
      pairSurvivorFinset degree R p s t ∪
        essentialSurvivorFinset degree R p s

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.survivor_iff_pairs_or_essential
statement:
theorem survivor_iff_pairs_or_essential (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (p s t : ℕ) (hst : s ≤ t)
    (i : Fin m) :
    Survivor degree R p s t i ↔
      (∃ hi : IsPivot R i, degree i = p ∧ i.val < s ∧
        t ≤ (deathOfPivot R i hi).val) ∨
      (IsEssential R i ∧ degree i = p ∧ i.val < s)

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.grade_preserving_mulVec
statement:
theorem grade_preserving_mulVec (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hA : ∀ r i, degree r ≠ degree i → A r i = 0)
    (p : ℕ) (x : Fin m → k) (hx : Homogeneous degree p x) :
    Homogeneous degree p (A.mulVec x)

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.matrixReductionTrace_originalHomologyMap_rank_formula
statement:
theorem matrixReductionTrace_originalHomologyMap_rank_formula
    (degree : Fin m → ℕ) (D : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hD2 : D * D = 0) (hstrict : StrictBoundary D)
    (hdegree : LowersDegree degree D)
    (p s t : ℕ) (hst : s ≤ t) (ht : t ≤ m) :
    let ops := matrixReductionTrace D
    let R := replay D ops
    let V := traceChange ops
    let W := traceChangeInv ops
    Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range
      (originalHomologyMap degree D R V W hD2
        (matrixReductionTrace_normalForm_input degree D hD2 hstrict hdegree).1
        (matrixReductionTrace_normalForm_input degree D hD2 hstrict hdegree).2.1
        (matrixReductionTrace_normalForm_input degree D hD2 hstrict hdegree).2.2.1
        (matrixReductionTrace_normalForm_input degree D hD2 hstrict hdegree).2.2.2.2.1
        p s t)) =
      (deathSurvivorFinset degree R p s t).card +
        (essentialSurvivorFinset degree R p s).card

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.normalBoundary_iff_originalBoundary
statement:
theorem normalBoundary_iff_originalBoundary (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (D R V W : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hD2 : D * D = 0) (hR : R = D * V)
    (hcert : TraceChangeCertificate degree V W)
    (hRdegree : LowersDegree degree R)
    (hpiv : DistinctPivots R) (p t : ℕ) (x : Fin m → k) :
    NormalBoundary degree R p t x ↔
      OriginalBoundary degree D p t ((normalMatrix R V).mulVec x)

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.normalCycle_iff_originalCycle
statement:
theorem normalCycle_iff_originalCycle (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (D R V W : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hD2 : D * D = 0) (hR : R = D * V)
    (hcert : TraceChangeCertificate degree V W)
    (hRdegree : LowersDegree degree R)
    (hpiv : DistinctPivots R) (p t : ℕ) (x : Fin m → k) :
    NormalCycle degree R p t x ↔
      OriginalCycle degree D p t ((normalMatrix R V).mulVec x)

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.normalMatrix_boundary_mulVec
statement:
theorem normalMatrix_boundary_mulVec (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (D R V W : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hD2 : D * D = 0) (hR : R = D * V)
    (hcert : TraceChangeCertificate degree V W)
    (hpiv : DistinctPivots R) (x : Fin m → k) :
    D.mulVec ((normalMatrix R V).mulVec x) =
      (normalMatrix R V).mulVec ((normalDifferential R).mulVec x)

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.normalMatrix_inv_mulVec
statement:
theorem normalMatrix_inv_mulVec (R V : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hV : V.IsUpperTriangular) (hdiag : ∀ i, V i i = 1)
    (x : Fin m → k) :
    ((normalMatrix R V)⁻¹).mulVec ((normalMatrix R V).mulVec x) = x

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.normalMatrix_mulVec_inv
statement:
theorem normalMatrix_mulVec_inv (R V : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hV : V.IsUpperTriangular) (hdiag : ∀ i, V i i = 1)
    (x : Fin m → k) :
    (normalMatrix R V).mulVec (((normalMatrix R V)⁻¹).mulVec x) = x

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.originalHomologyMap_comp
statement:
theorem originalHomologyMap_comp (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (D R V W : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hD2 : D * D = 0) (hR : R = D * V)
    (hcert : TraceChangeCertificate degree V W)
    (hRdegree : LowersDegree degree R)
    (hpiv : DistinctPivots R) (p s t u : ℕ)
    (hst : s ≤ t) (htu : t ≤ u) :
    (originalHomologyMap degree D R V W hD2 hR hcert hRdegree hpiv p t u).comp
      (originalHomologyMap degree D R V W hD2 hR hcert hRdegree hpiv p s t) =
    originalHomologyMap degree D R V W hD2 hR hcert hRdegree hpiv p s u

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.originalHomologyMap_id
statement:
theorem originalHomologyMap_id (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (D R V W : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hD2 : D * D = 0) (hR : R = D * V)
    (hcert : TraceChangeCertificate degree V W)
    (hRdegree : LowersDegree degree R)
    (hpiv : DistinctPivots R) (p t : ℕ) :
    originalHomologyMap degree D R V W hD2 hR hcert hRdegree hpiv p t t =
      LinearMap.id

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.originalHomologyMap_mk
statement:
theorem originalHomologyMap_mk (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (D R V W : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hD2 : D * D = 0) (hR : R = D * V)
    (hcert : TraceChangeCertificate degree V W)
    (hRdegree : LowersDegree degree R)
    (hpiv : DistinctPivots R) (p s t : ℕ) (hst : s ≤ t)
    (x : originalCycleSpace degree D p s) :
    (originalHomologyEquivAlive degree D R V W hD2 hR hcert hRdegree hpiv p t)
      (originalHomologyMap degree D R V W hD2 hR hcert hRdegree hpiv p s t
        (Submodule.Quotient.mk x)) =
      ⟨aliveRepresentative degree R p t (((normalMatrix R V)⁻¹).mulVec x.1),
        aliveRepresentative_mem_aliveSpace degree R p t
          (((normalMatrix R V)⁻¹).mulVec x.1)⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.originalHomologyMap_rank_formula
statement:
theorem originalHomologyMap_rank_formula (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (D R V W : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hD2 : D * D = 0) (hR : R = D * V)
    (hcert : TraceChangeCertificate degree V W)
    (hRdegree : LowersDegree degree R)
    (hpiv : DistinctPivots R) (p s t : ℕ) (hst : s ≤ t) (_ht : t ≤ m) :
    Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range
      (originalHomologyMap degree D R V W hD2 hR hcert hRdegree hpiv p s t)) =
      (deathSurvivorFinset degree R p s t).card +
        (essentialSurvivorFinset degree R p s).card

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.originalHomologyMap_transport
statement:
theorem originalHomologyMap_transport (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (D R V W : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hD2 : D * D = 0) (hR : R = D * V)
    (hcert : TraceChangeCertificate degree V W)
    (hRdegree : LowersDegree degree R)
    (hpiv : DistinctPivots R) (p s t : ℕ)
    (x : originalHomology degree D R V W hD2 hR hcert hRdegree hpiv p s) :
    (originalHomologyEquivAlive degree D R V W hD2 hR hcert hRdegree hpiv p t)
      (originalHomologyMap degree D R V W hD2 hR hcert hRdegree hpiv p s t x) =
    aliveSpaceMap degree R p s t
      ((originalHomologyEquivAlive degree D R V W hD2 hR hcert hRdegree hpiv p s) x)

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.originalHomology_kernel_eq_boundaries
statement:
theorem originalHomology_kernel_eq_boundaries (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (D R V W : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hD2 : D * D = 0) (hR : R = D * V)
    (hcert : TraceChangeCertificate degree V W)
    (hRdegree : LowersDegree degree R)
    (hpiv : DistinctPivots R) (p t : ℕ)
    (x : originalCycleSpace degree D p t) :
    x ∈ LinearMap.ker
      (originalLiveMap degree D R V W hD2 hR hcert hRdegree hpiv p t) ↔
      OriginalBoundary degree D p t x.1

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.originalLiveMap_surjective
statement:
theorem originalLiveMap_surjective (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (D R V W : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hD2 : D * D = 0) (hR : R = D * V)
    (hcert : TraceChangeCertificate degree V W)
    (hRdegree : LowersDegree degree R)
    (hpiv : DistinctPivots R) (p t : ℕ) :
    Function.Surjective
      (originalLiveMap degree D R V W hD2 hR hcert hRdegree hpiv p t)

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.essentialIndex_essential
statement:
theorem essentialIndex_essential (i : Fin m) :
    essentialIndex (essentialInterval i) = some i

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.essentialIndex_paired
statement:
theorem essentialIndex_paired (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hstrict : StrictBoundary R) (j i : Fin m)
    (hji : columnPivot (R.col j) = some i) :
    essentialIndex (pairedInterval R hstrict j i hji) = none

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.finiteIndexPair_essential
statement:
theorem finiteIndexPair_essential (i : Fin m) :
    finiteIndexPair (essentialInterval i) = none

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.finiteIndexPair_paired
statement:
theorem finiteIndexPair_paired (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hstrict : StrictBoundary R) (j i : Fin m)
    (hji : columnPivot (R.col j) = some i) :
    finiteIndexPair (pairedInterval R hstrict j i hji) = some (i, j)

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.mem_pivotEssentialIndices_iff
statement:
theorem mem_pivotEssentialIndices_iff (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (p : ℕ) (i : Fin m) :
    i ∈ pivotEssentialIndices degree R p ↔ IsEssential R i ∧ degree i = p

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.mem_pivotIndexPairs_iff
statement:
theorem mem_pivotIndexPairs_iff (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (hpiv : DistinctPivots R)
    (p : ℕ) (i j : Fin m) :
    (i,j) ∈ pivotIndexPairs degree R p ↔
      degree i = p ∧ columnPivot (R.col j) = some i

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.pivotBarcode_endpoints
statement:
theorem pivotBarcode_endpoints (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (hs : StrictBoundary R) (p : ℕ) :
    (pivotBarcode degree R hs p).map (fun I => (I.birth, I.death)) =
      (pivotIndexPairs degree R p).map (fun q => (q.1.val+1,q.2.val+1)) +
      (pivotEssentialIndices degree R p).map (fun i => (i.val+1,m+1))

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.pivotBarcode_essential
statement:
theorem pivotBarcode_essential (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (hstrict : StrictBoundary R) (p : ℕ) :
    (pivotBarcode degree R hstrict p).filterMap essentialIndex =
      pivotEssentialIndices degree R p

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.pivotBarcode_pairs
statement:
theorem pivotBarcode_pairs (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (hstrict : StrictBoundary R) (p : ℕ) :
    (pivotBarcode degree R hstrict p).filterMap finiteIndexPair =
      pivotIndexPairs degree R p

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.pivotBarcode_rank
statement:
theorem pivotBarcode_rank (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (hstrict : StrictBoundary R)
    (hpiv : DistinctPivots R) (p s t : ℕ) (hst : s ≤ t)
    (ht : t ≤ m) :
    (pivotBarcode degree R hstrict p).countP
      (fun I => I.birth ≤ s ∧ t < I.death) =
      (deathSurvivorFinset degree R p s t).card +
        (essentialSurvivorFinset degree R p s).card

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.pivotEssentialIndices_nodup
statement:
theorem pivotEssentialIndices_nodup (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (p : ℕ) :
    (pivotEssentialIndices degree R p).Nodup

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.pivotEssentialIntervals_count
statement:
theorem pivotEssentialIntervals_count (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (p s t : ℕ) (_hst : s ≤ t)
    (ht : t ≤ m) :
    (pivotEssentialIntervals degree R p).countP
      (fun I => I.birth ≤ s ∧ t < I.death) =
      (essentialSurvivorFinset degree R p s).card

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.pivotIndexPairs_nodup
statement:
theorem pivotIndexPairs_nodup (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (p : ℕ) :
    (pivotIndexPairs degree R p).Nodup

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.pivotPairIntervals_count
statement:
theorem pivotPairIntervals_count (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (hstrict : StrictBoundary R)
    (p s t : ℕ) :
    (pivotPairIntervals degree R hstrict p).countP
      (fun I => I.birth ≤ s ∧ t < I.death) =
      (pairSurvivorFinset degree R p s t).card

name: TDA.Persistence.TwoInjectivePresentation.differential_eq
statement:
@[simp] theorem differential_eq (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S)
    [∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)] :
    differential M = quotientProjection M ≫ secondEmbedding M

name: TDA.Persistence.TwoInjectivePresentation.firstEmbedding_comp_differential
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)] theorem firstEmbedding_comp_differential
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S) [∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)] :
    firstEmbedding M ≫ differential M = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.TwoInjectivePresentation.firstEmbedding_mono
statement:
theorem firstEmbedding_mono (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S)
    [∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)] : Mono (firstEmbedding M)

name: TDA.Persistence.TwoInjectivePresentation.firstEmbedding_π
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem firstEmbedding_π (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S)
    [∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)] (t : Index M) :
    firstEmbedding M ≫ biproduct.π (family M) t = summandMap M t

name: TDA.Persistence.TwoInjectivePresentation.firstEmbedding_π_app_val
statement:
theorem firstEmbedding_π_app_val (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S)
    [∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)] (t : Index M) (q : S) (x : M.obj q) :
    (((biproduct.π (family M) t).app q).hom
      (((firstEmbedding M).app q).hom x) : k) =
      if h : q ≤ t.1 then coordinate M t.1 t.2 (structureMapLinear M h x) else 0

name: TDA.Persistence.TwoInjectivePresentation.firstInjective_injective
statement:
theorem firstInjective_injective (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S) :
    Injective (firstInjective M)

name: TDA.Persistence.TwoInjectivePresentation.quotientProjection_surjective
statement:
theorem quotientProjection_surjective (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S)
    [∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)] (p : S) :
    Function.Surjective ((quotientProjection M).app p).hom

name: TDA.Persistence.TwoInjectivePresentation.quotient_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem quotient_finiteDimensional (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S)
    [∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)] (p : S) :
    FiniteDimensional k ((quotient M).obj p)

name: TDA.Persistence.TwoInjectivePresentation.range_firstEmbedding_eq_ker_differential
statement:
theorem range_firstEmbedding_eq_ker_differential
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S) [∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)] (p : S) :
    LinearMap.range ((firstEmbedding M).app p).hom =
      LinearMap.ker ((differential M).app p).hom

name: TDA.Persistence.TwoInjectivePresentation.secondEmbedding_mono
statement:
theorem secondEmbedding_mono (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S)
    [∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)] : Mono (secondEmbedding M)

name: TDA.Persistence.TwoInjectivePresentation.secondInjective_injective
statement:
theorem secondInjective_injective (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S)
    [∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)] :
    Injective (secondInjective M)

name: TDA.Persistence.TwoInjectivePresentation.shortComplex_exact
statement:
theorem shortComplex_exact (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S)
    [∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)] : (shortComplex M).Exact

name: TDA.Probability.Coupling.col_sum
statement:
theorem col_sum [Fintype X] [Fintype Y] (π : Coupling μ ν) (y : Y) :
    ∑ x, π.joint (x, y) = ν y

name: TDA.Probability.Coupling.cost_map
statement:
@[simp] theorem cost_map (π : Coupling μ ν) (f : X → Z) (g : Y → W)
    (c : Z → W → ℝ≥0∞) :
    (π.map f g).cost c = π.cost (fun x y => c (f x) (g y))

name: TDA.Probability.Coupling.row_sum
statement:
theorem row_sum [Fintype X] [Fintype Y] (π : Coupling μ ν) (x : X) :
    ∑ y, π.joint (x, y) = μ x

name: TDA.Probability.essentialSup_map
statement:
theorem essentialSup_map (μ : PMF X) (g : X → Y) (f : Y → ℝ≥0∞) :
    essentialSup (μ.map g) f = essentialSup μ (fun x => f (g x))

name: TDA.Probability.expectation_bind
statement:
theorem expectation_bind (μ : PMF X) (ν : X → PMF Y) (f : Y → ℝ≥0∞) :
    expectation (μ.bind ν) f = expectation μ (fun x => expectation (ν x) f)

name: TDA.Probability.expectation_const
statement:
@[simp] theorem expectation_const (μ : PMF X) (c : ℝ≥0∞) :
    expectation μ (fun _ => c) = c

name: TDA.Probability.expectation_map
statement:
theorem expectation_map (μ : PMF X) (g : X → Y) (f : Y → ℝ≥0∞) :
    expectation (μ.map g) f = expectation μ (fun x => f (g x))

name: TDA.Probability.expectation_mono
statement:
theorem expectation_mono (μ : PMF X) {f g : X → ℝ≥0∞} (h : ∀ x, f x ≤ g x) :
    expectation μ f ≤ expectation μ g

name: TDA.Probability.expectation_pure
statement:
@[simp] theorem expectation_pure (x : X) (f : X → ℝ≥0∞) :
    expectation (PMF.pure x) f = f x

name: TDA.Probability.iid_map
statement:
theorem iid_map (μ : PMF X) (f : X → Y) (n : ℕ) :
    (iid μ n).map (fun t i => f (t i)) = iid (μ.map f) n

name: TDA.Probability.iid_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem iid_succ (μ : PMF X) (n : ℕ) :
    iid μ (n + 1) = μ.bind (fun x => (iid μ n).map (Fin.cons x))

name: TDA.Probability.iid_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem iid_zero (μ : PMF X) : iid μ 0 = PMF.pure Fin.elim0

name: TDA.Probability.transportCost_le_coupling
statement:
theorem transportCost_le_coupling (c : X → Y → ℝ≥0∞) (μ : PMF X) (ν : PMF Y)
    (π : Coupling μ ν) : transportCost c μ ν ≤ π.cost c

name: TDA.Probability.wasserstein_eq_iInf
statement:
theorem wasserstein_eq_iInf {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (c : X → Y → ℝ≥0∞)
    (μ : PMF X) (ν : PMF Y) :
    wasserstein p c μ ν = ⨅ π : Coupling μ ν, π.cost (fun x y => c x y ^ p) ^ p⁻¹

name: TDA.Probability.cost_le_pairEnergy
statement:
theorem cost_le_pairEnergy (c : X → X → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hc : ∀ x, c x x = 0) (hs : ∀ x y, c x y = c y x)
    {n : ℕ} (t : Fin n → X) (i j : Fin n) : c (t i) (t j) ≤ pairEnergy c t

name: TDA.Probability.cost_le_pairMaximum
statement:
theorem cost_le_pairMaximum (c : X → X → ℝ≥0∞) {n : ℕ} (t : Fin n → X)
    (i j : Fin n) : c (t i) (t j) ≤ pairMaximum c t

name: TDA.Probability.essentialSup_pairMaximum_le
statement:
theorem essentialSup_pairMaximum_le (μ : PMF X) (c : X → X → ℝ≥0∞) (n : ℕ) :
    essentialSup (iid μ n) (pairMaximum c) ≤
      essentialSup μ (fun x => essentialSup μ (c x))

name: TDA.Probability.expectation_add
statement:
theorem expectation_add (μ : PMF X) (f g : X → ℝ≥0∞) :
    expectation μ (fun x => f x + g x) = expectation μ f + expectation μ g

name: TDA.Probability.expectation_pairEnergy
statement:
theorem expectation_pairEnergy (μ : PMF X) (c : X → X → ℝ≥0∞) (n : ℕ) :
    expectation (iid μ n) (pairEnergy c) =
      (n.choose 2 : ℝ≥0∞) * expectation μ (fun x => expectation μ (c x))

name: TDA.Probability.expectation_pairMaximum_rpow_le
statement:
theorem expectation_pairMaximum_rpow_le (μ : PMF X) (c : X → X → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hc : ∀ x, c x x = 0) (hs : ∀ x y, c x y = c y x)
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (n : ℕ) :
    expectation (iid μ n) (fun t => pairMaximum c t ^ p) ≤
      (n.choose 2 : ℝ≥0∞) * expectation μ (fun x => expectation μ (fun y => c x y ^ p))

name: TDA.Probability.expectation_sum
statement:
theorem expectation_sum (μ : PMF X) {I : Type*} (s : Finset I) (f : I → X → ℝ≥0∞) :
    expectation μ (fun x => ∑ i ∈ s, f i x) = ∑ i ∈ s, expectation μ (f i)

name: TDA.Probability.iid_eval
statement:
theorem iid_eval (μ : PMF X) {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) :
    (iid μ n).map (fun t => t i) = μ

name: TDA.Probability.mem_support_of_mem_support_iid
statement:
theorem mem_support_of_mem_support_iid (μ : PMF X) {n : ℕ} {t : Fin n → X}
    (ht : t ∈ (iid μ n).support) (i : Fin n) : t i ∈ μ.support

name: TDA.Probability.pairEnergy_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem pairEnergy_succ (c : X → X → ℝ≥0∞) {n : ℕ} (t : Fin (n+1) → X) :
    pairEnergy c t = pairEnergy c (fun i => t i.succ) + ∑ j : Fin n, c (t 0) (t j.succ)

name: TDA.Probability.pairEnergy_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem pairEnergy_zero (c : X → X → ℝ≥0∞) (t : Fin 0 → X) :
    pairEnergy c t = 0

name: TDA.Probability.pairMaximum_rpow_le_pairEnergy
statement:
theorem pairMaximum_rpow_le_pairEnergy (c : X → X → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hc : ∀ x, c x x = 0) (hs : ∀ x y, c x y = c y x)
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) {n : ℕ} (t : Fin n → X) :
    pairMaximum c t ^ p ≤ pairEnergy (fun x y => c x y ^ p) t

name: TDA.Probability.Coupling.distortionMoment_of_subsingleton
statement:
theorem Coupling.distortionMoment_of_subsingleton [Subsingleton Y]
    {μ : PMF X} {ν : PMF Y} (π : Coupling μ ν) (p : ℝ) :
    π.distortionMoment p = expectation μ (fun x => expectation μ
      (fun x' => ENNReal.ofReal (dist x x') ^ p))

name: TDA.Probability.distortion_comm
statement: theorem distortion_comm (a b : X × Y) : distortion a b = distortion b a

name: TDA.Probability.distortion_self
statement: @[simp] theorem distortion_self (a : X × Y) : distortion a a = 0

name: TDA.Probability.gromovWasserstein_of_subsingleton
statement:
theorem gromovWasserstein_of_subsingleton [Subsingleton Y]
    (μ : PMF X) (ν : PMF Y) (p : ℝ) :
    gromovWasserstein p μ ν = (2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ *
      expectation μ (fun x => expectation μ (fun x' => ENNReal.ofReal (dist x x') ^ p)) ^ p⁻¹

name: TDA.Probability.MeasureCoupling.cost_map
statement:
@[simp] theorem cost_map (π : MeasureCoupling μ ν) (f : X → Z) (g : Y → W)
    [MeasurableSpace Z] [MeasurableSpace W] (hf : Measurable f) (hg : Measurable g)
    (c : Z → W → ℝ≥0∞) (hc : Measurable (fun xy : Z × W => c xy.1 xy.2)) :
    (π.map f g hf hg).cost c = π.cost (fun x y => c (f x) (g y))

name: TDA.Probability.measureTransportCost_le_coupling
statement:
theorem measureTransportCost_le_coupling (c : X → Y → ℝ≥0∞)
    (μ : ProbabilityMeasure X) (ν : ProbabilityMeasure Y) (π : MeasureCoupling μ ν) :
    measureTransportCost c μ ν ≤ π.cost c

name: TDA.Probability.measureWasserstein_eq_iInf
statement:
theorem measureWasserstein_eq_iInf {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (c : X → Y → ℝ≥0∞)
    (μ : ProbabilityMeasure X) (ν : ProbabilityMeasure Y) :
    measureWasserstein p c μ ν =
      ⨅ π : MeasureCoupling μ ν, π.cost (fun x y => c x y ^ p) ^ p⁻¹

name: TDA.Probability.measureDistortion_comm
statement:
theorem measureDistortion_comm (a b : X × Y) :
    measureDistortion a b = measureDistortion b a

name: TDA.Probability.measureDistortion_self
statement: @[simp] theorem measureDistortion_self (a : X × Y) : measureDistortion a a = 0

name: TDA.Probability.MeasureCoupling.cost_tuples
statement:
theorem cost_tuples (π : MeasureCoupling μ ν) (n : ℕ)
    (c : (Fin n → X) → (Fin n → Y) → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hc : Measurable (fun ts : (Fin n → X) × (Fin n → Y) => c ts.1 ts.2)) :
    (π.tuples n).cost c =
      ∫⁻ t, c (fun i => (t i).1) (fun i => (t i).2)
        ∂(ProbabilityMeasure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => π.joint) : Measure (Fin n → X × Y))

name: TDA.Probability.lintegral_iid_pairEnergy
statement:
theorem lintegral_iid_pairEnergy (μ : ProbabilityMeasure X) (n : ℕ)
    (c : X → X → ℝ≥0∞) (hc : Measurable (fun xy : X × X => c xy.1 xy.2)) :
    ∫⁻ t, pairEnergy c t ∂(iidMeasure μ n : Measure (Fin n → X)) =
      (n.choose 2 : ℝ≥0∞) * ∫⁻ xy, c xy.1 xy.2 ∂(μ : Measure X).prod μ

name: TDA.Probability.lintegral_iid_pairMaximum_rpow_le
statement:
theorem lintegral_iid_pairMaximum_rpow_le (μ : ProbabilityMeasure X) (n : ℕ)
    (c : X → X → ℝ≥0∞) (hc : ∀ x, c x x = 0)
    (hs : ∀ x y, c x y = c y x) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p)
    (hcm : Measurable (fun xy : X × X => c xy.1 xy.2)) :
    ∫⁻ t, pairMaximum c t ^ p ∂(iidMeasure μ n : Measure (Fin n → X)) ≤
      (n.choose 2 : ℝ≥0∞) * ∫⁻ xy, c xy.1 xy.2 ^ p ∂(μ : Measure X).prod μ

name: TDA.Topology.exists_overlap_chain
statement:
theorem exists_overlap_chain (γ : Path x y) {U : ι → Set X} (hU : ∀ i, IsOpen (U i))
    (hcov : range γ ⊆ ⋃ i, U i) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (p : Fin (n + 1) → X) (i : Fin n → ι), p 0 = x ∧ p (last n) = y ∧
      (∀ k : Fin n, JoinedIn (U (i k)) (p k.castSucc) (p k.succ)) ∧
      ∀ (k : ℕ) (hk : k + 1 < n),
        p ⟨k + 1, by omega⟩ ∈ U (i ⟨k, by omega⟩) ∩ U (i ⟨k + 1, hk⟩)

name: TDA.Topology.exists_subdivision
statement:
theorem exists_subdivision (γ : Path x y) {U : ι → Set X} (hU : ∀ i, IsOpen (U i))
    (hcov : range γ ⊆ ⋃ i, U i) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (t : Fin (n + 1) → I) (i : Fin n → ι), t 0 = 0 ∧ t (last n) = 1 ∧
      Monotone t ∧ ∀ k : Fin n, γ '' Icc (t k.castSucc) (t k.succ) ⊆ U (i k)

name: TDA.Topology.exists_subdivision_opens
statement:
theorem exists_subdivision_opens (γ : Path x y) {W : TopologicalSpace.Opens X}
    (V : ι → TopologicalSpace.Opens X) (hγ : ∀ s, γ s ∈ W) (hWV : W ≤ ⨆ i, V i) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (t : Fin (n + 1) → I) (i : Fin n → ι), t 0 = 0 ∧ t (last n) = 1 ∧
      Monotone t ∧ ∀ k : Fin n, γ '' Icc (t k.castSucc) (t k.succ) ⊆ V (i k)

name: TDA.Topology.exists_subpath_chain
statement:
theorem exists_subpath_chain (γ : Path x y) {U : ι → Set X} (hU : ∀ i, IsOpen (U i))
    (hcov : range γ ⊆ ⋃ i, U i) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (t : Fin (n + 1) → I) (i : Fin n → ι), t 0 = 0 ∧ t (last n) = 1 ∧
      Monotone t ∧ ∀ k : Fin n, range (γ.subpath (t k.castSucc) (t k.succ)) ⊆ U (i k)

name: TDA.Topology.reflTransGen_of_joined
statement:
theorem reflTransGen_of_joined (h : Joined x y) {U : ι → Set X} (hU : ∀ i, IsOpen (U i))
    (hcov : pathComponent x ⊆ ⋃ i, U i) :

name: TDA.Topology.reflTransGen_of_path
statement:

name: TDA.Topology.reflTransGen_preimage
statement:
theorem reflTransGen_preimage {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y] (f : C(X, Y))
    {W : TopologicalSpace.Opens Y} (V : ι → TopologicalSpace.Opens Y) (hWV : W ≤ ⨆ i, V i)
    {a b : {x : X // f x ∈ W}} (h : Joined a b) :
    Relation.ReflTransGen
      (fun a b : {x : X // f x ∈ W} => ∃ i, ∃ (ha : f a.1 ∈ V i) (hb : f b.1 ∈ V i),
        Joined (⟨a.1, ha⟩ : {x : X // f x ∈ V i}) ⟨b.1, hb⟩) a b

name: TDA.Reeb.componentFunctor_reflTransGen_of_mk_eq
statement:
theorem componentFunctor_reflTransGen_of_mk_eq (f : C(X, Y)) {W : TopologicalSpace.Opens Y}
    (U : ι → TopologicalSpace.Opens Y) (hcov : W ≤ ⨆ i, U i) {a b : {x : X // f x ∈ W}}
    (h : (ZerothHomotopy.mk a : (componentFunctor f).obj W) = ZerothHomotopy.mk b) :
    Relation.ReflTransGen
      (fun a b : {x : X // f x ∈ W} => ∃ i, ∃ (ha : f a.1 ∈ U i) (hb : f b.1 ∈ U i),
        (ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨a.1, ha⟩ : (componentFunctor f).obj (U i)) =
          ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨b.1, hb⟩) a b

name: TDA.Topology.eqvGen_overlapRel_apply_eq
statement:
theorem eqvGen_overlapRel_apply_eq (F : α ⥤ Type w₀) (U : ι → α) {A : Sort*}
    (a : ∀ i, F.obj (U i) → A)
    (ha : ∀ i j (c : F.obj (U i ⊓ U j)),
      a i (F.map (homOfLE inf_le_left) c) = a j (F.map (homOfLE inf_le_right) c))
    {p q : Σ i, F.obj (U i)} (h : Relation.EqvGen (overlapRel F U) p q) :
    a p.1 p.2 = a q.1 q.2

name: TDA.Topology.existsUnique_glue_of_surjective_of_eqvGen
statement:
theorem existsUnique_glue_of_surjective_of_eqvGen (F : α ⥤ Type w₀) (U : ι → α)
    (c : Cocone (Pairwise.diagram U))
    (hsurj : ∀ x : F.obj c.pt, ∃ i, ∃ e : F.obj (U i), F.map (c.ι.app (.single i)) e = x)
    (hker : ∀ (i j : ι) (e : F.obj (U i)) (e' : F.obj (U j)),
      F.map (c.ι.app (.single i)) e = F.map (c.ι.app (.single j)) e' →
        Relation.EqvGen (overlapRel F U) ⟨i, e⟩ ⟨j, e'⟩)
    {A : Sort*} (a : ∀ i, F.obj (U i) → A)
    (ha : ∀ i j (c : F.obj (U i ⊓ U j)),
      a i (F.map (homOfLE inf_le_left) c) = a j (F.map (homOfLE inf_le_right) c)) :
    ∃! g : F.obj c.pt → A, ∀ i (e : F.obj (U i)), g (F.map (c.ι.app (.single i)) e) = a i e

name: TDA.Topology.nonempty_isColimit_mapCocone_iff
statement:
theorem nonempty_isColimit_mapCocone_iff (F : α ⥤ Type w₀) (U : ι → α)

    Nonempty (IsColimit (F.mapCocone c)) ↔
      (∀ x : F.obj c.pt, ∃ i, ∃ e : F.obj (U i), F.map (c.ι.app (.single i)) e = x) ∧
      ∀ (i j : ι) (e : F.obj (U i)) (e' : F.obj (U j)),
        F.map (c.ι.app (.single i)) e = F.map (c.ι.app (.single j)) e' →
          Relation.EqvGen (overlapRel F U) ⟨i, e⟩ ⟨j, e'⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.componentFunctor_existsUnique_glue
statement:
theorem componentFunctor_existsUnique_glue (f : C(X, Y)) {W : TopologicalSpace.Opens Y}
    (U : ι → TopologicalSpace.Opens Y) (hU : ∀ i, U i ≤ W) (hcov : W ≤ ⨆ i, U i) {A : Sort*}
    (a : ∀ i, (componentFunctor f).obj (U i) → A)
    (ha : ∀ i j (c : (componentFunctor f).obj (U i ⊓ U j)),
      a i ((componentFunctor f).map (homOfLE inf_le_left) c) =
        a j ((componentFunctor f).map (homOfLE inf_le_right) c)) :
    ∃! g : (componentFunctor f).obj W → A,
      ∀ i (e : (componentFunctor f).obj (U i)),
        g ((componentFunctor f).map (homOfLE (hU i)) e) = a i e

name: TDA.Reeb.componentFunctor_glue_natTrans
statement:
theorem componentFunctor_glue_natTrans {Z : Type u} [TopologicalSpace Z] {f : C(X, Y)}
    {g : C(Z, Y)} (h : C(X, Z)) (comm : ∀ x, g (h x) = f x) {W : TopologicalSpace.Opens Y}
    (U : ι → TopologicalSpace.Opens Y) (hU : ∀ i, U i ≤ W) (hcov : W ≤ ⨆ i, U i) {A : Sort*}
    (a : ∀ i, (componentFunctor g).obj (U i) → A) (G : (componentFunctor g).obj W → A)
    (hG : ∀ i (e : (componentFunctor g).obj (U i)),
      G ((componentFunctor g).map (homOfLE (hU i)) e) = a i e)
    (G' : (componentFunctor f).obj W → A)
    (hG' : ∀ i (e : (componentFunctor f).obj (U i)),
      G' ((componentFunctor f).map (homOfLE (hU i)) e) =
        a i ((componentNatTrans h comm).app (U i) e)) :
    G' = G ∘ (componentNatTrans h comm).app W

    (a : ∀ _ : Bool, (componentFunctor (ContinuousMap.id Unit)).obj ⊤ → A)
    (G : (componentFunctor (ContinuousMap.id Unit)).obj ⊤ → A)
    (hG : ∀ i (e : (componentFunctor (ContinuousMap.id Unit)).obj ⊤),
      G ((componentFunctor (ContinuousMap.id Unit)).map (homOfLE le_top) e) = a i e)
    (G' : (componentFunctor boolToUnit).obj ⊤ → A)

      G' ((componentFunctor boolToUnit).map (homOfLE le_top) e) = a i (collapseNatTrans.app ⊤ e)) :

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.emptyCover_existsUnique_glue
statement:
theorem emptyCover_existsUnique_glue {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    (f : C(X, Y)) {A : Sort*} (U : Empty → TopologicalSpace.Opens Y)
    (a : ∀ i, (componentFunctor f).obj (U i) → A) :
    ∃! g : (componentFunctor f).obj ⊥ → A,
      ∀ i (e : (componentFunctor f).obj (U i)),
        g ((componentFunctor f).map (homOfLE (i.elim : U i ≤ ⊥)) e) = a i e

    (hcov : W ≤ ⨆ i, U i) : IsEmpty ((componentFunctor f).obj W)

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.existsUnique_glue_sort
statement:

    {κ : Sort*} (f : C(X, Y)) {W : TopologicalSpace.Opens Y} (U : κ → TopologicalSpace.Opens Y)
    (hU : ∀ i, U i ≤ W) (hcov : W ≤ ⨆ i, U i) {A : Sort*}
    (a : ∀ i, (componentFunctor f).obj (U i) → A)
    (ha : ∀ i j (c : (componentFunctor f).obj (U i ⊓ U j)),
      a i ((componentFunctor f).map (homOfLE inf_le_left) c) =
        a j ((componentFunctor f).map (homOfLE inf_le_right) c)) :
    ∃! g : (componentFunctor f).obj W → A,
      ∀ i (e : (componentFunctor f).obj (U i)),
        g ((componentFunctor f).map (homOfLE (hU i)) e) = a i e

name: TDA.Reeb.ReebQuotient.componentComparison_natural

theorem componentComparison_natural {f : C(X, Y)} {g : C(Z, Y)} (h : C(X, Z))
    (comm : ∀ x, g (h x) = f x) :
    componentNatTrans h comm ≫ componentComparison g =
      componentComparison f ≫ componentNatTrans (map h comm) (height_map_apply h comm)

name: TDA.Reeb.ReebQuotient.componentComparison_naturality
statement:
theorem componentComparison_naturality (f : C(X, Y)) {U V : TopologicalSpace.Opens Y}
    (i : U ⟶ V) :
    (componentFunctor f).map i ≫ (componentComparison f).app V =
      (componentComparison f).app U ≫ (componentFunctor (height f)).map i

name: TDA.Reeb.ReebQuotient.height_comp_map
statement:
theorem height_comp_map {f : C(X, Y)} {g : C(Z, Y)} (h : C(X, Z)) (comm : ∀ x, g (h x) = f x) :
    (height g).comp (map h comm) = height f

name: TDA.Reeb.ReebQuotient.height_map_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem height_map_apply {f : C(X, Y)} {g : C(Z, Y)} (h : C(X, Z)) (comm : ∀ x, g (h x) = f x)
    (q : ReebQuotient f) : height g (map h comm q) = height f q

name: TDA.Reeb.ReebQuotient.map_comp
statement:
theorem map_comp {W : Type*} [TopologicalSpace W] {f : C(X, Y)} {g : C(Z, Y)} {e : C(W, Y)}
    (h : C(X, Z)) (hh : ∀ x, g (h x) = f x) (k : C(Z, W)) (hk : ∀ z, e (k z) = g z)
    (hkh : ∀ x, e ((k.comp h) x) = f x) :
    map (k.comp h) hkh = (map k hk).comp (map h hh)

name: TDA.Reeb.ReebQuotient.map_comp_proj
statement:
theorem map_comp_proj {f : C(X, Y)} {g : C(Z, Y)} (h : C(X, Z)) (comm : ∀ x, g (h x) = f x) :
    (map h comm).comp (proj f) = (proj g).comp h

name: TDA.Reeb.ReebQuotient.map_id
statement:
theorem map_id (f : C(X, Y)) (comm : ∀ x, f (ContinuousMap.id X x) = f x) :
    map (ContinuousMap.id X) comm = ContinuousMap.id (ReebQuotient f)

name: TDA.Reeb.ReebQuotient.map_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_mk {f : C(X, Y)} {g : C(Z, Y)} (h : C(X, Z)) (comm : ∀ x, g (h x) = f x) (x : X) :
    map h comm (mk f x) = mk g (h x)

name: TDA.Reeb.ReebQuotient.map_surjective
statement:
theorem map_surjective {f : C(X, Y)} {g : C(Z, Y)} (h : C(X, Z)) (comm : ∀ x, g (h x) = f x)
    (hs : Function.Surjective h) : Function.Surjective (map h comm)

name: TDA.Reeb.ReebQuotient.map_unique
statement:
theorem map_unique {f : C(X, Y)} {g : C(Z, Y)} (h : C(X, Z)) (comm : ∀ x, g (h x) = f x)
    (k : C(ReebQuotient f, ReebQuotient g)) (hk : ∀ x, k (mk f x) = mk g (h x)) :
    k = map h comm

name: TDA.Reeb.ReebRel.map
statement:
theorem ReebRel.map {f : C(X, Y)} {g : C(Z, Y)} (h : C(X, Z)) (comm : ∀ x, g (h x) = f x)
    {x x' : X} (hr : ReebRel f x x') : ReebRel g (h x) (h x')

name: TDA.Reeb.overBaseMap_comm

name: TDA.Simplicial.boundary_single
statement:
theorem boundary_single (n : ℕ) (s : Face K (n + 1)) (a : R) :
    boundary K R n (Finsupp.single s a) =
      a • (∑ i : Fin (n + 2),
        Finsupp.single (deletedFace K n s i) ((-1 : R) ^ (i : ℕ)))

name: TDA.Simplicial.enumerationAfterDeletion
statement:
theorem enumerationAfterDeletion (n : ℕ) (s : Face K (n + 1)) (i : Fin (n + 2))
    (hc : (s.1.erase (s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2 i)).card = n + 1)
    (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (s.1.erase (s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2 i)).orderEmbOfFin hc j =
      s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2 (i.succAbove j)

name: TDA.Simplicial.boundary_comp_boundary
statement:
theorem boundary_comp_boundary (n : ℕ) :
    (boundary K R n).comp (boundary K R (n + 1)) = 0

name: TDA.Simplicial.simplicialChainComplex_X
statement:
@[simp]
theorem simplicialChainComplex_X (n : ℕ) :
    (simplicialChainComplex K R).X n = ModuleCat.of R (Chain K R n)

name: TDA.Simplicial.simplicialChainComplex_d
statement:
@[simp]
theorem simplicialChainComplex_d (n : ℕ) :
    (simplicialChainComplex K R).d (n + 1) n =
      ModuleCat.ofHom (boundary K R n)

name: TDA.Simplicial.simplicialChainComplex_d_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem simplicialChainComplex_d_zero (j : ℕ) :
    (simplicialChainComplex K R).d 0 j = 0

name: TDA.Simplicial.boundary_chainIncl
statement:
theorem boundary_chainIncl (h : K ≤ L) (n : ℕ) :
    (boundary L R n).comp (chainIncl R h (n + 1)) =
      (chainIncl R h n).comp (boundary K R n)

name: TDA.Simplicial.chainIncl_single
statement:
theorem chainIncl_single (h : K ≤ L) (n : ℕ)
    (s : Face K n) (a : R) :
    chainIncl R h n (Finsupp.single s a) =
      Finsupp.single (faceIncl h n s) a

name: TDA.Simplicial.faceIncl_deletedFace
statement:
theorem faceIncl_deletedFace (h : K ≤ L) (n : ℕ)
    (s : Face K (n + 1)) (i : Fin (n + 2)) :
    faceIncl h n (deletedFace K n s i) =
      deletedFace L n (faceIncl h (n + 1) s) i

name: TDA.Simplicial.simplicialChainIncl_comp
statement:
theorem simplicialChainIncl_comp (h : K ≤ L) (g : L ≤ M) :
    simplicialChainIncl R (h.trans g) =
      simplicialChainIncl R h ≫ simplicialChainIncl R g

name: TDA.Simplicial.simplicialChainIncl_f
statement:
@[simp]
theorem simplicialChainIncl_f (h : K ≤ L) (n : ℕ) :
    (simplicialChainIncl R h).f n = ModuleCat.ofHom (chainIncl R h n)

name: TDA.Simplicial.simplicialChainIncl_id
statement:
theorem simplicialChainIncl_id (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) :
    simplicialChainIncl R (le_refl K) = 𝟙 (simplicialChainComplex K R)

name: TDA.Simplicial.boundaryMatrix_apply
statement:
theorem boundaryMatrix_apply (n : ℕ)
    [Fintype (Face K (n + 1))] [DecidableEq (Face K (n + 1))]
    [Finite (Face K n)] (τ : Face K n) (σ : Face K (n + 1)) :
    boundaryMatrix K R n τ σ =
      ∑ i : Fin (n + 2),
        if deletedFace K n σ i = τ then (-1 : R) ^ (i : ℕ) else 0

name: TDA.Simplicial.boundaryMatrix_chainInclusionMatrix
statement:
theorem boundaryMatrix_chainInclusionMatrix (R : Type v) [CommRing R]
    (h : K ≤ L) (n : ℕ)
    [Fintype (Face K (n + 1))] [DecidableEq (Face K (n + 1))]
    [Fintype (Face K n)] [DecidableEq (Face K n)]
    [Fintype (Face L (n + 1))] [DecidableEq (Face L (n + 1))]
    [Finite (Face L n)] :
    boundaryMatrix L R n * chainInclusionMatrix R h (n + 1) =
      chainInclusionMatrix R h n * boundaryMatrix K R n

name: TDA.Simplicial.boundaryMatrix_deletedFace
statement:
theorem boundaryMatrix_deletedFace (n : ℕ)
    [Fintype (Face K (n + 1))] [DecidableEq (Face K (n + 1))]
    [Finite (Face K n)] (σ : Face K (n + 1)) (i : Fin (n + 2)) :
    boundaryMatrix K R n (deletedFace K n σ i) σ =
      (-1 : R) ^ (i : ℕ)

name: TDA.Simplicial.boundaryMatrix_eq_zero_of_not_deletedFace
statement:
theorem boundaryMatrix_eq_zero_of_not_deletedFace (n : ℕ)
    [Fintype (Face K (n + 1))] [DecidableEq (Face K (n + 1))]
    [Finite (Face K n)] (τ : Face K n) (σ : Face K (n + 1))
    (hτ : ∀ i : Fin (n + 2), deletedFace K n σ i ≠ τ) :
    boundaryMatrix K R n τ σ = 0

name: TDA.Simplicial.boundaryMatrix_mulVec
statement:
theorem boundaryMatrix_mulVec (n : ℕ)
    [Fintype (Face K (n + 1))] [DecidableEq (Face K (n + 1))]
    [Finite (Face K n)] (c : Chain K R (n + 1)) :
    boundaryMatrix K R n *ᵥ chainCoordinates K R (n + 1) c =
      chainCoordinates K R n (boundary K R n c)

name: TDA.Simplicial.boundaryMatrix_mul_boundaryMatrix
statement:
theorem boundaryMatrix_mul_boundaryMatrix (n : ℕ)
    [Fintype (Face K (n + 2))] [DecidableEq (Face K (n + 2))]
    [Fintype (Face K (n + 1))] [DecidableEq (Face K (n + 1))]
    [Finite (Face K n)] :
    boundaryMatrix K R n * boundaryMatrix K R (n + 1) = 0

name: TDA.Simplicial.boundaryMatrix_toLin
statement:
theorem boundaryMatrix_toLin (n : ℕ)
    [Fintype (Face K (n + 1))] [DecidableEq (Face K (n + 1))]
    [Finite (Face K n)] :
    Matrix.toLin (faceBasis K R (n + 1)) (faceBasis K R n)
        (boundaryMatrix K R n) = boundary K R n

name: TDA.Simplicial.chainCoordinates_apply
statement:
theorem chainCoordinates_apply (n : ℕ) [Finite (Face K n)]
    (c : Chain K R n) (s : Face K n) :
    chainCoordinates K R n c s = c s

name: TDA.Simplicial.chainInclusionMatrix_apply
statement:
theorem chainInclusionMatrix_apply (R : Type v) [CommRing R] (h : K ≤ L) (n : ℕ)
    [Fintype (Face K n)] [DecidableEq (Face K n)] [Finite (Face L n)]
    (τ : Face L n) (σ : Face K n) :
    chainInclusionMatrix R h n τ σ =
      if faceIncl h n σ = τ then 1 else 0

name: TDA.Simplicial.chainInclusionMatrix_mulVec
statement:
theorem chainInclusionMatrix_mulVec (R : Type v) [CommRing R] (h : K ≤ L) (n : ℕ)
    [Fintype (Face K n)] [DecidableEq (Face K n)] [Finite (Face L n)]
    (c : Chain K R n) :
    chainInclusionMatrix R h n *ᵥ chainCoordinates K R n c =
      chainCoordinates L R n (chainIncl R h n c)

name: TDA.Simplicial.simplicialChainComplex_d_zero_toMatrix
statement:
theorem simplicialChainComplex_d_zero_toMatrix (j : ℕ)
    [Fintype (Face K 0)] [DecidableEq (Face K 0)]
    [Finite (Face K j)] :
    LinearMap.toMatrix (faceBasis K R 0) (faceBasis K R j)
      ((simplicialChainComplex K R).d 0 j).hom = 0

name: TDA.Simplicial.boundary_orientedTuple
statement:
theorem boundary_orientedTuple (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V)
    (R : Type v) [Ring R] {n : ℕ} (x : Fin (n + 2) → V)
    (hk : Finset.univ.image x ∈ K) :
    boundary K R n (orientedTuple K R x) = tupleBoundarySum K R x

name: TDA.Simplicial.deletedPerm_succAbove
statement:
theorem deletedPerm_succAbove {n : ℕ} (p : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1)))
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (j : Fin n) :
    (p i).succAbove (deletedPerm p i j) = p (i.succAbove j)

name: TDA.Simplicial.orientedTuple_comp_perm
statement:
theorem orientedTuple_comp_perm (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V)
    (R : Type v) [Ring R] {n : ℕ} (x : Fin (n + 1) → V)
    (p : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1))) :
    orientedTuple K R (x ∘ p) = (Equiv.Perm.sign p : ℤ) • orientedTuple K R x

name: TDA.Simplicial.orientedTuple_face
statement:
theorem orientedTuple_face (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V)
    (R : Type v) [Ring R] {n : ℕ} (s : Face K n) :
    orientedTuple K R (s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2) = Finsupp.single s (1 : R)

name: TDA.Simplicial.orientedTuple_of_injective
statement:
theorem orientedTuple_of_injective (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V)
    (R : Type v) [Ring R] {n : ℕ} (x : Fin (n + 1) → V)
    (hx : Function.Injective x) (hk : Finset.univ.image x ∈ K) :
    orientedTuple K R x = ((Equiv.Perm.sign (Tuple.sort x) : ℤ)) •
      Finsupp.single (tupleFace K x hx hk) (1 : R)

name: TDA.Simplicial.orientedTuple_of_monotone
statement:
theorem orientedTuple_of_monotone (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V)
    (R : Type v) [Ring R] {n : ℕ} (x : Fin (n + 1) → V)
    (hx : Function.Injective x) (hk : Finset.univ.image x ∈ K) (hm : Monotone x) :
    orientedTuple K R x = Finsupp.single (tupleFace K x hx hk) (1 : R)

name: TDA.Simplicial.orientedTuple_of_not_injective
statement:
@[simp] theorem orientedTuple_of_not_injective (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V)
    (R : Type v) [Ring R] {n : ℕ} (x : Fin (n + 1) → V)
    (hx : ¬Function.Injective x) : orientedTuple K R x = 0

name: TDA.Simplicial.sign_deletedPerm
statement:
theorem sign_deletedPerm {n : ℕ} (p : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1)))
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Equiv.Perm.sign (deletedPerm p i) =
      (-1 : ℤˣ) ^ (p i : ℕ) * Equiv.Perm.sign p * (-1 : ℤˣ) ^ (i : ℕ)

name: TDA.Simplicial.tupleBoundarySum_comp_perm
statement:
theorem tupleBoundarySum_comp_perm (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V)
    (R : Type v) [Ring R] {n : ℕ} (x : Fin (n + 2) → V)
    (p : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 2))) :
    tupleBoundarySum K R (x ∘ p) =
      (Equiv.Perm.sign p : ℤ) • tupleBoundarySum K R x

name: TDA.Simplicial.tupleBoundarySum_eq_zero_of_adjacent
statement:
theorem tupleBoundarySum_eq_zero_of_adjacent (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V)
    (R : Type v) [Ring R] {n : ℕ} (x : Fin (n + 2) → V)
    (r : Fin (n + 1)) (hr : x r.castSucc = x r.succ) :
    tupleBoundarySum K R x = 0

name: TDA.Simplicial.tupleBoundarySum_eq_zero_of_not_injective
statement:
theorem tupleBoundarySum_eq_zero_of_not_injective (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V)
    (R : Type v) [Ring R] {n : ℕ} (x : Fin (n + 2) → V)
    (hx : ¬Function.Injective x) : tupleBoundarySum K R x = 0

name: TDA.Simplicial.tupleFace_sorted_enumeration
statement:
theorem tupleFace_sorted_enumeration (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V)
    {n : ℕ} (x : Fin (n + 1) → V) (hx : Function.Injective x)
    (hk : Finset.univ.image x ∈ K) :
    ⇑((tupleFace K x hx hk).1.orderEmbOfFin (tupleFace K x hx hk).2.2) =
      x ∘ Tuple.sort x

name: TDA.Simplicial.tupleImage_delete_mem
statement:
theorem tupleImage_delete_mem (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V)
    {n : ℕ} (x : Fin (n + 2) → V) (hk : Finset.univ.image x ∈ K)
    (i : Fin (n + 2)) : Finset.univ.image (x ∘ i.succAbove) ∈ K

name: TDA.Simplicial.VertexMapExamples.edge_collapse_fixture
statement:
theorem edge_collapse_fixture :
    ({0, 1} : Finset (Fin 2)).image (fun _ : Fin 2 => (0 : Fin 2)) =
        ({0} : Finset (Fin 2)) ∧

name: TDA.Simplicial.VertexMapExamples.ghost_vertices_are_not_forced

theorem ghost_vertices_are_not_forced :

name: TDA.Topology.C0MeasureRepresentation.denseRange_compactlySupported
statement:
theorem denseRange_compactlySupported :
    DenseRange (fun f : C_c(X, ℝ) => (f : C₀(X, ℝ)))

name: TDA.Topology.C0MeasureRepresentation.exists_finite_regular_measure_sub
statement:
theorem exists_finite_regular_measure_sub (L : C₀(X, ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) :
    ∃ μ ν : Measure X, IsFiniteMeasure μ ∧ IsFiniteMeasure ν ∧ μ.Regular ∧ ν.Regular ∧
      ∀ f : C₀(X, ℝ), L f = (∫ x, f x ∂μ) - ∫ x, f x ∂ν

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.ball_mass_le
statement:
theorem ball_mass_le (μ ν : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (δ : ℝ≥0) (h : levyProkhorovEDist μ ν < (δ : ℝ≥0∞)) (x : X) (r : ℝ) :
    μ.real (ball x r) ≤ ν.real (ball x (r + δ)) + δ

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.cross_le_iff
statement:
theorem cross_le_iff (δ : ℝ≥0) (p q : Index) :
    (⟨p, false⟩ : InterleavingIndex δ) ≤ ⟨q, true⟩ ↔
      mass q ≤ mass p - δ ∧ radius p + δ ≤ radius q

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.interleavingDiagram_left
statement:
theorem interleavingDiagram_left (μ ν : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (δ : ℝ≥0) (h : levyProkhorovEDist μ ν < (δ : ℝ≥0∞)) :
    (copy δ false).toFunctor ⋙ interleavingDiagram μ ν δ h = diagram μ

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.interleavingDiagram_right
statement:
theorem interleavingDiagram_right (μ ν : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (δ : ℝ≥0) (h : levyProkhorovEDist μ ν < (δ : ℝ≥0∞)) :
    (copy δ true).toFunctor ⋙ interleavingDiagram μ ν δ h = diagram ν

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.interleavingIndex_le_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem interleavingIndex_le_iff (δ : ℝ≥0) (p q : InterleavingIndex δ) :
    p ≤ q ↔ mass q.point + penalty δ p.side q.side ≤ mass p.point ∧
      radius p.point + penalty δ p.side q.side ≤ radius q.point

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.stage_cross
statement:
theorem stage_cross (μ ν : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (δ : ℝ≥0) (h : levyProkhorovEDist μ ν < (δ : ℝ≥0∞))
    {p q : Index} (hpq : mass q ≤ mass p - δ ∧ radius p + δ ≤ radius q) :
    stage μ p ⊆ stage ν q

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.stage_mono
statement:
theorem stage_mono (μ : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {p q : Index} (hpq : p ≤ q) :
    stage μ p ⊆ stage μ q

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.topologicalInterleaving_left
statement:
theorem topologicalInterleaving_left (μ ν : Measure X)
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (δ : ℝ≥0)
    (h : levyProkhorovEDist μ ν < (δ : ℝ≥0∞)) :
    (copy δ false).toFunctor ⋙ topologicalInterleaving μ ν δ h = topologicalDiagram μ

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.topologicalInterleaving_right
statement:
theorem topologicalInterleaving_right (μ ν : Measure X)
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (δ : ℝ≥0)
    (h : levyProkhorovEDist μ ν < (δ : ℝ≥0∞)) :
    (copy δ true).toFunctor ⋙ topologicalInterleaving μ ν δ h = topologicalDiagram ν

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.uniformMeasure_apply
statement:
theorem uniformMeasure_apply (p : V → X) {A : Set X} (hA : MeasurableSet A) :
    uniformMeasure p A =
      (labelCount p A : ℝ≥0∞) / Fintype.card V

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.uniformMeasure_real
statement:
theorem uniformMeasure_real (p : V → X) {A : Set X} (hA : MeasurableSet A) :
    (uniformMeasure p).real A =
      (labelCount p A : ℝ) / Fintype.card V

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.labelCount_comp_embedding_le
statement:
theorem labelCount_comp_embedding_le [Fintype V] [Fintype W]
    (i : V ↪ W) (p : W → X) (A : Set X) :
    labelCount (p ∘ i) A ≤ labelCount p A

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.labelCount_le_card
statement:
theorem labelCount_le_card [Fintype V] (p : V → X) (A : Set X) :

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.levyProkhorovDist_uniform_embedding_le
statement:
theorem levyProkhorovDist_uniform_embedding_le (i : V ↪ W) (p : W → X) :
    levyProkhorovDist (uniformMeasure (p ∘ i)) (uniformMeasure p) ≤
      ((Fintype.card W : ℝ) - Fintype.card V) / Fintype.card W

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.levyProkhorovEDist_uniform_embedding_le
statement:
theorem levyProkhorovEDist_uniform_embedding_le (i : V ↪ W) (p : W → X) :
    levyProkhorovEDist (uniformMeasure (p ∘ i)) (uniformMeasure p) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (((Fintype.card W : ℝ) - Fintype.card V) / Fintype.card W)

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.uniformMeasure_real_comp_embedding_le
statement:
theorem uniformMeasure_real_comp_embedding_le (i : V ↪ W) (p : W → X)
    {A : Set X} (hA : MeasurableSet A) :
    (uniformMeasure (p ∘ i)).real A ≤ (uniformMeasure p).real A +
      ((Fintype.card W : ℝ) - Fintype.card V) / Fintype.card W

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.uniformOutlierInterleaving_left
statement:
theorem uniformOutlierInterleaving_left (i : V ↪ W) (p : W → X) (δ : ℝ≥0)
    (hδ : ((Fintype.card W : ℝ) - Fintype.card V) / Fintype.card W < δ) :
    (copy δ false).toFunctor ⋙ uniformOutlierInterleaving i p δ hδ =
      topologicalDiagram (uniformMeasure (p ∘ i))

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.uniformOutlierInterleaving_right
statement:
theorem uniformOutlierInterleaving_right (i : V ↪ W) (p : W → X) (δ : ℝ≥0)
    (hδ : ((Fintype.card W : ℝ) - Fintype.card V) / Fintype.card W < δ) :
    (copy δ true).toFunctor ⋙ uniformOutlierInterleaving i p δ hδ =
      topologicalDiagram (uniformMeasure p)

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.levyProkhorovDist_uniform_le_of_cross_dist_le
statement:
theorem levyProkhorovDist_uniform_le_of_cross_dist_le
    (p : V → X) (q : W → X) (p' : V → Y) (q' : W → Y)
    (hcross : ∀ v w, dist (p v) (q w) ≤ dist (p' v) (q' w)) :
    levyProkhorovDist (uniformMeasure p) (uniformMeasure q) ≤
      levyProkhorovDist (uniformMeasure p') (uniformMeasure q')

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.levyProkhorovDist_uniform_le_of_isClosed
statement:
theorem levyProkhorovDist_uniform_le_of_isClosed (p : V → X) (q : W → X)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (h : ∀ ε A, δ < ε → IsClosed A →
      uniformMeasure p A ≤ uniformMeasure q (thickening ε A) + ENNReal.ofReal ε) :
    levyProkhorovDist (uniformMeasure p) (uniformMeasure q) ≤ δ

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.levyProkhorovEDist_uniform_eq_of_cross_dist_eq
statement:
theorem levyProkhorovEDist_uniform_eq_of_cross_dist_eq
    (p : V → X) (q : W → X) (p' : V → Y) (q' : W → Y)
    (hcross : ∀ v w, dist (p v) (q w) = dist (p' v) (q' w)) :
    levyProkhorovEDist (uniformMeasure p) (uniformMeasure q) =
      levyProkhorovEDist (uniformMeasure p') (uniformMeasure q')

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.levyProkhorovEDist_uniform_le_of_cross_dist_le
statement:
theorem levyProkhorovEDist_uniform_le_of_cross_dist_le
    (p : V → X) (q : W → X) (p' : V → Y) (q' : W → Y)
    (hcross : ∀ v w, dist (p v) (q w) ≤ dist (p' v) (q' w)) :
    levyProkhorovEDist (uniformMeasure p) (uniformMeasure q) ≤
      levyProkhorovEDist (uniformMeasure p') (uniformMeasure q')

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.uniformMeasure_apply_le_of_label_mem
statement:

      S.biUnion id ∈ openCech p (radius a)

      s ∈ openCech p (radius a) ∧ mass a ≤ (s.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card V ∧
        x ∈ faceRegion p (radius a) s

      ⋃ (s : Finset V) (_ : s ∈ openCech p (radius a))

name: TDA.Topology.NerveMapExamples.permutation_reindex_inverse_fixture
statement:

          (nerveMap (reindexRefinement_symm swapEquiv NerveExamples.disjointFamily)) =
        VertexMap.id

      VertexMap.comp
          (nerveMap (reindexRefinement_symm swapEquiv NerveExamples.disjointFamily))
          (nerveMap (reindexRefinement swapEquiv NerveExamples.disjointFamily)) =
        VertexMap.id (nerve NerveExamples.disjointFamily)

      (∀ k : Fin n, JoinedIn (twoOpens (i k)) (p k.castSucc) (p k.succ)) ∧
      ∀ (k : ℕ) (hk : k + 1 < n),
